Mapa, chamada de vídeo e citação

slides.nome: Fotos aéreas, tabela e barras
slides.mensagem: Alvenaria estrutural em terrenos irregulares reduz custo por m2 e eleva rentabilidade do projeto.
slides.truque: Duas fotos de obra Cury vs Direcional lado a lado, tabela de trade-offs de metodo construtivo com linha de resultado destacada.

slides.nome: Barra realçada com chamada e linhas

slides.nome: Texto com foto de visita e barras

slides.nome: Foto de visita, tabela e curva

slides.truque: Ciclo de 5 etapas numeradas do risco, heatmap VSO x INCC do VPL e Dupont ajustado, tudo em uma pagina com caixa conclusiva 'alta alavancagem = maior necessidade de VSO'.

slides.nome: Quadrante com logos, barras e decomposição

slides.truque: Scatter ROE x VSO com logos das empresas como pontos (Cury em bolha tracejada) ao lado de barras de equity exposure no landbank.

slides.nome: Divisor com terceira tese acesa
Linha do tempo com retratos e organograma

slides.truque: Fotos dos dois executivos nas pontas de uma linha do tempo de cargos, organograma familiar e citacao de analista (BTG) em caixa recortada.

slides.nome: Preço com eventos, treemap e barras
slides.mensagem: Governanca com alinhamento economico: insiders compram acoes e remuneracao variavel e atrelada a acoes.
slides.truque: Grafico de preco com marcadores de compra do CEO como balões, treemap de composicao acionaria e barras 100% empilhadas de remuneracao.

slides.truque: Mapa do Brasil com bolhas de presenca e tabela de mercado enderecavel por regiao, foto do CEO com citacao e recorte de reportagem.

slides.nome: Área entre linhas, notícia e sensibilidade

Índice de apêndice em colunas numeradas
Capa escura com ondas de linhas

slides.nome: Resumo de investimento em painéis com cards
slides.mensagem: Investment summary: 28.9% IRR / 2.71x MOIC over 6 years from a R$876mm minority entry at 8.1x and exit at 7.3x EV/EBITDA, with entry, exit and risks rationale.

slides.mensagem: Section divider 01 Business Overview with a six-section tracker (Overview, Thesis, VCP, Valuation, Deal, Risks).

slides.nome: Ilustração, barras com linha e faixa de números
slides.mensagem: Vasta at a Glance: leading B2B K-12 private education platform with R$1.8bn net revenue, ~5,000 partner schools and recurring ecosystem economics.
slides.truque: Rounded card with illustration + brand pillars on the left, brand-logo row of school counts above a stacked column+line chart, and a bottom Key Stats strip of 6 big numbers separated by hairlines.

slides.nome: Donut segmentado ligado a cards e gráficos
slides.mensagem: One-stop-shop platform (Core, Digital, Complements, Bilingual, School Management) gives Vasta ticket/penetration superiority vs Arco's scale strategy, with expanding margins.
slides.truque: Left stack of staggered rounded boxes hugging a half-donut wheel as an ecosystem metaphor, paired on the right with a scatter (ticket vs schools) and a margin line chart.

slides.nome: Divisor com numeral grande e ondas
Dois gráficos e destaque circular lateral
slides.mensagem: Private K-12 enrollment is flat (-0.5% CAGR) so growth comes from tuition pricing above IPCA, which lets schools invest in quality.
slides.truque: Progressive-reveal slide: top rounded panel holds stacked-percentage columns and a tuition vs IPCA line, with a pink callout card on the right; lower row is ghosted and revealed in later builds.

slides.nome: Barras empilhadas com setas e destaque
Barras com callout e citação em card
slides.mensagem: Only ~10% of private schools have scale to develop their own curriculum, and teaching quality is the main purchase driver, which is why they adopt learning systems.
slides.truque: Column chart of schools by student-count bucket with a dashed highlight box on the long tail, plus a quote card with attributed source and two icon-labelled drivers.

slides.nome: Divisor com numeral grande e ondas
slides.mensagem: Divider for Thesis I: A Portfolio Built To Stick.
slides.truque: Same divider template repeated per thesis with the slogan as subtitle so each section announces its claim before the evidence.

slides.nome: Cinco colunas com logos e gráfico lateral
slides.mensagem: Vasta has the most complete K-12 portfolio, built through M&A, and ranks at the top of academic approvals (USP, Unesp, Unicamp) vs Poliedro, Anglo, Objetivo.
slides.truque: Five vertical pillar cards with icon, label and stacked brand-logo lineup (the logos prove the claim) beside a clustered bar chart with colored background bands per exam, and a B2C TAM callout with Brazil map.

slides.nome: Dois gráficos de área e citação com fotos
slides.mensagem: Vasta's product stickiness is structural: churn stays low and net revenue retention rises while Arco's churn is higher and retention weaker.
slides.truque: Two matching area charts (Arco x Vasta churn and NRR) side by side, with a testimonial card with face photos and magenta name bar overlapping the lower right corner.

slides.nome: Cabeçalhos em seta sobre três gráficos
slides.mensagem: Cross-sell, lower selling expenses and higher EBITDA margin combine into stronger unit economics than Arco.
slides.truque: Three tinted header cards with chevron arrows (cause chain) each over a Vasta vs Arco chart, closed by a numbered conclusion bar with equals sign leading to 'Stronger unit economics'.

slides.nome: Modal sobre slide esmaecido com linha
slides.mensagem: LTV/CAC formula (gross margin x ACV x partner schools / churn over selling expenses) shows Vasta's return trending above Arco's.
slides.truque: Slide 14 dimmed behind a modal-style rounded white popup with a boxed LTV/CAC formula and a single line chart, an overlay used to zoom into one metric.

slides.nome: Divisor com numeral grande e ondas
Três cards: barras, linha e celular
slides.mensagem: Premium brands carry pricing power: Vasta ticket +69% vs IPCA +21%, validated by a brand price ladder and Plurall usage field evidence.
slides.truque: Three column cards with distinct fills (brand ladder bars, highlighted gradient pricing-index chart, phone mockup showing app-store stats), the middle one in solid magenta for emphasis.

slides.nome: Painéis de contribuição, prazo e profundidade
slides.mensagem: Core revenue grew +89% in 2021-2025, driven almost entirely by average ticket (73 p.p.) and school count (15 p.p.), with density contributing zero.
slides.truque: Single contribution bar split into colored segments (ticket/schools/density) with a 3-icon decomposition below, plus a CAC-payback range strip and four NPV-by-depth bubbles of increasing size.

slides.nome: Barras de custo, KPIs e faixa de síntese
slides.mensagem: High switching cost (R$394k per school, 1.3x annual fee) and 92.8% GRR keep returns resilient even under severe stress.
slides.truque: Horizontal bars stack the cost components of switching to a total row, and a donut GRR with three icon KPIs sits beside a stress-case NPV ladder, with two tinted takeaway banners at the bottom.

slides.nome: Divisor com numeral grande e ondas
Três linhas numeradas com mini-barras e painel
slides.mensagem: Northeast is a whitespace premium: scarce premium systems, low private penetration and a ticket headroom vs Sao Paulo, with a closing window.
slides.truque: Three numbered white cards (01-03) each with a mini chart, joined to a solid magenta conclusion panel listing the whitespace arguments and ending in a 'Premiumization -> Volume' pill.

slides.nome: Ciclo de volante com cards laterais
slides.mensagem: The flagship flywheel: one anchor school drives approvals, local reputation, school demand and B2B system adoption.
slides.truque: Five circle icons connected by arrows with a return loop arrow beneath, next to three bordered case cards (Bernoulli, Poliedro, Anglo), and a callout bar quantifying the single-flagship payoff.

slides.nome: Mapa regional com ranking e tabela
slides.mensagem: Recife ranks highest on capital attractiveness, so the entry starts there, with Natal and Joao Pessoa as phased follow-ups and target neighborhoods mapped.
slides.truque: Northeast map with numbered phased-rollout pins beside a ranked bar+table of cities, and three satellite-map neighborhood thumbnails with R$/m2 prices along the bottom.

slides.nome: Funil 3D central com matriz e painéis
slides.mensagem: Cautious entry in Recife is the dominant strategy in a 3x3 payoff matrix against Bernoulli's reaction, and the TAM funnel narrows to ~40 schools today.
slides.truque: A 3D tiered funnel (TAM to SAM to SOM to Today) sits between a 3x3 game-theory payoff grid with the Nash cell highlighted in magenta and a 'where the 100 come from' split, with a four-KPI row beneath.

slides.nome: Curva de payback com opções e ilustração
slides.mensagem: The expansion plan pays off: 25% IRR, 4x MOIC, 95% chance of positive NPV, payback 2031, with real options (Salvador, Natal, Fortaleza) staged as future bets.
slides.truque: Three big-number KPIs across the top, a J-curve cash line with 'max risk' and 'upside' callouts, and chained option pills (Now / if validated / separate option) with a recommendation bar at the foot.

slides.nome: Divisor com numeral grande e ondas
Mapa do Brasil, donut e gráficos em painel

slides.truque: Violet palette signals a different entity (Educbank) inside a magenta deck; a header summary box with a cap-table donut sits over three tinted pillars (Demand / Performance / Potential) with a Brazil choropleth and isometric building.

slides.truque: Logo equation badge (arco -> isaac) at left, a video-call quote card on the right, and two columns+line charts below with a dashed box marking the inflection year.

slides.truque: Stacked 100% cap-table columns by year and a capital-invested bar chart on the left, framed by a rounded outline panel for a stacked revenue breakdown by product with growth labels on the right.

slides.nome: Divisor com numeral grande e ondas
Barras empilhadas com linha e premissas
slides.mensagem: Revenue grows from R$947mm to R$6.5bn by 2035E, led by core and cross-sell with VCP I and II modules, under five stated assumption groups.
slides.truque: Large stacked revenue column chart with segment legend and total/growth labels on the left, numbered assumptions list (I-V by line item) in a narrow right column.

Donuts antes e depois com entrada central
slides.mensagem: Deal terms: Cogna's CJE injects R$876mm primary capital at 8.1x entry multiple, taking 15% post-money, for 2.71x MOIC and 28.9% IRR.
slides.truque: Pre- and post-money shareholder donuts bracket a central entry box with the building image, and below a horizontal multiple scale (trading comps, tender offer, entry, transaction comps) positions the 8.1x entry.

slides.truque: Two-panel layout with a thin ownership bar and a bylaws illustration on one side and a boxed numbered term sheet on the other; signature row adds credibility.

slides.nome: Tabela de fluxo com duas pontes cascata

slides.mensagem: PF bancário e green bond são instrumentos validados (precedentes em Chile e Colômbia) e green bonds atraem demanda de credores acima de títulos convencionais.
slides.truque: Diagrama de vantagens com logo Green Bond Principles e setas à esquerda, cards de precedentes à direita e linha comparativa overscribed green vs convencional embaixo.

slides.nome: Tabela, cartão e colunas de prêmio
slides.mensagem: Precificação do green bond a partir de comparáveis: taxa fixa de 5,0% a.a., prêmio de 0,53% abaixo do emitido de 11,8% sobre US Treasury.
slides.truque: Linha de emissões comparáveis (OETC, Elecnor, ASI) em tabela com rating, depois 3 cards de debêntures brasileiras com prêmios grandes em azul destacando a conta até a precificação final.

slides.nome: Cartões de termos com painel explicativo
slides.mensagem: Dívidas operacionais comparáveis (MUFG, BTG Chile) precificam o Project Finance a SOFR + 3,05%, com covenants ICSD e cash sweep.
slides.truque: Três fichas de comparáveis em cards à esquerda e painel azul à direita com blocos numerados I-II-III (Index+Spread, Covenant e Garantia, Amortização) apontados por setas para o logo TPC.

slides.nome: Árvore de dívida com foco sequencial
slides.mensagem: Fluxo do financiamento: USD 1,2 bi de emissão total dividido em Equity Bridge Loan, Project Finance I/II e Green Bond, com custo da dívida e covenant de cada tranche.
slides.truque: Slide escuro com menu lateral de 4 etapas e timeline de anos no topo; rosca central do uso de recursos e árvore à direita com valor da tranche em USD grande, cada etapa destaca em azul a sua parte (animação por build, p22-p24).

slides.nome: Árvore de dívida com foco sequencial
Árvore de dívida com foco sequencial
Tabelas empilhadas conectadas a caixas
slides.mensagem: Fluxo de caixa do projeto e dos credores: TIR de 13,7% (Grupo 2) e 13,5% (Grupo 3) para o projeto, com retornos de 6,3%-7,6% para o credor, acima do Treasury.
slides.truque: Duas tabelas de fluxo por período (projeto e credor) com linha final destacada em azul e caixas de TIR conectadas por setas ao benchmark US Treasury, rosca de emissão à esquerda.

slides.nome: Tabelas empilhadas conectadas a caixas
Encerramento escuro com torres aramadas
Capa com foto em recorte curvo
slides.mensagem: Constellation Challenge 2023 cover for Arezzo&Co by Argos Capital.
slides.truque: Left dark panel with big bold white title and a diagonal cyan swoosh over a full-bleed store photo; company logo bottom-right, team names bottom-left.

slides.nome: Coluna de cadeia com gráficos densos
slides.mensagem: Brazil's footwear market is more mature than the world's but apparel is still recovering, and a heavily clustered A/B consumer base drives spending.
slides.truque: Left callout box with a value-chain icon stack (design, manufacturing, distribution) beside 4 compact charts, each with a one-line bold takeaway above it.

slides.nome: Linha grande com rosca e logos
slides.mensagem: Brazilian apparel and footwear are fragmented but consolidating via M&A, with Arezzo&Co at 25% of women's footwear share.
slides.truque: Logo wall of acquired brands in a shaded box next to a market-share donut and a share-evolution line chart, tying consolidation text to visuals.

slides.nome: Faixas por classe e curvas suavizadas
slides.mensagem: Arezzo&Co and Soma lead on pricing power and diversified channel mix, so they are more resilient in downturns.
slides.truque: Peer logos on rows with horizontal dots on a C- to A+ customer-class scale, plus a smooth line chart of inflation vs revenue variation with an annotation callout.

slides.nome: Linha do tempo de logos e gráficos
slides.mensagem: International brands struggle in Brazil due to import tariffs and taxes, and Shein is the one growing as a low-price threat.
slides.truque: Logo timeline by entry decade across the top, with Shein-vs-Arezzo logo comparison and price-benchmark horizontal bars below.

slides.nome: Quatro gráficos com frases de abertura
slides.mensagem: E-commerce accelerated by the pandemic and is the future, but Brazil's penetration is still well below other regions.
slides.truque: Three stacked chart bands (columns with CAGR badge, benchmark bars highlighting Brazil in cyan, ribbon of yearly values) in one dark-grey and cyan palette.

slides.nome: Gráficos com painel destacado à direita
slides.mensagem: Omnichannel and influencers are the key digital opportunity for apparel and footwear brands.
slides.truque: Right-hand cyan-tinted panel isolates the influencer sub-story (histogram, donut, takeaway box) from the left channel-penetration charts.

slides.nome: Linhas, rosca e barras em grade
slides.mensagem: Men's apparel is a fragmented, higher-ticket gold mine and the best consolidation opportunity.
slides.truque: Men vs women shown consistently as dark vs cyan series across line, stacked 100% bars and paired columns, so the gender contrast reads at a glance.

slides.nome: Grade com fileira de roscas pequenas
slides.mensagem: Casualization and sustainability are lasting trends, but price is still the decisive factor for buyers.
slides.truque: Row of five small donuts with one-line labels for decisive purchase factors, beneath a Google Trends line with a dark callout stat box.

slides.nome: Matriz de impacto com quatro gráficos
slides.mensagem: Four main risks (destructive competition, bad tax reform, high rates, global recession) are mapped by probability x impact, with Shein and SELIC as the biggest.
slides.truque: Risk matrix with impact vs probability grid and named cells placed in the grid, paired on the right with evidence charts for each risk (SELIC line, Shein users, ICMS bars).

pecas.nome: Dark-slide outline map with glowing corridor states and two-sided orthogonal leaders
pecas.o_que_faz: Turns a logistics footprint into the whole slide, with eight assets labelled around a map that stays readable on navy.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Brazil by state, full slide. Colour: navy gradient background; all states no fill with white hairline outline; only MG/SP/RJ and RS filled with a blue gradient that brightens at the centre. Labels: outside the map, five on the right and three on the left, bold white name plus grey one-line spec. Overlays: white freeform rail lines; 1 pt bright-blue elbow connectors running only horizontal and vertical, ending in a small arrow at the label; framed KPI box top left with numbered circles. Order: background, state outlines, active fills, rail, connectors, labels, KPI box. Collision control: all text is off the map and leaders never cross.
pecas.serve_para: Logistics or asset footprint as a showpiece slide; a change of pace in a light deck.

pecas.nome: Per-country black-to-red gradient map with plant dots, under an active tab bar
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows a regional network with the two target assets lifted out of an otherwise dark, dense field.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Europe by country, cut to the network. Colour: each country its own black-to-red diagonal gradient with white borders; the target countries (Germany, Portugal) in a lighter rose so they read first. Overlays: red dots for network, black for recycling, blue with white ring for target assets; thin elbow rule from each target to a label of name, capacity, type. Legend: one horizontal row above the map. Tabs above: three dark gradient bars; active tab has a dashed red double frame. Order: tabs, legend, countries, highlights, dots, leaders, labels. Labels sit in the white margin off the map.
pecas.serve_para: Target or acquisition assets inside a wider network; multi-asset sections needing navigation.

pecas.nome: Map between chamfered gradient panels with rail network
pecas.o_que_faz: Makes the map the hinge of the slide, joining an acquisition history on the left to the rationale on the right.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Brazil by state in very pale grey with white borders. Panels: left and right rosy-grey-to-white gradient shapes whose inner edges are cut diagonally around the map, leaving a hexagonal opening; solid dark-red triangles on the diagonal seams give depth. Overlays: thin dark-red freeform rail lines, dark-red plant dots clustered in the Southeast; large red '27 units' and KPI text at the base. Left panel: year-stamped rows of target logo, swap arrows, acquirer logo, one-line rationale. Right panel: rationale bullets plus a browser-chrome news card. Order: panels, triangles, map, lines, dots, text.
pecas.serve_para: Serial M&A or footprint build-up told as history, map and thesis on one slide.

pecas.nome: Funnel wedge from map to colour-keyed cluster bars
pecas.o_que_faz: Zooms geography into portfolio, so each coloured state becomes a labelled bar that continues into a reserves donut.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Brazil by state in 4-5 greys; only cluster states take the brand colours (navy, green, dark teal). Wedge: solid green triangle, apex at the map's east edge and base at the full panel height, gradient running to grey at the apex. Panel: light grey rectangle behind three stacked bars, one per cluster, each with a darker skewed parallelogram on its right so it looks folded; donut in the same colours and a dashed total box to the right. Order: panel, wedge, map, bars, donut. No labels on the map; colour is the only key.
pecas.serve_para: Portfolio or segment breakdown tied to geography; historical overview above a timeline.

pecas.nome: Grey wedge from map into a funnel, with region values
pecas.o_que_faz: Narrows a national population map down to the addressable market in one reading motion.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Brazil by state lines, filled by 5-region purple ramp, Northeast darkest. Labels: bold value on each region, white on dark and dark on light. Wedge: grey gradient shape from the map's east edge opening right, fading to white. Funnel: five lilac blocks of shrinking width, each with an italic label and bold number. Order: wedge, map, region values, funnel. Values sit on large regions, so no leaders are needed.
pecas.serve_para: TAM funnels with regional context.

pecas.nome: Region-tint map with white pins and dashed count leaders
pecas.o_que_faz: Reports store count by region with no legend, because each number takes its region's colour.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Brazil by state, grouped into 5 regions, each a different green, Southeast darkest. Overlays: one white teardrop pin per state. Labels: bold store count outside the map in the region's own colour, joined by a dashed horizontal leader. Left: dashed-frame fact box. Right: pale grey panel with a diagonal edge starting at the map, holding before/after bar pairs. Order: panel, map, pins, leaders, labels.
pecas.serve_para: Capillarity or footprint where the regional total is the message.

pecas.nome: Coloured wedge drill-down holding a map copy
pecas.o_que_faz: Links one stack segment of a revenue chart to a detail panel that reuses the footprint map as evidence.
pecas.como_montar: Base: stacked column chart with the e-commerce series in teal and the rest pale grey. Wedge: solid teal shape from that segment opening right into a teal-framed panel. Panel: bars, bold takeaway, then a reduced copy of the region-tint map joined by a dotted frame and stem. Order: chart, wedge, panel, inner content.
pecas.serve_para: Revenue build-ups where one line depends on physical footprint.

pecas.nome: Mini region-tint map in a card
pecas.o_que_faz: Compresses the footprint for an at-a-glance card without dropping the regional counts.
pecas.como_montar: Same recipe as the region-tint map at about a third of the size: 5 green regions, white pins, dashed leaders to counts in region colour, and a dark-green chip with total stores and distribution centres at bottom left. Sits in a framed card with a green top rule.
pecas.serve_para: At-a-glance slides.

pecas.nome: Small-multiple maps in each competitor's brand hue
pecas.o_que_faz: Compares regional strength across chains side by side using nothing but each brand's own colour ramp.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: three identical Brazil maps by state or region. Colour: each map uses one chain's hue, strongest where the chain is strongest (coral with a red Northeast; mint with a dark Southeast; grey with a blue South). Labels: logo centred above each map; rounded chip with total stores at its bottom left, in the same hue. Bars below reuse the hues. Order: logo, map, chip.
pecas.serve_para: Competitive footprint comparison.

pecas.nome: Twin state choropleths with counts and independent scales
pecas.o_que_faz: Compares two firms' office networks with the actual number printed on every state.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: two Brazil state maps, BTG and XP. Colour: grey for zero, pale blue to strong teal for count. Labels: integer centred on each state with at least one office, and a small title above each map. Legend: thin vertical gradient bar beside each map, labelled max and 1. Each map has its own scale (60 vs 302), which fits footprint shape but not absolute size, so state that next to the slide. Rebuild: Excel or PowerPoint filled-map chart, whose 'Powered by Bing' credit stays visible, or freeform states.
pecas.serve_para: Footprint contrast between two companies.

pecas.nome: Twin choropleths with dashed min/max leaders and icon rail
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows two indicators by state, then ties them to the regulatory regimes below.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: two Brazil state maps in a blue ramp. Labels: only best and worst values, bold italic, on dashed curved leaders. Legend: one shared horizontal gradient bar between the maps, 0% to 100%. Overlays: cyan stems drop from each map's base with a small cap into a pale-cyan panel holding three diamond icons on a horizontal rail with captions. Order: panel, rail, maps, leaders, values, legend, stems.
pecas.serve_para: Paired indicators where only the extremes matter.

pecas.nome: Silhouette with radial glow gradient and route lines
pecas.o_que_faz: Gives a plain country outline drama with one gradient and thin route lines, leaving the data card to carry the numbers.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: one country as a single shape, no internal borders (Peru, Colombia). Colour: radial gradient, royal blue centre to near-black navy edge. Overlays: thin blue-to-cyan polylines with small ring nodes for each transmission route; tiny legend of line swatches at bottom left; Python logo floating top left to flag analysis. Order: silhouette, routes, nodes, legend. Paired with a framed term-sheet card on the right. Page 18 uses a small variant.
pecas.serve_para: Single-project or single-country pages; repeatable project template.

pecas.nome: Dense route network with dashed cluster ellipses
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows a whole country's transmission network and uses thin dashed ellipses to group it into the areas that matter, with no labels on the map.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Peru as one shape, radial gradient from royal blue centre to near-black navy edge. Overlays: many thin cyan-to-white polylines with small ring nodes, voltage legend of line swatches at lower left, dark dashed ellipses drawn around 4 clusters, Python logo floating top left. Container: pale-blue gradient panel with a blue border, KPI row and two underlined plan headings on top. Order: panel, silhouette, lines, nodes, ellipses, legend.
pecas.serve_para: Grouping a dense network into regions.

pecas.nome: Map clipped by a card, with long rule labels
pecas.o_que_faz: Uses a cropped map as a backdrop for three business lines instead of as a data display.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: east half of Brazil in navy gradient, the rest hidden behind the white company card that sits in front. Overlays: white squiggle freeforms for lines. Labels: three bold-italic headings, each on a long navy rule starting at the map and ending in a small marker, with a grey sub-line underneath. Order: map, white lines, card in front, rules, labels.
pecas.serve_para: Company overview where the map is texture.

pecas.nome: Black-to-red cutout with dashed leaders to logo rows
pecas.o_que_faz: Assigns each concession to its state and reads like a table, because every leader ends in an aligned row.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: only the served coastal and southern states, cut out and enlarged. Colour: black-to-red gradient per state with white borders. Labels: right column of 7 rows, each a logo, share %, vertical rule, volume in mm/day; underlined column header 'Volume m3'. Leaders: black dashed elbow connectors from state to logo, staggered so they don't cross. Order: map, connectors, logos, numbers.
pecas.serve_para: Concessions, subsidiaries or brands by territory with a metric per row.

pecas.nome: Active states with dashed leaders to logos and a bracket
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows that local brands were kept by placing each logo beside its state.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Brazil by state; inactive states in 3-4 greys, active states navy. Labels: logos in a vertical right-hand column. Leaders: thin dashed horizontal lines from state to logo, then a dashed bracket from the column to the explanatory text. Order: map, leaders, logos, bracket.
pecas.serve_para: Multi-brand or acquisition strategies by region.

pecas.nome: Mini active-state map, reused as a template
pecas.o_que_faz: Marks where a company operates at a glance, and the same layout on the next page makes target and acquired company directly comparable.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Brazil by state, inactive greys, active navy, no labels. Sits in a light grey tile under a numbered heading with a navy rule. Page 9 repeats the layout with the acquired company's states.
pecas.serve_para: Paired company profiles in M&A decks.

pecas.nome: Silhouette on a 100% share bar with stems
pecas.o_que_faz: Connects a stacked share bar physically to the geography it splits.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Sao Paulo and Rio de Janeiro joined as one shape in a blue gradient with darker edge and soft shadow. Below: horizontal 100% bar, SP 72% and RJ 28%, in two blues. Overlays: thin vertical stems with a small foot rising from each segment into the map. Order: bar, stems, map. Labels live inside the bar, so the map stays clean.
pecas.serve_para: Regional allocation of a landbank or asset base.

pecas.nome: Per-state gradient with owner dot clusters and bleeding plates
pecas.o_que_faz: Compares two players' locations in metro clusters while KPIs and a table share the same space.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Brazil by state, navy in the north to mid blue in the south, white borders. Overlays: dark dots vs bright blue dots packed tightly at each metro; legend pair on top. Plates: three translucent pale-blue rectangles bleeding off the right edge over the map. Table: small framed region table overlapping lower left. Order: map, dots, table, plates.
pecas.serve_para: Peer footprint where KPIs must sit on the map.

pecas.nome: Tier choropleth and table in one tile, with dashed callout
pecas.o_que_faz: Pairs a regional map with its numbers and calls out the one concentration that matters.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Brazil by state in 4-5 blues, darkest in the Southeast. Container: pale-blue tile with thin border holding both the map and a borderless table. Callout: dashed elbow from SP/RJ to a small dashed box with the takeaway. Order: tile, map, table, callout.
pecas.serve_para: Market concentration by region.

pecas.nome: State filled with its own flag, plus dashed bracket
pecas.o_que_faz: Turns a small supporting stat into a memorable mark by filling the state with its flag.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Sao Paulo state as one shape. Fill: the actual state flag clipped to the shape (rebuild with a picture fill or Merge Shapes). Overlays: green dashed bracket from the sigma label to a dashed rounded note. Order: flag shape, bracket, note. This is a decorative choice and suits one small panel only.
pecas.serve_para: Small local-market panel.

pecas.nome: Three-tier choropleth with legend squares
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows service-centre density in three classes at very small size, without a label on the map.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Brazil by state, three brand tiers (dark green, mid green, pale yellow-green). Legend: a row of three squares with class ranges underneath. No leaders. Sits in a column between a dashed text box and a framed KPI list with diamond bullets.
pecas.serve_para: At-a-glance slides.

pecas.nome: Staggered street-map zoom pair with heat overlay on a folded panel
pecas.o_que_faz: Goes from metro to city in two overlapping maps, showing primary location data rather than a generic footprint.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: real road-map rasters, metro and city. Heat: Google API heat map, blue through green and yellow to red, generated in code and captured as an image. Overlays: star markers for rivals with a small legend; framed label boxes with a diamond-end rule pointing at each map; green dashed callout overlapping the corner. Container: pale grey panel with a chamfered 3D fold into a second panel with KPIs and a dark code screenshot with Python logo. Order: panel, metro raster, city raster offset down-right, stars, labels, callout.
pecas.serve_para: Proprietary spatial analysis of distribution density.

pecas.nome: Raster heatmap pair in a navy frame
pecas.o_que_faz: Presents the team's own distribution-centre analysis as a framed exhibit next to an executive quote.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: two road-map rasters (southeast South America, Mexico) with pale-blue sea. Heat: blue through green to red blobs. Overlays: red teardrop pins on key cities, dark grey label plates beside them. Container: navy rounded rectangle bleeding off the slide edge, with an italic white caption, short rule and white Python tile. Order: frame, rasters, heat, pins, plates, caption.
pecas.serve_para: Logistics coverage, especially with interviews.

pecas.nome: Street-map popup with pin legend on a trapezoid connector
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows local competition at street level as a zoom-in that sits on top of the dimmed parent slide.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: real neighbourhood street raster in a green dashed frame. Overlays: teardrop pins by chain (about 45 on p14 in four colours; p15 turns small drugstores black). Legend: green dashed box on the left with coloured pins and chain names in matching colour, joined to the map by a grey trapezoid with dashed green edges. Callout: dashed box at right on p15. Popup: parent slide copied and dimmed under a white shadowed card. Order: dimmed slide, card, connector, raster, pins, legend.
pecas.serve_para: Field research on local competition.

pecas.nome: Terrain tile on a plinth with dotted leaders into a chart
pecas.o_que_faz: Explains an operating conflict by physically linking places on a real map to the chart series below.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: real road and terrain raster of the reservoir system. Overlays: red and navy teardrop pins with bold place names, red dotted distance line labelled 9.32 km, small white note box on the map, pin legend row above. Container: grey panel with a trapezoid plinth narrowing down to a chart. Leaders: dotted blue lines from the pins to each series' legend entry. Order: panel, raster, pins, distance line, plinth, chart, leaders.
pecas.serve_para: Single-asset case studies.

pecas.nome: Phased rollout map with status chips and ranked bars
pecas.o_que_faz: Sequences market entry in one view, with phase on the map and the score ranking beside it in the same order.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: pale coast shape, sea white, in a rounded card, with italic region name, compass and scale bar. Overlays: magenta pin (entry), magenta dots (pilot), lilac dot (M&A), dark pin (second wave), dotted arc from first to last. Labels: bold city plus coloured status chip, set to the right of each point in a loose column. Beside it: numbered round badges and bars in matching colours, then a table. Order: card, basemap, arc, points, labels, ranking.
pecas.serve_para: Expansion roadmaps.

pecas.nome: Neighbourhood thumbnails with polygon and rent
pecas.o_que_faz: Backs the city choice with micro-location evidence, repeated as three uniform cards.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: pale street raster for each neighbourhood. Overlays: magenta pin and translucent pink polygon. Beside each: city chip, neighbourhood name, dotted rule, big R$ number per m2 per month. Three equal cards in a rounded container with a coloured heading.
pecas.serve_para: Micro-location or real-estate evidence.

pecas.nome: Five-region ramp with values outside in matching tint
pecas.o_que_faz: Labels regions with no leaders by colour-matching each number to its region.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Brazil in 5 regions, violet ramp, Northeast darkest, white borders. Labels: bold percentage placed just outside each region in that region's tint, even when the tint is pale. Caption in italics at top. Thin line runs from the map to the neighbouring panel.
pecas.serve_para: Regional split in a compact space.

pecas.nome: Pale map in a tinted tile with two-owner dots
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows the combined portfolio's plants by owner in a before/after table layout.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Brazil and neighbours in pale grey, no emphasis. Container: pale-green tile holding both map and table. Overlays: bright green vs black dots, legend box top left. Pre-Deal and Pro Forma tags on the boundary between map and table. Order: tile, map, dots, legend, table.
pecas.serve_para: Pro forma portfolio after a merger.

pecas.nome: Dot density with no outline
pecas.o_que_faz: Lets several thousand stations draw the country on their own.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: none drawn; the outline emerges from the points. Overlays: small dark-green dots for one network, pale dots for the other, legend box lower left; green-framed text and data cards overlap the empty east. Rebuild: scatter of lat/lon in code exported as transparent PNG or SVG.
pecas.serve_para: Very dense networks such as stations or stores.

pecas.nome: World crop bleeding off the slide with dashed selection box
pecas.o_que_faz: Points to the international assets being sold using a small, cut-off map rather than a full panel.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: world crop cut by the right edge of the slide. Colour: USA bright green, Brazil dark green, rest pale grey. Overlays: dashed green box running across the top of the map from the USA toward Europe, thin rule from the table to the box. Order: map, box, rule.
pecas.serve_para: Small supporting geography beside a table.

pecas.nome: Map breaking out of a card, with KPI strips over it
pecas.o_que_faz: Adds energy to an A + B = C layout by letting the map escape the card frame.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Brazil in grey with white state lines, overlapping the card's left edge and crossing the footer rule. Overlays: tiny markers for factories and distribution centres in two colours, legend box. KPI strips: pale translucent rows with big green numbers, overlapping the map's east side. Order: card, map, markers, strips.
pecas.serve_para: Merger result summaries.

pecas.nome: Municipal choropleth pair breaking out of a grey panel
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows two municipal variables stacked so the viewer sees the same places light up, ahead of the regression that proves it.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Sao Paulo state by municipality. Colour: about 8 blue classes plus pale grey for not operated. Container: grey panel with shadow; the map rises out of its top right. Inside the panel: small swatch legend and a bold insight sentence; Python badge at the corner. Stacked twice, with a regression scatter (R2 and p-value boxes) on p24 and a torn-paper news clip on p25. Municipal shapes need GeoJSON and code or a filled-map chart, exported as SVG for editing.
pecas.serve_para: Proving a geographic correlation.

pecas.nome: Adjacency-tier municipal map
pecas.o_que_faz: Maps network proximity, in tiers by how many municipalities away each one is, to argue the expansion is contiguous.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Sao Paulo state by municipality. Colour: navy for the existing network, cyan shades by distance from it, grey for others. Same panel breakout as the municipal pair, with a swatch legend and a bold sentence.
pecas.serve_para: Adjacent expansion theses.

pecas.nome: Municipal footprint with corner chips
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows a concession footprint at municipal detail with two headline numbers tucked into the empty corners.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Sao Paulo state by municipality; served in bright cyan, unserved in grey. Container: grey card with a dark right and bottom bar. Overlays: two cyan rounded chips (375 cities, 58% coverage) at the lower corners.
pecas.serve_para: At-a-glance for regional concessions.

pecas.nome: Map, grey wedge and bold state letter into block bars
pecas.o_que_faz: Moves from national concession blocks into the blocks inside one state.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Brazil by state, cyan to navy, small vertical gradient legend. Connector: cyan dashed line from a framed text box to the map. Wedge: grey shape opening right from Sao Paulo, carrying a large bold 'SP'. Panel: horizontal bars by block with a cyan 'Unified' bracket. Order: panel, wedge, map, letter, bars.
pecas.serve_para: Regulatory or regional drill-downs.

pecas.nome: Income contour map with sized pins
pecas.o_que_faz: Overlays bank branches on income to show visually who the branches ignore.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Mexico City with smoothed contours rather than administrative lines. Colour: lilac to deep purple. Overlays: black teardrop pins in 4 sizes by branch concentration; stacked pin-size legend; horizontal gradient bar 'Income level' with 5 ticks. Dark code card with lilac Python tile overlapping top right. Order: contours, pins, legends, code card. Contours need code output or GIS, inserted as an image; pins can stay native.
pecas.serve_para: Demand-vs-supply white space.

pecas.nome: Staircase chips on hairline leaders
pecas.o_que_faz: Places each country's metrics in steps down the slide that follow the geography from Mexico to Brazil.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Latin America, three active countries purple, rest pale grey, no borders emphasised. Labels: lilac rounded chips with 23'/25' and dark purple value pills, each moved down and right to match its country. Leaders: thin grey horizontal lines from country to chip. Flag-and-pill 'Deposits' card below. Order: map, leaders, chips, card.
pecas.serve_para: Few-country metrics over time.

pecas.nome: Screening cards with flag and magnifier on hairline leaders
pecas.o_que_faz: Explains why each market was rejected with a mini-card anchored directly on the country.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Latin America, screened countries purple, rest grey. Cards: rounded pale grey, circular flag, name, magnifier icon, two friction lines with purple keywords. Leaders: thin grey straight lines. Cards sit in the Pacific and Atlantic, so nothing covers land. Filter pills top right.
pecas.serve_para: Market screening.

pecas.nome: Map in a rounded panel with flag legend
pecas.o_que_faz: A clean supporting map where flags replace both legend and labels.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Latin America, active countries purple, rest pale grey. Container: huge rounded pale-grey panel bleeding right. Legend: flag rectangle and ~% rows at top right, in the empty Atlantic.
pecas.serve_para: Share by country beside a main chart.

pecas.nome: Map at the base of a tabbed summary card
pecas.o_que_faz: Fills the lower half of a text card with geography so the text block looks finished.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Latin America, active countries purple, rest pale grey, no labels. Container: lilac card with rounded bottom, purple title tab with folded corners. Order: card, text, map.
pecas.serve_para: At-a-glance slides.

pecas.nome: Ring-percent circles straddling the coast
pecas.o_que_faz: Reads revenue share per country at once using oversized numbers placed just off the land.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Latin America; Brazil near-black navy, Mexico and Argentina mid blues, rest pale lilac. Labels: white circles with black ring carrying the %, sitting on each country's coast. Grey text plate with a left rule and notch runs behind the southern cone. Order: plate, map, circles.
pecas.serve_para: Revenue by geography.

pecas.nome: Gold-halo bubbles on a grey world
pecas.o_que_faz: Puts a regional figure (revenue share on pp. 11 and 15, growth on p. 8) on a world map while staying inside a luxury palette of grey and gold.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: world in flat mid grey on off-white, no borders. Bubbles: dark grey circle sized by share, soft gold glow ring (Glow effect, about 8 pt), white % inside; very small values become a dot in a ring (p8). Labels: bold caps region under each bubble on p15, none on p11. Section header with rule above. Stacked twice on p15 for two brands. Print the % inside every bubble, because the size alone is hard to read.
pecas.serve_para: Regional revenue mix.

pecas.nome: Mini-map coin selector
pecas.o_que_faz: Uses mini-maps as tabs: the active cluster stays in full colour and the others fade, so a repeated page shows where you are.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Brazil by state inside a circle. Active: dark-green circle, pale map, active state bright green, solid arrow to bold cluster name. Inactive: pale sage circle, near-white map, pale arrow and faded label. Build all three, then swap the active style per page. Order: circle, map, highlight, arrow, label.
pecas.serve_para: Repeating a template across clusters, regions or projects.

pecas.nome: Pills colour-keyed to states, no leaders
pecas.o_que_faz: Avoids all leader clutter by making the colour of the pill the only link to the state.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Brazil by state in greys, 3 cluster areas in navy, green, dark teal. Labels: stacked rounded pills to the right, same colours, white text. Container: grey card with dark top rule and right shadow bar.
pecas.serve_para: At-a-glance with up to about 4 categories.

pecas.nome: Diamond markers with overlapping dark plates
pecas.o_que_faz: Attaches a compact mini-profile directly to each country, keeping it on the map instead of in a side table.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: South America; Brazil strong teal-blue, other countries pale blue tints or grey. Overlays: navy diamond on the country's coast, dark grey plate overlapping the land, white title, cyan subtitle. Plain sentence set beneath each plate on the white space. Order: map, plate, diamond in front.
pecas.serve_para: International entries with a date or licence.

pecas.nome: Portrait leaders into a map
pecas.o_que_faz: Credits primary research geographically by running a line from each interviewee's face to their country.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Latin America; operating countries near-black navy, Brazil mid blue, rest grey. Left: circular portrait, name, role, italic date. Leaders: thin black line from a small diamond above the name straight to the country. Right: dark grey quote boxes with cyan emphasis. Order: map, leaders, portraits, text.
pecas.serve_para: Interview evidence by geography.

pecas.nome: Flow arrows out of a highlighted country
pecas.o_que_faz: Signals planned expansion with hand-drawn looking arrows, showing direction rather than data.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Latin America by country in grey with white lines, Brazil solid yellow. Overlays: four black curved arrows from inside Brazil outward (Curved Connector or Scribble, with arrowhead); mascot icon on Brazil; thin grey elbow to a dashed box with chevron bullets; italic grey caption over the map. Order: map, highlight, arrows, icon, callout.
pecas.serve_para: Geographic expansion plans.

pecas.nome: Coverage circles over a municipal silhouette
pecas.o_que_faz: Documents field coverage with translucent circles beside the numbers and photos that prove the visits.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: one flat grey municipal shape, no internal lines. Overlays: 8 yellow circles at about 50-60% transparency in varied sizes, which get stronger where they overlap. Paired with a dashed-rule band of huge yellow numbers (27, 10+) and a store photo collage.
pecas.serve_para: Primary-research coverage.

pecas.nome: Flat world fill with soft shadow
pecas.o_que_faz: Answers one question ('where?') at near full slide with no labels.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: world by country, no ocean. Colour: brand yellow vs white with hairline. Effect: soft grey outer shadow on the whole map group gives slight lift. Rebuild with a single SVG of country shapes.
pecas.serve_para: Appendix or ESG pages.

pecas.nome: World highlight with no labels
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows platform presence in a small panel under an interview.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: world by country; yellow active on mid-grey with white lines. Small italic caption above. No legend or labels.
pecas.serve_para: Footprint in a secondary panel.

pecas.nome: Mini world in a framed card
pecas.o_que_faz: Fills one of three at-a-glance cards with a yellow-grey world above a volume area chart.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: world by country, yellow vs grey. Container: pale grey card with yellow top and bottom rule and a centred title on a dashed underline.
pecas.serve_para: At-a-glance slides.

pecas.nome: Code card beside a dot map
pecas.o_que_faz: Proves the data is self-collected by placing the Python script next to the plotted result.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: country by state or province in pale blue-grey with white lines (USA with Alaska and Hawaii insets; India). Overlays: orange dots, hundreds on p124 and about 20 larger ones on p125. Left: dark rounded code screenshot with syntax colours. Order: code card, base map, dots. Export the dots from code as a transparent image above a native map.
pecas.serve_para: Appendix evidence of proprietary data work.

pecas.nome: World score choropleth with hatched exclusion and overlapping criteria card
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows a proprietary score worldwide, and hatching keeps the home market clearly out of the ranking rather than scored low.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: world by country. Colour: white through pink to deep red; grey for unscored; diagonal hatch (Pattern Fill) for North America. Legend: horizontal gradient bar Low-Medium-High with caption. Overlay: white rounded shadowed card with red square tiles numbered in roman numerals and a Python logo, covering the empty Pacific and part of North America. Order: map, hatch, legend, card.
pecas.serve_para: Market prioritisation scoring.

pecas.nome: Stacked before/after dot maps beside stat cards
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows store growth over time through density alone, with the number on the card and the pattern on the map.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: USA by state in very faint grey lines. Overlays: thousands of tiny dark-red dots, exported from code. Cards: white rounded shadowed cards on the left with a red year and red counts, touching the map's west side; grey double chevron between the two rows. Order: map, dots, card.
pecas.serve_para: Unit growth over time.

pecas.nome: Faint province map with proportional dots under a KPI card
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows white-space cities as a screening result, with the filter outcome stated in a strip above.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Canada by province, faint outline only. Overlays: red circles of varying size along the populated south (the slide does not state the sizing variable). Card: white rounded shadow strip with 3 red KPI tiles and double chevrons, overlapping the top of the map, where there is no data. Above it: red question banner with Python badge and numbered criteria.
pecas.serve_para: City-level white-space screens.

pecas.nome: Greyscale class map with dark table panel
pecas.o_que_faz: A sober accent-free map for backup data, where the dark table bleeding off the slide provides the weight.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Brazil by state in 5 greys, top class (SP and RJ) black. Legend: dashed box at lower left in the empty Pacific side, 5 swatches. Right: dark charcoal panel bleeding off the edge holding a white-lined table and totals. Order: map, legend, panel.
pecas.serve_para: Appendix and data-heavy pages.

pecas.nome: Translucent proportional city circles
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows reach by city in a small card, with overlaps naturally darkening the dense Southeast.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Brazil white with hairline state outlines. Overlays: pink circles at about 50% transparency sized by value. Card 02 of three numbered cards; pink KPIs under. On pp. 4-6 the same slide reveals one card at a time.
pecas.serve_para: Reach or penetration by city.

pecas.nome: Brand-colour world with stacked numbers
pecas.o_que_faz: Gives a simple presence map character by placing three big numbers and the logo in empty ocean.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: world by country, orange active with thin borders, white land with thin dark outline. Labels: number-plus-word stack (44, 19, 9) at lower left; logo at lower right. No legend.
pecas.serve_para: Acquired-company or international presence.

pecas.nome: Single-diagonal gradient corridor cutout
pecas.o_que_faz: Cuts the country down to only the states of the rail corridor, so the map becomes the shape of the argument.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: only the corridor states, enlarged. Colour: dark red to near black. Overlays: white dashed rail freeform, red dots with dark ring, legend top left, red KPI text beside it. Tab bar with dashed active frame above.
pecas.serve_para: Regional infrastructure next to a valuation table.

pecas.nome: Corridor zoom with thick brand-colour rail and dashed stems
pecas.o_que_faz: Lets the subject company's own yellow take over the slide on a blue state cutout.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: southeastern states, active blue gradient, neighbours grey. Overlays: thick bright-yellow rail lines. Labels: three stacked corridor blocks (name in olive-yellow, characteristics, impact), joined to the rail by dashed grey vertical stems. Order: states, rail, stems, labels.
pecas.serve_para: Single-asset profiles in the asset's own branding.

pecas.nome: Operating-states-only cutout with elbow labels
pecas.o_que_faz: Omits every irrelevant state so the shape itself says where the company operates.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: only operating states, navy, white borders, others absent. Overlays: blue dots with white ring. Labels: bold-italic blue plant name plus 2 spec lines with thin grey elbow leaders, all placed in the white space where the missing states would be.
pecas.serve_para: Industrial footprint with plant specs.

pecas.nome: Full-bleed gradient band with highlighted countries
pecas.o_que_faz: Stages a regional map on a band that runs off the slide, with the two non-core countries bright against dark.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Europe by country, navy gradient; Germany bright blue, Portugal mid blue. Container: pale-blue horizontal gradient band from the slide's left edge, with blue rule at bottom. Labels: plant name on a rule, blue capacity below, placed in the Atlantic and above.
pecas.serve_para: Non-core or target assets abroad.

pecas.nome: Framed tile with asset-type dots and internal text
pecas.o_que_faz: Combines map, legend and short explanatory lists in one framed exhibit above a production-chain strip.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: Brazil grey with white state lines, neighbours white with thin outline. Container: pale-blue gradient tile with navy left and bottom edge. Overlays: 3 dot types by asset type; legend box top right; two pale text panels in the Atlantic. Beneath: 3 chain boxes linked by pale bands.
pecas.serve_para: Asset base with a process explanation.

pecas.nome: Grey world with per-country red gradient beside a treemap
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows global footprint in a small panel, matching the reds of the adjacent regional treemap.
pecas.como_montar: Geography: world grey, active countries with a black-to-red gradient per shape. No labels. Treemap beside it uses the same reds.
pecas.serve_para: At-a-glance for global companies.

pecas.nome: Aerial photo pair (reference, not a map)
pecas.o_que_faz: Compares two sites from above with captioned satellite-style images, the closest thing to a satellite map in the corpus.
pecas.como_montar: Two equal images side by side with a coloured title and grey caption beneath. Needs real imagery.
pecas.serve_para: Site-level comparisons.

pecas.nome: Before/Now gradient tiles over conversion rows
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows a model shift as two gradient tiles of what the product covered, above rows that convert each old term into its new one.
pecas.como_montar: Two equal dark-to-teal gradient rectangles titled Antes/Hoje with diamond-bullet lists; below, two icon headers and two rows of hard-shadow outlined chips joined by short arrows (Licenciamento to SaaS, Infraestrutura to PaaS).
pecas.serve_para: Business model transitions, on-prem to cloud, licence to subscription.

pecas.nome: Acronym spoke hub around a pictogram
pecas.o_que_faz: Defines a product suite by putting the buyer in the middle and eight acronyms on thin spokes around it.
pecas.como_montar: Central building pictogram; eight bold 18pt acronyms in a circle with a one-line grey gloss under each; hairline spokes stop short of both the picture and the label; no boxes at all.
pecas.serve_para: Module maps, product portfolio, segments served by one platform.

pecas.nome: Core and Near Core twin rings with fanned product notes
pecas.o_que_faz: Sorts products into two tiers by giving each tier a ringed object with fan lines out to its products on both sides.
pecas.como_montar: Two rings stacked vertically, each with a cube icon and a label above (Core, Near Core); from each ring, two or four thin angled lines fan left and right to small text blocks with a green product title.
pecas.serve_para: Core versus adjacent portfolio, business lines with different maturity.

pecas.nome: Count beads on a year rail
pecas.o_que_faz: Turns an M&A plan into a rail of circled deal counts with years alternating above and below.
pecas.como_montar: Horizontal hairline running off the slide edge; five equal grey outlined circles with a large digit; year labels in bold teal alternate above and below the beads.
pecas.serve_para: Planned deals per year, roll-out counts, store openings by year.

pecas.nome: Tinted pentagon summary field pointing into rationale
pecas.o_que_faz: Splits a one-page investment summary into a tinted facts zone whose right edge points at the white reasoning zone.
pecas.como_montar: Pale pink freeform covers the left 60 percent and ends in a shallow chevron nose; facts and thesis sit centred on it, while Entry, Exit and Risks sit on white to the right as diamond-bulleted rows of small cards.
pecas.serve_para: Investment summary, one-page memo, IC-style overview.

pecas.nome: Diamond return rail from IRR to MOIC
pecas.o_que_faz: Draws the holding period as a vertical line whose two ends carry the two return numbers.
pecas.como_montar: Thin vertical magenta line with a diamond at each end; IRR above the top diamond, MOIC under the bottom one, and 'In 6 years' interrupting the line at mid-height.
pecas.serve_para: Return summary for a private deal or a holding-period thesis.

pecas.nome: Capsule columns with icon disc and logo stack
pecas.o_que_faz: Presents portfolio segments as tall rounded capsules where the stacked brands under each label prove the claim.
pecas.como_montar: Five tall stadium outlines in tints of the brand colour; a filled icon disc sits at the top of each, then a bold label, a small italic descriptor, a short rule and three or four monochrome logos stacked in the lower half.
pecas.serve_para: Brand portfolios, segment architecture, ecosystem of products.

pecas.nome: Option chain with fading pills and cards
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows staged real options left to right with colour strength falling as each option gets more conditional.
pecas.como_montar: Row of four pills (Now, If X validates, Separate option) over four rounded outline cards with a filled value chip at the base; the fill goes magenta, tint, teal, grey to encode rising conditionality.
pecas.serve_para: Expansion plans, staged capex, optionality slices of value.

pecas.nome: J-curve with asset illustration pinned at breakeven
pecas.o_que_faz: Annotates the cash curve with its trough and payoff and parks a picture of the asset where it crosses zero.
pecas.como_montar: Dotted line with round markers over a thin zero axis; rounded tinted callouts for Max risk and Upside on hook leaders; a vertical bar flag marks the payback year; an isometric building overlaps the curve on the right.
pecas.serve_para: Single-project payback, new-unit economics, greenfield capex.

pecas.nome: Numbered chain header driving one row per step
pecas.o_que_faz: Uses a thin numbered chain as a header and hangs one sentence and one logo set from each step.
pecas.como_montar: Four small dashed numbered tiles on a dashed line with step names under them; below, four outlined rows numbered 1 to 4, each with a sentence on the left and an icon or logo cell on the right.
pecas.serve_para: Supply chain with players at each stage.

pecas.nome: KPI bubble cluster with loose droplets
pecas.o_que_faz: Replaces a KPI row with a loose cluster of soft circles of different sizes, with small empty droplets as texture.
pecas.como_montar: Three or four pale green circles of varied size holding a number and caption, overlapping nothing; six to ten small empty circles of the same tint scattered around them in free positions.
pecas.serve_para: Footprint or scale KPIs where a table would feel flat.

pecas.nome: Slanted two-tone How-it-works band
pecas.o_que_faz: Divides a mechanism note from its assumptions with a band whose fill ends on a diagonal.
pecas.como_montar: Full-width thin band; left 55 percent in mint, ending in a slanted edge, with bold question and two lines; right part pale grey with a dashed vertical and italic assumptions.
pecas.serve_para: Mechanism plus assumptions under a structure diagram.

pecas.nome: Staged deal columns closing on a final structure panel
pecas.o_que_faz: Summarises a multi-step transaction as bordered columns with big stats, chevrons between them and the end-state org chart as the last panel.
pecas.como_montar: On dark, three neon-green-outlined columns each holding two numbered steps with a large stat per step, and thin chevrons in the gutters; a fourth wider column holds the final structure chart; assumptions run in a footer.
pecas.serve_para: Transaction summary, multi-stage deal or restructuring recap.

pecas.nome: Logo treemap zoomed out from a sliver into a second treemap
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows the dominant player's treemap, then opens its tiny remainder into a second treemap of the niche.
pecas.como_montar: Left treemap with one giant tile filled with a ghosted logo; the narrow right tiles are joined by a grey trapezoid wall to a second treemap, whose tiles use full logos as the only labels; tile colours step from dark to light.
pecas.serve_para: Market share where the niche is invisible beside the incumbent.

pecas.nome: Stepped lifecycle silhouette with numbered phase key
pecas.o_que_faz: Draws an asset's cash profile as a blocky silhouette split by who owns each phase, keyed to numbered tiles.
pecas.como_montar: Stepped polygon around a cash-flow axis, with phase digits inside each block and two colours for the two owners; headers 'Incumbent focus' and 'Niche focus' above; a 2-by-3 grid of dark rounded tiles lists the numbered phase names.
pecas.serve_para: Asset lifecycle, where the company plays in the life of a well, plant or product.

pecas.nome: Spine timeline with alternating notched banners
pecas.o_que_faz: Tells a financing history down a vertical spine with date banners flagging out to alternating sides.
pecas.como_montar: Dark vertical line in a pale grey panel; dark, then one light, swallowtail banners holding the date, leaving the line left or right; bold amount and label beneath each banner; a tinted header pill sits on the panel top.
pecas.serve_para: Debt raises, M&A history, funding rounds.

pecas.nome: Numbered badges on radar vertices keyed to a list
pecas.o_que_faz: Removes axis labels from a radar and uses numbered badges at the vertices that map to a scored list.
pecas.como_montar: Hairline concentric pentagons with a single coloured polygon; dark pentagon badges with a white digit float outside each vertex; the right panel repeats the same badges beside a bold force name with its score and a short paragraph.
pecas.serve_para: Porter forces, scorecards with long criterion text.

pecas.nome: KPI satellite dots on a faint orbit
pecas.o_que_faz: Places claims as solid dots on a barely visible ring around the logo, each with a short caps label.
pecas.como_montar: Pale grey central disc with logo; very pale wide ring around it; five solid brand-colour dots on the ring with caps text outside; on the left, a large coloured name is linked to the disc by a hook line.
pecas.serve_para: Product-at-a-glance, attributes of one business unit.

pecas.nome: Nested TAM circles with tabbed leaders
pecas.o_que_faz: Nests the addressable market inside the total with circles tangent at the base, each tied to a side label.
pecas.como_montar: Two circles sharing a bottom tangent in pale and stronger yellow, value inside each near its top; horizontal leaders run to labels with a short vertical colour tab.
pecas.serve_para: TAM and SAM with a large size gap.

pecas.nome: Off-page progress arcs keyed to a numbered list
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows several progress scores as concentric partial arcs bleeding off the left edge, one per list item.
pecas.como_montar: Four concentric thick arcs cut by the slide's left margin, grey track with a yellow portion of different length; to the right, large thin numerals 01 to 04 with one line each.
pecas.serve_para: Improvement areas, scorecards of initiatives.

pecas.nome: Phase columns over a benefit area and effort curve
pecas.o_que_faz: Aligns four programme phases to a rising benefit area and a falling effort line, with the actions under each phase.
pecas.como_montar: Four dark header boxes spanning the width with a double arrow and duration under each; one yellow freeform area climbing across them with an S-curved black line crossing it and a triangular kickoff marker; bullets in columns aligned below.
pecas.serve_para: Transformation programmes, roadmaps with a value build-up.

pecas.nome: Long chain above short chain to show disintermediation
pecas.o_que_faz: Stacks the traditional and direct chains on the same icon grid, so the missing steps show as empty space.
pecas.como_montar: Grey panel; upper row of six line icons with chevrons, lower row of three icons spaced across the same width with chevrons; italic row labels and a two-line note beneath each row.
pecas.serve_para: Channel disruption, removal of middlemen, direct versus indirect routes.

pecas.nome: Acrostic drop-letter pillar cards
pecas.o_que_faz: Makes three tall cards spell the framework through an oversized first letter in a contrasting colour.
pecas.como_montar: Three full-height solid-colour cards with a line icon centred on top; heading with its first letter at 1.5 times size in dark, rest in white; chevron-bulleted list below.
pecas.serve_para: ESG, or any framework named by an acronym.

pecas.nome: Twin vertical chains with check and cross verdict rows
pecas.o_que_faz: Compares two companies by running the same three-link chain side by side, with each link's consequence as a green check or a red cross row.
pecas.como_montar: Each side has a logo plus a short incentive note, then three hard-shadow icon tiles stacked with arrows; to the right of each tile, a pale green row with a ringed check or a pale red row with a ringed cross; one chain uses double arrows, the other a broken elbow line.
pecas.serve_para: Why an incentive or model works for one player and fails for its rival.

pecas.nome: Logo pentagon constellation around a business unit
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows what a unit contains by setting product logos on the corners of an outlined pentagon that names the unit in the middle.
pecas.como_montar: Thin blue pentagon outline with caps text in the centre; a logo at each vertex, knocked over the line with the panel colour; above it, an old logo arrows into the new one to record the rebrand.
pecas.serve_para: Group brands, digital unit composition, sub-brands of a holding.

pecas.nome: Two-tone arc arrows as a two-engine flywheel
pecas.o_que_faz: Draws mutual reinforcement as two huge opposed arc arrows, each owned by one business, around the company logo.
pecas.como_montar: Two thick block-arc arrows, medium and dark, forming a full ring around a white logo disc with a hairline inner circle; a rectangular name tag sits on the left and right of the ring; four text blocks at the diagonals connect through hairlines with diamond ends.
pecas.serve_para: Synergy between two segments, reinforcing loops with two engines.

pecas.nome: Triangle-pointer process axis
pecas.o_que_faz: Hangs step captions over a line with grey downward triangles ending in dots, closing on a bold result statement.
pecas.como_montar: Pale grey strip; hairline axis with three solid dots; a short grey triangle drops from each caption to its dot, with the middle dot in dark colour; the last column is a bold conclusion and has no pointer.
pecas.serve_para: Customer journey or mechanism summary under a diagram.

pecas.nome: Mirror spines under a shared question bar
pecas.o_que_faz: Sets two parties' benefits in mirrored columns with text aligned toward outer ring-bulleted spines.
pecas.como_montar: Grey bar across the slide with a central question and a dark tab at each end naming the side; two vertical spine lines at the far left and far right; three thick ring bullets per spine; left text ragged right of its spine, right text right-aligned to its spine.
pecas.serve_para: Two-sided value exchange, partnerships, platform with two user groups.

pecas.nome: Serpentine era timeline with diamonds
pecas.o_que_faz: Folds a timeline back on itself in one U-turn, so a long history stays large in half a slide.
pecas.como_montar: One thick line going left to right, then a round U-turn to run right to left, ending in an arrowhead on the last date; outlined diamonds at each era with a large pale decade label and two-colour caption; the line fades from pale at the start to saturated at the end.
pecas.serve_para: Industry history, eras next to a structural diagram.

pecas.nome: Service stack with fee arrows to two clients
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows a two-sided business as a vertical product stack with paired flow arrows out to the two customer groups.
pecas.como_montar: Five stacked rows in shades of one blue under a dark header, framed in dark; to the right, paired arrows pointing opposite ways with service above and fee below in blue; each pair ends in an outlined pale green tile with a big icon and label.
pecas.serve_para: How a bank or intermediary earns from each side.

pecas.nome: Stake chips into target logo with board list attached
pecas.o_que_faz: Combines ownership and control by hanging the target's board from the same diagram as its shareholders.
pecas.como_montar: Three logos or grey tags in a row with small italic percent chips on the wires dropping to a large target logo; underneath, a pale panel split by a vertical rule with 'nominated by' at left and director names at right; a double-slash mark breaks the connector.
pecas.serve_para: Joint ventures, minority stakes where board control matters.

pecas.nome: Vertical value chain rail with icon and callout cards
pecas.o_que_faz: Runs a value chain down a tinted side rail, so it can sit next to charts without taking their width.
pecas.como_montar: Pale blue vertical panel with a header tab; three steps alternate a line icon and a small blue-outlined text box, joined by thin elbows; the rail closes with a dark conclusion box.
pecas.serve_para: Sector primers that need a chain and charts on one page.

pecas.nome: Wire globe with leaders to tiered activity rows
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows a conglomerate as one network sphere, with three leader lines from its surface to labelled business rows.
pecas.como_montar: Wireframe sphere built from lines and dots in the dark brand colour, cut by the left card; three straight leaders from three nodes pass a small bold segment label and end in a solid dot beside a one-line role description.
pecas.serve_para: Group overview, holding segments, integrated businesses.

pecas.nome: Step columns hanging from a ticked rail
pecas.o_que_faz: Sets out a multi-step plan as a full-width rail crossed by short ticks, each dropping a column with rationale chips and bottom KPIs.
pecas.como_montar: A thin line crosses the slide; a cross tick marks each of four columns with 'Nth Step' beside it; each column is a faint outlined panel with an italic title, two dashed chips and three stacked KPI lines. Reused later with three columns dimmed.
pecas.serve_para: Action plans, deleveraging, multi-step recommendations.

pecas.nome: Event timeline stacked over analog-case bars
pecas.o_que_faz: Pairs the current case's dated events with a bar set of prior cases to answer how long this usually takes.
pecas.como_montar: Upper band: arrowed axis with small tan ring nodes and arrow-capped stems alternating up and down to centred captions. Lower band: under a caps header and rule, four grey bars with brand and year labels, closed by a dashed vertical and a pale tan note.
pecas.serve_para: Turnarounds, recoveries, base-rate arguments.

pecas.nome: Segmented C-wheel with icon wedges around a title disc
pecas.o_que_faz: Holds a culture statement in a ringed disc while a graded sweep of wedges counts the episodes told in the dark list beside it.
pecas.como_montar: Thick grey ring with an italic title inside; around its right side, four ring segments going from grey to saturated red, each with a line icon; the dark panel to the right has numbered red 01-04 stories.
pecas.serve_para: Track record, episodes of execution, milestones without dates.

pecas.nome: SWOT cards with corner sashes around a quartered ring
pecas.o_que_faz: Sets four grey cards around a logo ring, with the quadrant name as a diagonal sash on each outer corner.
pecas.como_montar: Four pale grey cards with centred text and a gap between them; a thick quartered ring with the logo overlaps the inner corners, with red, pink and grey segments; each card has a diagonal 45-degree ribbon on the outer corner in its quadrant's colour, grey for threats.
pecas.serve_para: SWOT, two-by-two lists with a clear good and bad reading.

pecas.nome: Deadline columns ending in a darkening slanted band
pecas.o_que_faz: Lays dated obligations in columns whose feet merge into one band that darkens with time and rises in steps.
pecas.como_montar: Six grey-topped cards with a bold date and two short notes; below, one continuous row of colour blocks going from pale to navy, each with a white headline and a slanted top edge so the row climbs to the right.
pecas.serve_para: Concession milestones, covenants, regulatory calendars.

pecas.nome: Illustrated process chain with a risk row beneath
pecas.o_que_faz: Draws each stage as a small 3D plant illustration in an arrowed chain, with a matched row of what can go wrong under each.
pecas.como_montar: Seven same-angle isometric illustrations with thin arrows between them; a bold step name under each; below, two rows of short coloured risk labels with an icon bullet at the left, aligned to the same columns.
pecas.serve_para: Operational chains where each stage has its own risk or cost.

pecas.nome: Sorted bars with colour break and dashed average brackets
pecas.o_que_faz: Turns a cost curve into an argument by changing bar colour at the break point and pinning each zone's average on a dashed bracket.
pecas.como_montar: Ascending columns per percentile: grey to the break, then cyan deepening to navy; dashed elbow brackets rise from the zone edges to outlined average chips at different heights; a pale tinted note with a side rule fills the empty upper left.
pecas.serve_para: Marginal cost, cost curves, cohort or asset ranking.

pecas.nome: Age pyramids as paired solid vase silhouettes
pecas.o_que_faz: Reduces two population pyramids to solid same-colour shapes, so the eye compares the silhouette and not the bars.
pecas.como_montar: Back-to-back age bars with no gap and no axis, in a single green, with stepped ends left visible; two side by side labelled by year, with age bands listed only at the left of each.
pecas.serve_para: Demographic shift, any distribution whose shape changed.

pecas.nome: Group capsules linked by a dashed elbow with a multiple
pecas.o_que_faz: Rings the top and bottom groups of a bar chart and links them with a dashed elbow labelled with the multiple.
pecas.como_montar: Horizontal bars in a green-outlined panel; two rounded dashed tinted capsules around the chosen rows; dashed elbow from upper capsule, down the right side and back with an arrowhead to the lower; bold '4x more!' knocks through the line.
pecas.serve_para: Top versus bottom cohort spending, concentration.

pecas.nome: Profit pool Marimekko with share as width
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows who earns the sector's profit, with spread as height and market share as width around a zero line.
pecas.como_montar: Adjacent blocks along a zero axis: width is share and height is spread; the leader is a long thin green block above zero, the others hang below in sky and navy with heavy widths; value labels sit in tinted chips on the block edge.
pecas.serve_para: Profit pools, value capture across players.

pecas.nome: Charts as operands in a visual equation
pecas.o_que_faz: Writes DuPont literally by placing whole charts as terms with large operators between them.
pecas.como_montar: Grey band with a folded green tab title; three charts in a row with the same bar style and label pills; big black X and = sit in the gutters between the plots; the last term is a line chart in the result colour.
pecas.serve_para: ROIC or ROE decomposition, any product of drivers over time.

pecas.nome: Bevelled vertical WACC column with stacked operators
pecas.o_que_faz: Writes a whole formula down one narrow column, so the term values read like a table and leave the page width to charts.
pecas.como_montar: Pale panel with a green bevel top and thick green base; centred large coloured result, then alternating '=', 'X', '+' lines with bold term and value below each.
pecas.serve_para: WACC, cost of capital, any multi-term formula beside a build-up chart.

pecas.nome: Floating block build-ups for cost of capital
pecas.o_que_faz: Builds a rate through solid bricks that float at their running level, with no connector lines, axes or gridlines.
pecas.como_montar: Wide flat blocks with a dark-green rim and hard side shadow, placed at cumulative height; a negative term is a small dark block near the top; value inside the block top and name under the baseline.
pecas.serve_para: Cost of debt or equity build-up, short bridges.

pecas.nome: Value box branching through a dashed bracket
pecas.o_que_faz: Breaks one big market size into its segments using a dashed box and a dashed comb bracket without any boxes on the leaves.
pecas.como_montar: Dashed rectangle with a value in large blue; short dashed line to a dashed vertical; four dashed horizontals to plain text labels.
pecas.serve_para: TAM composition, small breakdown in an overview card.

pecas.nome: Before and after circles with growth text in the gap
pecas.o_que_faz: Compares two years by size alone, with the delta as words between the two circles.
pecas.como_montar: Two circles with year above in black: smaller navy, larger teal; value inside each in white; bold '+500 Million' centred in the gap; hairlines tangent to both circles form an open cone, with no arrow.
pecas.serve_para: Population or market size, one-glance growth.

pecas.nome: Dashed valuation frame with breakout header and result plates
pecas.o_que_faz: Holds the EV-to-equity bridge in a dashed frame, with the header and target price plates breaking the frame's top and bottom edges.
pecas.como_montar: Pale grey panel with a tinted corner tab; inside, a dashed rectangle; dark navy plate overlaps its top edge, teal plate overlaps its bottom edge; centred lines with a hairline before the total.
pecas.serve_para: Valuation result next to sensitivity tables.

pecas.nome: Numbered market columns with tangent-linked circles
pecas.o_que_faz: Compares three addressable markets by growing a circle across three cards, with fine tangent lines joining the circles.
