pecas.como_montar: Three grey rounded column cards with numbered red discs and bold titles; a solid red circle of increasing size in the same row, hairlines joining their tops and bottoms across the gutter; a red label chip at each foot holds the company share.
pecas.serve_para: TAM by geography with the company's share at each level.

pecas.nome: Lit driver tree with crosses between siblings
pecas.o_que_faz: Breaks revenue into drivers and colours only the branch the slide discusses, repeating the tree as a locator.
pecas.como_montar: Red top plate with elbow connectors to two rectangles and a light X between them; a further level beneath; active boxes in red, inactive in grey with faded X; rounded corners and italic labels; reused on later slides with a different branch lit.
pecas.serve_para: KPI trees, SSS decomposition, section locator.

pecas.nome: Offset year staircase of paired actual and consensus bars
pecas.o_que_faz: Stacks each year's actual and consensus as paired right-anchored bars, so the years step down like stairs.
pecas.como_montar: Paired horizontal bars, navy over yellow, all ending at the right axis; each lower year is shorter, producing a staircase on the left edge; year labels at far right and a dashed italic takeaway in the empty lower left.
pecas.serve_para: Beats versus consensus, plan versus realised.

pecas.nome: Wave labels inside stacked area bands
pecas.o_que_faz: Names each layer of a stacked area as a wave in plain words on the band, so the reader does not need the legend.
pecas.como_montar: Three stacked area layers in black, navy and yellow on a grey card with a hard right wall; '1st wave', '2nd wave', '3rd wave' placed by hand at the right end of each band, at the height where it thickens.
pecas.serve_para: Technology adoption waves, successive revenue layers.

pecas.nome: Quadrant name chips inside a scatter
pecas.o_que_faz: Marks the zones of a scatter with grey chips in large italic, colouring each country label to match its chip.
pecas.como_montar: Plot with no gridlines; four to six pale grey rectangles with bold italic two-line text in the zone's colour placed in empty plot space; point labels use the same colour as their zone; repeated names mark split zones.
pecas.serve_para: Country or peer segmentation without drawing quadrant lines.

pecas.nome: Cohort lines with a vertical gradient legend
pecas.o_que_faz: Colours many cohort lines by age and replaces the legend with one gradient bar labelled at both ends.
pecas.como_montar: About 30 lines going from pale lilac in old cohorts to saturated purple in new; a slim vertical gradient rectangle in the empty right area, with the first and last cohort names at its ends.
pecas.serve_para: Cohort analysis, vintages, anything with too many series to label.

pecas.nome: Value ball on a rounded track with average divider
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows a score per brand as a coloured stem and ball rising in a pale rounded track, with brand logos as labels.
pecas.como_montar: Equal pale vertical capsules; a thin stem in each brand's colour with a ball at the value; number on top of the track; logo at the foot; a dashed vertical between the below-average and above-average groups with 'Média' on top.
pecas.serve_para: NPS, ratings, any 0-100 score across many peers.

pecas.nome: App-icon column headers with logo row heads
pecas.o_que_faz: Uses recognisable icons as column names and competitor logos as row names, so the table reads with almost no words.
pecas.como_montar: Navy header row where two cells hold only an app-store icon; first column is navy too, with white-boxed or reversed logos; body cells in light grey with bold centred values and thin black rules. Page 150 is the variant with grey banding and an empty corner cell.
pecas.serve_para: Peer ratings, product feature comparison.

pecas.nome: Check table split into two opposed blocks
pecas.o_que_faz: Sorts rows so one option's checks form one solid block and the other's a second block, making exclusivity visible at a glance.
pecas.como_montar: Two-tone purple header over zebra grey rows; rows sorted by owner of the data; heavy black checks in only one column per row, which produce a stepped diagonal; no crosses and no dashes.
pecas.serve_para: Data access, features unique to each model.

pecas.nome: Status column wired from table row into a chart
pecas.o_que_faz: Uses a tinted condition column as a heat strip and connects the current row by a thin bracket line to the time-series windows beside it.
pecas.como_montar: Light table with hairline header; last column is a continuous block in green tints with a cyan top cell for the row at issue; a cyan elbow runs from that cell across the gutter to a line chart with dashed tinted crisis windows.
pecas.serve_para: Asset condition lists tied to a historical stress chart.

pecas.nome: Curved brand panel over a duotone photo
pecas.o_que_faz: Lets a large curved edge of solid brand colour take the right half of a photo, which is washed in the same hue.
pecas.como_montar: Full-bleed photo of the brand's physical asset with a semi-transparent purple overlay; a solid purple shape with a large-radius curved left edge carries title, rule and subtitle; team names bottom right; repeated for later dividers.
pecas.serve_para: Cover and matching section dividers when a real company photo exists.

pecas.nome: Two-tone swoop cover with a tilted photo
pecas.o_que_faz: Cuts a tilted photo with large organic red forms, so the brand signage appears through a window between them.
pecas.como_montar: Rotated photo with a red tint; dark-red gradient blob on the left, a brighter wave across the base, both freeforms with very large radii; white title with an underline, small logos top left and authors bottom right.
pecas.serve_para: Cover for multi-brand companies, photographic section openers.

pecas.nome: Roman-numbered three-by-two chart grid
pecas.o_que_faz: Fills a primer page with six small charts in three strict columns, each column headed by a numbered claim over a coloured rule.
pecas.como_montar: Three equal columns; each opens with 'I.', 'II.', 'III.' plus a short claim in the accent colour over a thin rule; two rows of charts below, each with a small grey title and only one highlight colour; one dashed window as the single annotation.
pecas.serve_para: Sector overview, dense at-a-glance pages.

pecas.nome: Twin dotted-orbit hubs on a dark band
pecas.o_que_faz: Draws the same six-spoke ecosystem around two rival logos so the viewer sees at once that both built the identical model.
pecas.como_montar: Full-width charcoal band; in each half two concentric dotted white circles, central logo on a white disc, six solid white discs sitting on the outer orbit, each with a short white rule ending in a dot and an italic coloured label; duplicate the group exactly and only swap the logo; stacked-share chart underneath on white.
pecas.serve_para: Peer precedents, showing two companies converged on the same product set, international analogues

pecas.nome: Three schematic g-curves over dashed stage boxes
pecas.o_que_faz: Explains a model choice with three hand-drawn textbook axes, each locked to a dashed box holding the number that stage uses.
pecas.como_montar: Three small arrow-headed L-axes built from lines, labelled g and t; black stepped polyline per regime; bold centred caption inside each plot; under each a dashed rectangle with stage label, large coloured % and italic note; grey field behind everything; quote strip below.
pecas.serve_para: Justifying DCF stages, model-method slides, any concept where a schematic beats real data

pecas.nome: Roof-top plates under persona icons with a logo sum between
pecas.o_que_faz: Gives each side of a two-sided market its own benefit plate whose peak points up at its persona icon, with the combined products as a sum in the centre.
pecas.como_montar: Light-grey pentagon shape like a house (very shallow roof) with bullets inside; line icon centred above the peak with a bold label; thick navy arrow from one icon to the other; in the centre gutter two logos stacked with a bold plus between.
pecas.serve_para: Two-sided platforms, buyer vs seller benefits, value proposition by stakeholder

pecas.nome: Thick-rim icon wheel with a throat into a revenue panel
pecas.o_que_faz: Turns a business-line wheel into a lid that pours through a tinted throat into the donut showing what those lines earn.
pecas.como_montar: Heavy brand-coloured ring, white spoke dividers, six equal tinted wedges each with a line icon and bold label, logo on a white centre disc; pale trapezoid from the wheel's lower edge widening into a rounded lavender panel that holds the revenue donut with leader-line labels.
pecas.serve_para: Company overview, ecosystem-to-revenue mapping, business model summary

pecas.nome: Icon tray tapering into a persona
pecas.o_que_faz: Reads as a visual formula: three attributes in a tray are funnelled down into the customer group they win.
pecas.como_montar: Pale rounded rectangle holding three line icons with two-line captions; its lower edge fades through a soft trapezoid gradient to transparent, narrowing onto a single people icon sitting centred below.
pecas.serve_para: Growth formula, value proposition summed up in three drivers

pecas.nome: Subtractive funnel of centred offset plates
pecas.o_que_faz: Walks a population down to the real TAM with signed numbers on flat plates of shrinking width, fed by a grey wedge from the map that sources it.
pecas.como_montar: Five abutting flat rectangles in one tint, each slightly narrower and centred, each with an italic thin label and a bold signed number on two lines; last plate labelled TAM; a grey-to-transparent gradient wedge joins the plates to the map on the left.
pecas.serve_para: TAM reduction, addressable-market logic, customer conversion with subtractions

pecas.nome: Dashed speech frame with a dashed tether down to the last bar
pecas.o_que_faz: Ties a conditional note physically to the data point it reads from, with the same dash wrapping the label.
pecas.como_montar: Rounded dashed brand-coloured rectangle in the empty upper right of a declining bar chart; from its right edge a dashed vertical drops straight down and closes into a dashed rounded box around the last bar's value pill.
pecas.serve_para: Commenting on a final data point, setting up a 'but' that the next exhibit answers

pecas.nome: Twin logo fans into a colour-keyed mirrored logic column
pecas.o_que_faz: Compares two regulatory models by giving each logo a fan and tinted card, then running both causal chains through a shared central column in their own colours.
pecas.como_montar: Logo tile on the left, gradient triangle fanning into a tinted rounded card (purple top, blue bottom); middle: one tall rounded panel with outline, upper half in purple and lower half in blue, each with bold premise, A arrow B row, consequence line and a triad split by vertical hairlines.
pecas.serve_para: Regulatory or license differences, business-model A vs B when the point is a chain of consequences

pecas.nome: Ellipsis exhibit headers reading as one sentence
pecas.o_que_faz: Makes separate exhibits read as one argument by splitting a single sentence across their headers with trailing and leading dots.
pecas.como_montar: Sentence broken in three: first header ends in '...', next ones start with '...driving' and '...and replicating', with the key verb bolded in the deck colour; exhibits placed in reading order under each fragment; same pattern on Nubank p33 and BTG p50.
pecas.serve_para: Any multi-exhibit slide, turning a chart mosaic into a narrative

pecas.nome: Three exhibit cards above an anchoring history footer
pecas.o_que_faz: Fixes the at-a-glance page into a template: what it is, where it is, how it performs on top, how it got here running across the bottom.
pecas.como_montar: Three equal grey cards with hard grey offset shadows, tied by a paler horizontal band running behind them; each card one headline, one italic sub, one exhibit (mini table, map with two chips, combo chart); the bottom third is a single full-width timeline; same skeleton on Rede D'Or p8 with roman-numbered exhibits.
pecas.serve_para: Company-at-a-glance, first content slide of a deck

pecas.nome: Serpentine rail threaded through hexagon photos with year tabs
pecas.o_que_faz: Tells a long corporate history in three boustrophedon rows with a real photo at each stop, so it feels like an archive rather than a list.
pecas.como_montar: Thick brand-green line entering from the left edge and leaving on the right, with quarter-circle turns between rows; hexagon-clipped photos with a green outline sitting on the line; green year tab overlapping each hexagon's lower edge; centred caption with key word bolded below; logos in plain white hexagons where no photo exists.
pecas.serve_para: Company history with 8 to 12 events, founder stories, merger narratives

pecas.nome: ECG spike timeline in a dashed frame
pecas.o_que_faz: Uses the sector's own metaphor: the time line is a heartbeat trace whose peaks and troughs carry the milestones.
pecas.como_montar: Single green polyline running flat, spiking up, down, flat, up, down, ending in an arrowhead; solid year chip at each extreme, caption and an icon disc beyond it; the line enters from off-slide through a dashed-border grey panel; final point lands on the thesis.
pecas.serve_para: Regulatory milestones, healthcare decks; swap the trace shape for a sector-specific pattern

pecas.nome: X-cross brand wheel split by a tinted horizon
pecas.o_que_faz: Sorts a sprawling brand portfolio in two axes at once: wedges by function, and above or below the horizon by business.
pecas.como_montar: Central dark disc with circular arrows and people icon; two diagonal hairlines forming an X; horizontal rule through the disc with a grey fill under it; row names at far left of the horizon; wedge titles in teal near the disc and logos loose in each wedge.
pecas.serve_para: Multi-brand portfolios, M&A roll-ups, classifying acquired businesses

pecas.nome: Descending drop-line timeline from a root box
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows expansion as branches of one origin, each later step dropping lower so the eye descends in time.
pecas.como_montar: Dark root box with icon and description; horizontal hairline under it; five thin verticals of increasing length; date plus two-tone label at the foot of each; framed by a sentence that opens above ('What started...') and closes below ('...became').
pecas.serve_para: Scope expansion, product history where everything comes from one original business

pecas.nome: Segmented year column with wedge-linked bands and an exception exit
pecas.o_que_faz: Lists who followed a trend and then visually singles out the one who did not by leaving the column on a different connector.
pecas.como_montar: Narrow vertical column alternating navy and grey blocks with years; from each grey block a darker bevel wedge widens into a light grey name band; bottom navy block carries a blue diamond and hairline out to a large blue statement and logo instead of a band.
pecas.serve_para: Precedent lists with one outlier, peer behaviour, 'everyone did X except Y'

pecas.nome: Proportional gradient tile pair
pecas.o_que_faz: A two-cell treemap that shows where an incremental number comes from, large enough to hold the explanation inside each cell.
pecas.como_montar: Two rounded rectangles of equal height, widths in the data ratio (80/20), each with its own diagonal gradient (slate blue fading light, deep magenta to pink); big % and caption centred in white; base label under each; related donut pill below.
pecas.serve_para: Source of growth, split of incremental revenue or capture

pecas.nome: Halo-icon exhibit heads over a floating takeaway tray
pecas.o_que_faz: Makes a three-exhibit slide skim on two levels: icon heads name each exhibit and a floating tray states the conclusion with its numbers.
pecas.como_montar: Each column headed by a line icon in a pale tinted disc plus bold coloured title and italic sub; bottom white rounded tray with a soft shadow holding one text block and three pairs of big halo icon plus coloured stat; icons all one line weight and colour.
pecas.serve_para: Dense strategy slides, value-creation pages

pecas.nome: Giant logo triptych over brand-coloured gradient card headers
pecas.o_que_faz: Presents exit candidates as three equal cases, each card inheriting the buyer's brand colour from the logo above it.
pecas.como_montar: Oversized logos (a logo tile in yellow for the one needing background) linked horizontally with dashed green lines; under each, a pill header in a gradient of that brand's colours with an icon disc overlapping its left end; grey body card with a thin deck-colour outline.
pecas.serve_para: Strategic buyers, exit routes, competitor profiles

pecas.nome: T-cross KPI table capped with a diamond
pecas.o_que_faz: Reduces a comparison to a minimal ledger of label and value split by one vertical stem, repeated under each column for fast scanning.
pecas.como_montar: Three rows only, no fill; coloured horizontal rules between rows; one vertical hairline through the centre extending above and below, topped with a small diamond; text in the rule colour.
pecas.serve_para: Three to five KPIs under a logo or card

pecas.nome: Receding sector-object linework cover
pecas.o_que_faz: Fills a cover with the sector's defining object in thin blueprint lines, repeated at three shrinking scales for depth.
pecas.como_montar: Midnight-navy field; pale-blue wireframe line drawing of a transmission tower at three sizes receding left with cables linking them, lower opacity on the smaller ones; stacked logo, event name and rule in the top-left, authors small at the foot.
pecas.serve_para: Infrastructure, energy and industrial covers without a good photo

pecas.nome: Circular photo porthole sliced by a pale arc
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows product through a giant off-page circle while a wide arc in the brand tint crosses it, with the rest of the slide kept dark for the title.
pecas.como_montar: Charcoal base; photo clipped to a circle larger than the slide height bleeding right; thick pale-cyan arc crossing the photo from top to right edge; cyan quarter-round corner holding the company logo; large white uppercase title at left.
pecas.serve_para: Consumer and retail covers with good product photography

pecas.nome: Inverted-triangle photo window with a tilted product card and title band
pecas.o_que_faz: Layers a dim HQ photo in a downward triangle with the company's physical product tilted over the corner, behind a solid title band.
pecas.como_montar: Navy field; building photo clipped to an inverted triangle at about 40% opacity; rotated rounded rectangles for the card with logo; opaque charcoal band from the left edge ending under the triangle with title, subtitle and italic event; letter-spaced team names at the foot.
pecas.serve_para: Financials or any firm with an iconic card, device or product

pecas.nome: Arrowhead-clipped HQ photo on a woven teal field
pecas.o_que_faz: Clips the building photo into a right-pointing arrowhead so the cover itself points at the logos and credits.
pecas.como_montar: Teal base with a very fine woven pattern texture; photo occupying the left two-thirds with diagonal upper and lower right edges meeting at a point at mid-height; logos top-right split by a vertical hairline; right-aligned team and school text at the bottom.
pecas.serve_para: Covers built around a headquarters photo

pecas.nome: Oversized logotype on tonal nested arcs
pecas.o_que_faz: Gets a confident cover with no image at all: stepped tints of the brand colour radiate like a signal behind a giant wordmark.
pecas.como_montar: Six to eight very large ellipses from dark to lighter green nested from the left, each slightly larger, bleeding off top and bottom; white logotype spanning 40% of width; rule and two-line event below it; team names small at bottom right.
pecas.serve_para: Any cover when no decent photo exists, tech and telecom in particular

pecas.nome: Narrow credit panel beside a generative flow field
pecas.o_que_faz: Splits the cover 40/60 into a sober information column and a textured art plate that adds polish without implying anything about the business.
pecas.como_montar: Left navy panel with co-branded logos on top, title in the middle and the team with emails stacked at the foot; right plate is a blue flow-field image of thousands of thin curves, generated in code or exported from an image tool.
pecas.serve_para: Formal analyst reports where a contact list must appear on the cover

pecas.nome: Ghost logo glyph with contour lines on a red-black gradient
pecas.o_que_faz: Uses a giant dim company glyph plus thin topographic strokes to brand a dark cover, leaving a clear centre for the lockup.
pecas.como_montar: Black to deep-red diagonal gradient; huge logo glyph on the right at low opacity in a slightly lighter red; two bundles of thin red curves entering at the top and bottom right; centred logo, hairline and thesis line.
pecas.serve_para: M&A pitches, oil and gas or energy decks

pecas.nome: Corner shards on a two-tone vertical gradient
pecas.o_que_faz: Frames a centred lockup with two translucent polygons at opposite corners, a minimal geometric cover for no-image situations.
pecas.como_montar: Dark teal to green vertical gradient; lighter-green translucent polygon with a hairline edge at top-left, another at bottom-right, thin rule continuing one edge across; centred title and logo pair; team at bottom left.
pecas.serve_para: Quick cover or backup deck

pecas.nome: Centred logo-rule-subtitle lockup on black with edge art
pecas.o_que_faz: A banker-style cover: everything sits on one hairline in a dark void while the art stays at the edges, with roles (partner, manager, analysts) listed at the corner.
pecas.como_montar: Black field; blue ribbon image bleeding from the corners; centred white logo, thin rule under it, one-line project name and date; bottom right team stacked by seniority with a hairline above partners; same lockup across the InFinance decks (Cosan, Vibra, CSN-ArcelorMittal).
pecas.serve_para: Credit, M&A and liability-management pitches with codename projects

pecas.nome: Moire line wave across charcoal
pecas.o_que_faz: Gives movement through hundreds of fine magenta lines forming a twisting wave that sets the deck's accent colour from the first frame.
pecas.como_montar: Charcoal base; line-blend wave bleeding left and right (each line a phase-shifted sine, generate with matplotlib or SVG, export PNG); logo top left, co-sponsor mark top right, credits with bold role labels at the bottom over the wave's calm area.
pecas.serve_para: Education, tech or any brand with a strong single accent

pecas.nome: Monochrome action photo melting into navy
pecas.o_que_faz: Places the viewer in the operating room, with a horizontal gradient dissolving the same-hue photo into a text area with no hard edge.
pecas.como_montar: Full-bleed photo tinted with a brand-blue colour overlay; left-to-right navy gradient from opaque to transparent over 55% of width; white logo and small title at mid-left; team at bottom left.
pecas.serve_para: Healthcare, operations or any business where the activity is more telling than the building

pecas.nome: Double S-lobe panel over a mono-tinted storefront
pecas.o_que_faz: Separates text from photo with two interlaced vertical S-curves in a bright and a deep green, keeping a soft pharmacy-brand feel.
pecas.como_montar: Storefront photo with green duotone on the right; dark-green left panel whose right edge is an S curve; a brighter gradient lobe weaves behind it with the opposite curve; centred title with rule, small team line, head of team at the foot.
pecas.serve_para: Retail and healthcare covers, brands with organic logos

pecas.nome: App phone on a brand disc
pecas.o_que_faz: Puts the actual product on the cover, breaking out of a solid circle so the phone feels in front of the deck.
pecas.como_montar: Graphite background; large solid pink circle right of centre with subtle dark shadow; phone mockup with a real app screenshot, taller than the circle so both ends break out; logos in corners.
pecas.serve_para: App and consumer-tech covers

pecas.nome: Icon rail with cross ticks and a lens plate over the cover window
pecas.o_que_faz: Re-uses the cover art as a section opener: thesis icons sit on a vertical thread and only the active section gets a translucent name plate over the photo window.
pecas.como_montar: Cover layout kept (navy, inverted-triangle photo, tilted card); left column with a hairline thread and small x marks at its ends and between items; one line icon per thesis, active in bright white with bold title, others dimmed with letter-spaced grey text; translucent grey rectangle over the triangle holding the section name in thin wide type.
pecas.serve_para: Dividers with three or four thesis pillars, when the cover art is strong enough to repeat

pecas.nome: Gradient-fade agenda bars on a red field
pecas.o_que_faz: A simple agenda in which each section is a heavy bar fading from red to black, matching the deck's gradient cover.
pecas.como_montar: Black to red diagonal gradient background; five equal bars left aligned, stopping before the right margin, with a red to black fill, thin red outline, and bold white roman-numbered titles.
pecas.serve_para: Agenda in dark M&A decks

pecas.nome: Comb bracket of reason boxes in a bar chart's empty corner
pecas.o_que_faz: Explains a rising bar series by hanging its three causes from one labelled comb in the blank space above the short bars.
pecas.como_montar: Bold navy label centred on top; a thin elbow bracket drops to three outlined white boxes with a blue-to-transparent lower edge; boxes occupy the unused top left of the ascending chart; no connectors to specific bars.
pecas.serve_para: Growth charts where the drivers should appear inside the exhibit

pecas.nome: Four-quadrant exhibit grid with bold head and one-line reason
pecas.o_que_faz: A disciplined 2x2 where each cell is a mini-slide with its own black head and sentence, mixing area, bars and a logo table under one claim.
pecas.como_montar: Four equal cells with no borders or fills; head in bold black with unit in brackets, one-line reason beneath; exhibit fills the rest; all column bars use the same navy vertical gradient; the fourth cell is a logo table with a gradient header; left edge has a thin decorative blue strip.
pecas.serve_para: Sector problem pages that need four pieces of evidence for a single claim

pecas.nome: Project fact sheet on arrow-tipped cross axes
pecas.o_que_faz: Turns a term sheet into a designed card: three headline KPIs over a two-column key/value list split by a thin cross with dot ends.
pecas.como_montar: Light-blue fading rectangle, solid blue outline on three sides that fades off to the right; top row of bold KPI label and value pairs; horizontal blue line with small end dots beneath; vertical line with the same ends dropping to the bottom between two italic key/value columns; no row rules.
pecas.serve_para: Project, bond or asset fact sheets, deal terms

pecas.nome: Breakeven diagonal with a gradient cost zone and one lone bubble
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows at a glance that a project sits in the value-creating side of a Kd = IRR line, with the plot field itself saturated towards the worse corner.
pecas.como_montar: Square-ish scatter with white gridlines; field filled with a diagonal blue gradient from strong at bottom left to almost white at top right; dotted 45-degree line fading out; single dark glossy circle with a white ring and project label inside; companion slide p10 shows the full bubble set.
pecas.serve_para: IRR vs cost of debt, ROIC vs WACC, single-project reads

pecas.nome: Three unit columns: mini income statement, wired returns, sensitivity
pecas.o_que_faz: Stacks table, result and heatmap in repeated columns on dark, with the result row physically wired down to its IRR boxes so the comparison reads across and the logic down.
pecas.como_montar: Three identical columns on black; white heavy rules above and below a borderless table; bottom FCFE row in a white outline with a blue fading fill; elbow lines from its ends into two outlined boxes (real and nominal IRR) with a small white lightning icon between; below each a white-framed blue heatmap with Kd rows and % debt columns; short broken blue vertical dividers between columns.
pecas.serve_para: Unit economics of projects, stores or assets compared side by side

pecas.nome: Return chips on an elbow bus into a benchmark panel
pecas.o_que_faz: Pulls the IRR out of each creditor's cash-flow table and routes every one along a thin bus into the same US Treasury benchmark box.
pecas.como_montar: Tables at left with outlined total rows; break mark (double slash) on a vertical rule next to each table; rectangular outlined chip with big value, small TIR and corner dots; thin blue elbow lines rising on two verticals into a glassy panel listing 5y, 10y, 30y yields.
pecas.serve_para: Bond tranches vs benchmark, multi-instrument returns

pecas.nome: Diamond-topped flagpoles with italic notes on a price area
pecas.o_que_faz: Annotates price history with long thin poles topped by diamonds whose notes float in the empty sky above the falling line.
pecas.como_montar: Pale sage area under a dark green line; thin vertical stem rising from the event date to a variable height; small diamond on top; italic green two-line note beginning right of the diamond; no boxes.
pecas.serve_para: Falling share price with discrete causes, what-went-wrong narrative

pecas.nome: Boxed dossier column beside a chart grid
pecas.o_que_faz: Fixes a full-height left panel for who the company is, leaving the right two-thirds free for evidence; used as the opening page of many decks.
pecas.como_montar: Tall left card, grey or white with hard dark offset shadow: logo, paragraph, shareholder logo row with converging tree, key-financials T-table; to the right two rows of exhibits with a bold head and grey sub; same skeleton on Cury p3 with an embedded treemap and on Rede D'Or p8.
pecas.serve_para: Company or sector overview pages

pecas.nome: Tick ruler with triangle markers and a peer range block
pecas.o_que_faz: Benchmarks past and current values on a real-looking graduated scale, with the peer range as a hatched grey block so progress and gap are read without a chart axis.
pecas.como_montar: Key above the rulers: light triangle = 2012, dark triangle = 2025, grey block = peer; one long thin rectangle per metric with dense vertical ticks (repeated line pattern) and arrow-like end caps; grey rectangle laid over the range; triangles standing on the ruler with value labels above; italic metric title over each.
pecas.serve_para: Turnaround progress against peers, regulatory convergence, KPI gap analysis

pecas.nome: Boxed axis range with a stem into a note
pecas.o_que_faz: Selects a time window by framing the x-axis labels themselves and running a line up through the bars to a note, so the callout claims a period instead of a bar.
pecas.como_montar: Thin red rectangle around the 2025A to 2027E axis labels; a thin black vertical rising from it, passing between bars into a grey box with red border and short thick red tab at its base; italic justified text with red keywords in the box.
pecas.serve_para: Ramp-up periods, inflection windows on stacked bars

pecas.nome: Table rows wired to insight headlines with diamond leaders
pecas.o_que_faz: Connects specific rows of a cap table to the conclusions they prove, so the reader never has to match text to numbers.
pecas.como_montar: White outlined table on dark with key rows in red bold; dotted white rules grouping Pre-Offer and Post-Offer above columns, same dotted rule above Key Insights; thick red line leaving the table edge at each key row and ending in a diamond; bold red insight head at the diamond with justified white body below.
pecas.serve_para: Cap tables, financial tables with three or fewer things to say

pecas.nome: Tall-tile tonal treemap inside a side panel
pecas.o_que_faz: Fits market-share structure into a narrow column, where one giant dark 'others' cell makes fragmentation obvious and tickers break across tile width.
pecas.como_montar: Six rectangles in navy-to-sky tonal blues with thin white gaps; % at top left and ticker at bottom of each; tickers forced onto two lines in the small tiles; the largest cell kept nearly black with a single label.
pecas.serve_para: Fragmented sectors, market share in a sidebar

pecas.nome: Logo-headed duel table with outlined verdict rows
pecas.o_que_faz: Compares two companies with only logos for column heads and saves the emphasis for the two rows that decide the argument.
pecas.como_montar: No fills or rules in body; single vertical rule between the two value columns running up into the logo row; final two rows in a pale blue fill with a solid blue outline and bold blue text, outline crossing the vertical rule.
pecas.serve_para: Head-to-head unit economics, company vs main rival

pecas.nome: Curves with gap fill and area anchored on the hurdle line
pecas.o_que_faz: Shades only what matters: the space between two curves, or between a return and its cost of equity rather than zero.
pecas.como_montar: Smoothed lines; a pale blue tint polygon only between the two series; second chart, ROE area with a dark-to-light vertical gradient whose floor is the Ke line drawn as a blue rule, labelled at its right end, and the real x-axis sits lower; values at each point with no y-axis.
pecas.serve_para: TSR vs price, ROE vs Ke, ROIC vs WACC

pecas.nome: One tall chart beside two stacked
pecas.o_que_faz: Breaks chart-grid monotony by giving the crowded multi-series exhibit double height and the simpler ones half height.
pecas.como_montar: Left column full body height for the many-line chart; right column split into two equal cells; each cell with bold head, grey sub; all charts same smoothing, palette and light gridless style; average band in the tall one in a pale tint with dashed upper line.
pecas.serve_para: Management or financial track record with one busy exhibit and two simple ones

pecas.nome: Greyscale treemap with a gold-dashed side note
pecas.o_que_faz: Removes colour from the treemap so that size alone speaks, and leaves the single gold accent for the sentence interpreting it.
pecas.como_montar: Four grey tiles from charcoal to light grey with white gaps and small labels bottom-left; to the right, a short dashed gold arrow into a pale gold dashed rectangle with a short paragraph; no percentages on tiles.
pecas.serve_para: Concentration arguments, revenue by category

pecas.nome: Football field as a table column
pecas.o_que_faz: Places each valuation range in the same row as its numbers and comment, so method, range, implied value and rationale read in a single line.
pecas.como_montar: Dark full-width header; row hairlines in pale grey; left bold grey method labels; second column holds floating horizontal bars with dark-to-light gradient and low/high labels at both ends; a pale beige vertical band and dashed gold line through all rows mark the offer and price; right columns low, high, low, high and a comment with bold range.
pecas.serve_para: Valuation summary with a reason per method, comps with commentary

pecas.nome: Diamond nodes on a capped rail with dashed span brackets beneath
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows a three-step mechanism in very little space, with the explanation attached to the gaps between steps rather than to the steps themselves.
pecas.como_montar: Thin green horizontal line with short vertical end caps; three large green-outlined pale diamonds with a line icon; label above each; dashed green square bracket beneath spanning from node to node, with a centred two-line caption.
pecas.serve_para: Compact mechanisms in a half-slide, cross-sell logic, incentive chains

pecas.nome: Rotated-axis heat table with survey answer chip
pecas.o_que_faz: Displays a primary-survey cross-tab as a single-hue heat table, credited by a form-logo chip with the sample size.
pecas.como_montar: Row-group label rotated 90 degrees in bold at far left; plain text column and row headers without rules; cells with white gaps tinted by value in brand green; chip of a Forms icon overlapping a rounded outlined pill with bold sample count above the table.
pecas.serve_para: Survey cross-tabs, product attach rates

pecas.nome: Before and after ownership treemap pair
pecas.o_que_faz: Makes a change of control obvious from area alone: same frame size, same colours per holder, the state tile collapsing and a new holder appearing.
pecas.como_montar: Two equal-size rectangles divided with thin white gaps and a clear gutter, no arrow; consistent holder colour across both (cyan = state, navy = free float, purple = new strategic); % top-left bold in white, holder name bottom-left; a tinted note band with mini logos for governance rights beneath.
pecas.serve_para: Privatizations, IPOs, follow-ons, post-deal shareholding

pecas.nome: Slice treemap with % on top and label at the foot
pecas.o_que_faz: Keeps the treemap readable by making it nearly a single row of tall slices, in stepped brand blues, with only the last slice subdivided.
pecas.como_montar: Rectangle cut vertically into four widths proportional to value, last column split horizontally in two; white gaps; bold % at top left and regular label bottom aligned; fills alternate tones so neighbours separate without borders.
pecas.serve_para: Cost base, revenue mix where many items are similar in size

pecas.nome: Hollow outline arrows between stakeholder panels and a dashed logo disc
pecas.o_que_faz: Maps what each side gives and gets with four outlined arrows around the platform, the arrow colour showing whose flow it is.
pecas.como_montar: Two tall rounded panels (brand tint and grey), each with name, icon rows, big stat, optional logos; centre: dashed circle with logo; above and below it hollow block arrows with sharp pointed tails, pink for user side, grey for partner side, with a flow label over or under each.
pecas.serve_para: Marketplaces, two-sided platforms, win-win models

pecas.nome: Icon-disc legend column with growth arrows between paired stacks
pecas.o_que_faz: Replaces a chart legend with round segment icons aligned to each band, and puts the growth of each segment on arrows between the two years so mix and growth read together.
pecas.como_montar: Two 100% stacked columns far apart; between them per band one thin arrow in the band colour with +% in the middle; left: icon in a disc with label below, colour-matched and vertically centred with its band; small tag above each column for the tiny top segment.
pecas.serve_para: Mix shift between two periods, revenue by segment

pecas.nome: Ranked donut row as a survey strip
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows the importance of independent factors as five mini donuts of equal size in descending order, where a bar chart would imply they add up.
pecas.como_montar: Five identical small donuts in one row with dark remainder and cyan share, bold % in hole; two-line centred caption under each; tinted takeaway box with hard offset below.
pecas.serve_para: Multiple-response surveys, purchase factors, independent KPIs

pecas.nome: Folded square icon tabs on pale pill rows
pecas.o_que_faz: Lists modelling assumptions as physical tabs: a dark icon square wraps over each pale pill with folded corners.
pecas.como_montar: Pale lavender rounded rectangle with text and bold coloured key number; dark purple square overlapping its left end, taller than the pill, with small darker triangles at top and bottom right to fake a fold; white line icon inside.
pecas.serve_para: Assumption lists, four-to-five drivers next to a chart

pecas.nome: Scenario animals inside bar bases
pecas.o_que_faz: Labels scenarios from inside the bars with a bear or bull line icon and bold name, removing the need for an axis or legend.
pecas.como_montar: Three wide bars in different brand tones with value chip on top; white outline bear or bull icon near the foot, white bold case name below it; a thick vertical rule at left with heading and a tinted chip acting as chart intro; comparison reference in a shadow chip at top right.
pecas.serve_para: Bear, base and bull outcomes

pecas.nome: Scenario glow header over bullets and range rows
pecas.o_que_faz: Unifies three scenarios under one glowing band of IRR and MOIC, with the assumptions in columns and the exit variables below as bear-to-bull range tubes.
pecas.como_montar: Single dark-to-green gradient plate with three bold case names and green IRR and white MOIC pairs; aligned dash bullets in three columns; white rule; table with row labels at left, one vertical rule, a rectangle with a green gradient glowing from the centre with a small base tick, bear and bull values at each end, base value under it, range on the far right in grey.
pecas.serve_para: Returns analysis, PE exit scenarios, sensitivity summary on dark

pecas.nome: Logo-topped count capsules above a chart
pecas.o_que_faz: Adds a mini brand census on top of a financial chart so the reader sees what the business comprises and how it performs in one column stack.
pecas.como_montar: Five logos evenly spaced in a row; below each a white rounded rectangle with a magenta outline (lighter for lesser brands), bold count and unit in two lines; chart immediately below using overlapped-label bars and a pale line with chip labels.
pecas.serve_para: Multi-brand companies, portfolio with one-number facts

pecas.nome: Lit and ghost logo walls in dashed frames
pecas.o_que_faz: Divides a set of logos into two groups and spotlights one by keeping it in full contrast with shadow while the other is greyed out in a pale frame, so the segmentation is grasped before any text.
pecas.como_montar: Two stacked 4x2 logo grids; top with dark dashed frame on white and soft shadow, full-colour black logos, a leader line and diamond into the section title; bottom same size with pale teal dashed border, grey fill, logos at about 25% opacity.
pecas.serve_para: Segmenting peers, clients or partners into tiers

pecas.nome: Pointed attribute band into a stem splitting to two icon conclusions
pecas.o_que_faz: Collapses a row of attributes down through a shallow arrow point into a single stem that forks in two conclusions.
pecas.como_montar: Pale blue rectangle whose lower edge forms a very wide shallow V, five bold attributes evenly spaced; thin line from the tip; hollow diamond at the fork, filled diamonds at both ends; large dark icon and centred two-tone sentence under each end.
pecas.serve_para: From characteristics to implications, closing half of a logic slide

pecas.nome: Stem flags over square icon tiles on an arrow rail
pecas.o_que_faz: Lays out a four-step adoption loop as big icon tiles on one arrow, each step's text hanging right-aligned against a vertical stem rising from its tile.
pecas.como_montar: Pale rounded tray; thin black arrow crossing the tray; four large rounded-square brand tiles with white icons sitting on the line; thin vertical stem rising from each tile's right portion; right-aligned two-line bold head and smaller note set against the stem's left side.
pecas.serve_para: Customer journey, engagement-to-ARPU chains, bottom strip of a dense slide

pecas.nome: Storyline rail with rotated message
pecas.o_que_faz: Gives each slide a two- or three-word plot point, so the left edge alone tells the story as the reader flips.
pecas.como_montar: Full-height solid brand rail about 6% of width; page number at top in small white; rotated 90-degree large white phrase bottom-aligned ('Evolving Mindsets', 'Dream Big'), not the section name. Rail turns dark grey in the appendix (p79).
pecas.serve_para: Long decks with an argument per slide; separating main body from appendix by rail colour alone.

pecas.nome: Criteria track with logo spotlight
pecas.o_que_faz: Tells the reader which criteria are being tested and which competitor is under the lens across a slide run.
pecas.como_montar: A chevron pair points from a short sentence into a grey band with a long horizontal line carrying three pill handles labelled with criteria; below, a row of competitor logos acts as the legend, the active one full colour and the others faded, and the chart recolours to match across the pages.
pecas.serve_para: Multi-slide competitor comparison with a repeated chart.

pecas.nome: Three-level tracker: section, chapter, slide idea
pecas.o_que_faz: Tells the reader at once which thesis, which chapter inside it and which of three sub-arguments they are on.
pecas.como_montar: Bottom text rail with five thesis names and a thick bar over the active one; top right tabs for the chapter, active one dark and taller; under the title, a thin full-width rule with three small rectangle ticks and captions, active tick solid, others outlined, ended by a small X.
pecas.serve_para: Long decks with nested arguments; the third level suits a chapter that makes exactly three points.

pecas.nome: Master plan re-entered as tracker
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows where the advisory plan stands by returning to the same four-step page with only the current step lit.
pecas.como_montar: Build one master slide with 4 columns. Duplicate it before each section; set the other columns to about 25% opacity and keep the active one at full. Step labels are small italics between two vertical ticks on a line running edge to edge. Column values are constant across all copies, so the page also recaps the numbers.
pecas.serve_para: Multi-step plans, transaction sequences, any deck with one governing framework

pecas.nome: Second-level tab tracker with dashed selection frame
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows which of several deal parts the slide belongs to, inside one section.
pecas.como_montar: Three equal dark gradient bars across the top under the subtitle with white labels; active tab gets a red dashed double frame slightly bigger than the bar, others stay plain.
pecas.serve_para: Multi-asset deal, sum-of-the-parts, several business units

pecas.nome: Thesis orbit agenda with bracketed BUY
pecas.o_que_faz: Turns the agenda into a statement: the logo at the hub, 3 theses on the arc, the verdict beside them.
pecas.como_montar: Two concentric circle outlines bleeding off the left edge, logo inside the inner one. Three 120px circles with line icons sit on the outer ring, heading to the right of each. Black heavy "BUY!" between two L-shaped corner marks at top-left and bottom-right. On section dividers remove BUY and fade the other two theses.
pecas.serve_para: Thesis overview and thesis dividers

pecas.nome: Agenda dressed as the company's website
pecas.o_que_faz: Makes a 150-page index feel like browsing the target's own product, so the structure is memorable.
pecas.como_montar: Full-width brand-colour nav bar with fake menu items, white search box with magnifier, cart icon with red count badge at right; body is 3 columns of underlined linked titles numbered 1.1, 2.1; footer rule with link columns and social icon circles.
pecas.serve_para: Long deck agenda or appendix index for a consumer or platform company

pecas.nome: Verdict ticket divider with thesis rail
pecas.o_que_faz: Repeats ticker, BUY, upside and IRR at every section change, so the recommendation is never out of sight.
pecas.como_montar: Grey page, thin kraft header strip. Top plate: ticker left, large green BUY right. White card below: vertical green line with 3 dots and thesis names; inactive theses and their dots fade to pale grey. Card footer split by a hairline: Upside left, IRR plus exit year right. Same fields as the shipping label on the cover.
pecas.serve_para: Section dividers in a stock pitch; the closing recap

pecas.nome: Mini-diagram as a locator on repeat slides
pecas.o_que_faz: Keeps the same driver tree on every slide of a chapter and colours only the branch being discussed, so the reader sees which lever is under test.
pecas.como_montar: Top box Revenue; pale elbow arrows down to AUV X Units and on to Price X Traffic and NRG; active path in solid red, inactive boxes in flat grey with white italic text; pale X between multiplied boxes. The same tree moves slide to slide with a new branch lit. Pp. 24-26 repeat it with the Reclaim the Flame plan cards.
pecas.serve_para: Revenue build-ups, DuPont, any decomposition argued lever by lever.

pecas.nome: Sized bubbles as a scope selector
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows market size by scope in p.28, then reappears with two bubbles ghosted to mark which market the slide now covers.
pecas.como_montar: Three pale rounded columns, each with numbered red disc, market name, circle sized to the value, red share tag at the base; two thin grey lines tie the bubbles together like a growing cone. Later slides fade the unused columns.
pecas.serve_para: TAM ladders and geographic expansion chapters.

pecas.nome: Guest-company chrome recolor
pecas.o_que_faz: Tells the reader instantly that this slide is about another company (benchmark or asset), not the subject.
pecas.como_montar: Keep the template, swap one theme: side rail, title tick, active breadcrumb word and subtitle accents take the guest brand colour, and the top-right logo becomes the guest logo. Sabesp p17 goes purple for Equatorial, Intelbras p10 red for Coca-Cola, CSN p27-31 yellow for MRS and red for TECON. A theme-colour swap only.
pecas.serve_para: Case studies, peer benchmarks, subsidiaries and asset-by-asset sections

pecas.nome: Running term-sheet ledger beneath a stepper
pecas.o_que_faz: Keeps deal numbers for the current step on screen as the reader goes through a multi-step transaction.
pecas.como_montar: Fixed left column about 22% of width: the wheel stepper (already catalogued), then a KPI ledger of paired stats per sub-header ('Block Trade: BRL 35.4 Price per Share | 5% Premium'), values in accent with small grey unit, pairs split by a thin fading vertical line.
pecas.serve_para: Multi-stage transaction structure, LBO steps.

pecas.nome: Breadcrumb whose vocabulary swaps in the appendix
pecas.o_que_faz: Each appendix block gets its own local path, so backup slides show where they sit in that sub-topic.
pecas.como_montar: Footer text line with pipe separators, current item bold and accent; main deck lists main sections, each appendix group replaces the list with its own steps (Operation | Macro | Oil Reserves...).
pecas.serve_para: Deep appendix with several mini-storylines

pecas.nome: Footer tab tracker with sliding overbar
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows which of five chapters the reader is in without taking content space.
pecas.como_montar: Hairline across the footer, five evenly spaced uppercase labels under it; a thick short accent segment sits on the hairline above the active label and moves between slides.
pecas.serve_para: Any deck with 4-6 chapters.

pecas.nome: Year stepper header
pecas.o_que_faz: Locates each tranche on the financing calendar while the body changes.
pecas.como_montar: Four small boxes in a row across the top, linked by thin arrows. Past or active years use blue italics on navy; future ones white-outlined grey. Below it, a one-line navy strip states what happens at that date.
pecas.serve_para: Financing schedules, phased projects, multi-year rollouts

pecas.nome: Fading double-rule agenda
pecas.o_que_faz: Gives a plain list on a dark page a structured, ledger-like rhythm.
pecas.como_montar: Each item sits between two horizontal bars that run from the left edge to about 56% of the width and fade from grey to transparent. Items have regular white text and generous gaps; the abstract artwork occupies the free side.
pecas.serve_para: Agendas and index pages on dark themes

pecas.nome: Chapter phase tabs
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows the phase of a story across a three-slide narrative.
pecas.como_montar: Three adjoining dark tabs at the top of the body (Restructuring, Aggressive Growth, Financial Distress); active is lit blue, the others dim, and the charts below change. Low-res crop.
pecas.serve_para: Company history split into eras

pecas.nome: Book-style table of contents
pecas.o_que_faz: Gives the deck the feel of a bound report.
pecas.como_montar: Bold section names with a short gold tick at left; dotted leaders across to right-aligned page numbers; generous even row spacing on a warm off-white page. Use tab leaders: here hand-typed dots render unevenly.
pecas.serve_para: Formal M&A or report-style decks.

pecas.nome: Spine with rotated section name, roman numerals in appendix, grey chevrons
pecas.o_que_faz: Tells the reader the section and whether they are in main deck or backup, without reading the footer.
pecas.como_montar: Dark left rail; page number at top; section name rotated 90 degrees; chevron stack at base (the rail shape itself is already catalogued). Appendix switches chevrons from brand colour to grey and page numbers to roman numerals.
pecas.serve_para: Decks with a long appendix

pecas.nome: Four-pill section tabs
pecas.o_que_faz: Gives a web-style top menu that shows the current pillar without taking up title width.
pecas.como_montar: Four equal rounded rectangles in the top right of each content slide. Active one slate fill with white text; inactive ones light grey with text barely darker than the fill, so they read as disabled.
pecas.serve_para: Decks with 3-5 pillars and a long appendix

pecas.nome: Sector-object icon on every nav item
pecas.o_que_faz: Turns a generic footer tracker into a piece of company identity and shows the section by bold green text.
pecas.como_montar: Footer rule; each section label preceded by a small outline icon drawn from the sector (pills for a pharmacy, a building for overview); active label bold and coloured, others regular.
pecas.serve_para: Any company with a simple recognisable object: pills, boxes, houses, aircraft.

pecas.nome: Breadcrumb sentence footer
pecas.o_que_faz: Keeps the whole storyline readable on one line, with the current chapter coloured.
pecas.como_montar: Footer line under a full-width hairline: section names separated by pipes, active name bold in accent colour, sources in italic grey on the same baseline. Appendix pages reduce to the single word Appendix.
pecas.serve_para: Any structured deck; cheaper than tabs

pecas.nome: Inline breadcrumb in gold
pecas.o_que_faz: Marks the current chapter in a single text line.
pecas.como_montar: Centered line of chapter names split by pipes, active one in gold; heavy rule above, firm name and page number at right. Rede D'Or uses the same with teal.
pecas.serve_para: Decks with many chapters, where tabs would not fit.

pecas.nome: Numbered disc inside the title
pecas.o_que_faz: Ties each slide title to one of the numbered growth avenues without a separate tracker.
pecas.como_montar: Red disc with white number and a pale ring, placed just before the title text at cap height; number matches the columns of the opening slide of the chapter.
pecas.serve_para: Chapters split into two to four numbered arguments.

pecas.nome: Bar segments continued into captions
pecas.o_que_faz: Uses the last stacked bar as a table row header: each segment height sets the height of its explanation.
pecas.como_montar: Last column of the stacked bar touches a block of pale rows of equal heights to its segments, tinted to match; each row has a title and a reading; from one row, a thin line and diamond run right to a detail panel, where a curved thick arrow carries 74% between two TAM numbers.
pecas.serve_para: Segmented markets where each layer needs a qualitative note.

pecas.nome: Purchase-price banner over football field
pecas.o_que_faz: Tests all ranges against the deal price in one vertical line.
pecas.como_montar: Pale blue box above the bars with price in blue and implied multiple in grey. Dashed line runs from a dot at its base through all bars to the axis. Low and high values sit outside the bars.
pecas.serve_para: Football fields, target prices

pecas.nome: Highlight plate shaped as an L that holds the caption
pecas.o_que_faz: Merges the takeaway and the highlighted years into one shape, leaving the rest of the chart clean.
pecas.como_montar: Tinted polygon: a horizontal strip across the top holding bold text, a vertical block dropping down over only the last years through to the axis labels. Build by union of two rectangles.
pecas.serve_para: Line chart with a turning point

pecas.nome: Scribble ring linking the same number across exhibits
pecas.o_que_faz: Tells the reader the table total and the bridge end point are the same figure, using a hand gesture.
pecas.como_montar: Irregular dotted hand-drawn oval around the number; the same ring repeats on the same value in the table and at the top of the final bar.
pecas.serve_para: Bridges, net debt, any number that recurs on a slide

pecas.nome: Span bracket with notes in the empty years
pecas.o_que_faz: Uses the empty part of the chart to explain why nothing happened during that period.
pecas.como_montar: Accent rule with a diamond at both ends over the gap, title centred above it; grey rectangle below holding three bold-lead italic notes, in place of the absent bars.
pecas.serve_para: Time series with a drought, gap or regime

pecas.nome: Political-era dividers over a bar chart
pecas.o_que_faz: Explains the data by government period without adding text inside the bars.
pecas.como_montar: Evenly spaced bars; dashed vertical lines rising above the bars at each regime change; right-aligned grey caption hugging each line at the top, naming the period and what it did.
pecas.serve_para: Regulated sectors and policy-driven series: funding, tariffs, tax regimes.

pecas.nome: Insider-buying flags on price history
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows the alignment claim directly, each purchase planted on the date it occurred.
pecas.como_montar: Thin price line; tall blue-outlined candle-like rectangles on stems hanging from the line at purchase dates, with Compra and amount above each; end labels with total stakes bottom right.
pecas.serve_para: Insider trades, buybacks, capital raises, M&A dates.

pecas.nome: Insider trades flagged on the price chart
pecas.o_que_faz: Turns the stock chart into evidence of management behaviour.
pecas.como_montar: Hollow red circle on the line at each event, dashed vertical leader rising to a two-weight label: bold verb, then quantity (Compra de 60k acoes).
pecas.serve_para: Events, buybacks, insider trades, catalysts

pecas.nome: Formula with stepped leader notes
pecas.o_que_faz: Breaks a formula into terms using a staircase of notes, so each one is read in turn.
pecas.como_montar: Math-font equation on one line. Thick navy bar below each term. From each bar a thin line drops to a yellow diamond, with a note to the right; line lengths increase leftwards so the notes form a stair. An arrow from the result leads to consequence text. Dashed rules enclose a summary paragraph.
pecas.serve_para: Pricing mechanics, unit economics, regulatory formulas

pecas.nome: Hand-brushed circle on the winner
pecas.o_que_faz: Adds one human gesture to a formal table and pinpoints the winner.
pecas.como_montar: Yellow brush-stroke ellipse, tapered and open-ended like marker pen, around the single winning number. Peers in the same row enclosed by a thin dashed navy box. Draw it as a freeform or PNG; use only once per deck.
pecas.serve_para: Peer comparison tables

pecas.nome: Price chart with bull and bear icons on target lines
pecas.o_que_faz: Marks bull, base and bear values on the price history itself, so the verdict sits against where the stock trades.
pecas.como_montar: Dark slide; price line runs under three full-width dashed lines in green, yellow and red; value label at each right end, base in a dashed box; small outline bull above and bear below the band. Right side: grey card with dashed green edge and offset shadow holding HOLD, price, a thick down arrow labelled Downside, target.
pecas.serve_para: Recommendation slide, especially for a Hold or Sell that needs its range visible.

pecas.nome: Phase window aligned across stacked charts
pecas.o_que_faz: Labels a regime on two charts at once so the reader sees the same period driving both.
pecas.como_montar: Translucent coloured rectangle with dashed outline and white phase title over the time span, repeated at the same x on the chart below; each phase gets its own hue; the build walks Before, During, After, each with a side panel in the same hue explaining it.
pecas.serve_para: Regime narratives: pre/during/post crisis, management eras, cycles.

pecas.nome: Formula with brackets and dashed notes
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows which terms of a regulatory formula are locked and why this drives the thesis.
pecas.como_montar: Centred equation with key terms bold navy. Curly brackets under grouped terms carry a small bold label. Straight stems run down to dashed rounded boxes with one-sentence meaning. A diamond bullet below states the takeaway.
pecas.serve_para: Tariff formulas, covenants, DuPont

pecas.nome: Gap wedge with curved arrows
pecas.o_que_faz: Converts the space between two lines into named money.
pecas.como_montar: Shade the area between the series in pale cyan from the event onward. Dashed vertical marks the event, labelled Privatization. From the wedge end, two thin curved arrows leave for small tinted cards with bold values. Pill labels on both lines.
pecas.serve_para: Actual vs ceiling, plan vs delivery, before vs after

pecas.nome: Fieldset legend frame
pecas.o_que_faz: Puts a heading into the border, saving a line and binding label to box.
pecas.como_montar: Two-point coloured rectangle outline with bold coloured title centred on the top edge; a white or page-coloured patch behind the text breaks the line. Stack several, one sentence each, in a grey panel.
pecas.serve_para: Consequences, rules, programme definitions

pecas.nome: Row highlight running across twin cards
pecas.o_que_faz: Draws attention to the one line of a side-by-side that decides the argument.
pecas.como_montar: Two shadowed cards, each with an italic title, logos and a key-value list; one dashed strip with a fading accent runs across both cards at the same row ('Operator Margin: Lower / Higher').
pecas.serve_para: Business model comparisons.

pecas.nome: Deal ellipses on a threshold chart
pecas.o_que_faz: Marks which offers pass a limit, so the chart reads as a story of three bids.
pecas.como_montar: Scatter with background split into two color bands by the limit (grey 'Threshold Violation', green 'Target Leverage Range'); paired dots as short vertical ranges; thin dashed ellipses around each offer with an italic label; the proposed deal in a heavier, brighter dashed circle with bold label.
pecas.serve_para: Offer comparison, covenant limits, feasibility maps.

pecas.nome: Deal ledger cards above a stock line
pecas.o_que_faz: Pairs each past capital-allocation decision with what the stock did at the time.
pecas.como_montar: CEO tenure strip with year scale at the top; row of outlined cards dated and aligned to that scale, each with status ('Dissolved', 'Exit') and logo; below, the price line with small callouts and dashed window for acquisitions; a comps table completes the right side.
pecas.serve_para: Management track record, capital allocation reviews.

pecas.nome: Logos as series end labels
pecas.o_que_faz: Removes the legend hunt by ending every line in the company's own logo beside its value.
pecas.como_montar: Line chart with small value tags at right ends, company logos stacked in same order right after them; call-outs on the plot with light or dark hard-shadow boxes.
pecas.serve_para: Peer comparison lines with at most about six companies.

pecas.nome: Double dashed selection ring
pecas.o_que_faz: Flags the one row or conclusion like a marquee selection, without adding a fill.
pecas.como_montar: Rounded rectangles drawn twice with slight offset in dashed line (red on rows, white on summary boxes), containing just the figures that matter, echoing into a summary card beneath.
pecas.serve_para: Key lines of a model table on dark slides

pecas.nome: Ghost delta bar with I-beam note
pecas.o_que_faz: Identifies the gain as an explanation rather than a mass, between two solid totals.
pecas.como_montar: Two solid gradient bars; middle one is pale tint with dashed outline floating at the delta; capped stem drops to a dashed note box.
pecas.serve_para: Before and after with one explained gap

pecas.nome: Texture-coded bridge legend
pecas.o_que_faz: Gives equity, debt, synergies and incremental value separate material on a single-hue page.
pecas.como_montar: White outline for equity, solid red for debt, dark red for synergies, hatch for the increment; a top legend with long swatches; thin red connector rules; subscript on final labels.
pecas.serve_para: Monochrome value bridges

pecas.nome: Forecast divider with its own note zone
pecas.o_que_faz: Separates actuals from estimates and uses the zone to state the point.
pecas.como_montar: Dark vertical line between years with a small rightward arrow at the top; light grey zone covers the estimate years, italic note at its top; ratio series as filled tags over the bars.
pecas.serve_para: Actuals vs. estimate charts

pecas.nome: Dashed logo tether on seat plan
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows which shareholder holds which seat (the plan itself is already catalogued).
pecas.como_montar: Shareholder logos beside the seat, joined by dashed line; seat recoloured in a contrasting tone; pale zone with caption New Board Members groups them.
pecas.serve_para: Board change

pecas.nome: "Not this, but that" card
pecas.o_que_faz: Dismantles the assumed explanation and lands the real one.
pecas.como_montar: Dashed red rounded box: small statement of what the moat is not, grey down-triangle, statement of what it is, red footer strip with a fact. Sits at the end of a chain of bordered pills linked by fading arrows.
pecas.serve_para: Reframing an insight

pecas.nome: Evidence bracket into takeaway box
pecas.o_que_faz: Binds a whole list to one conclusion so the reader knows what to make of it.
pecas.como_montar: Thin gold dashed bracket spanning the content's width; short dashed drop with a tiny solid triangle; sentence; pale box with gold dashed outline holding the implication.
pecas.serve_para: Bottom of any list or exhibit column.

pecas.nome: Named zones over a bar chart
pecas.o_que_faz: Classifies peers into two camps on the chart itself.
pecas.como_montar: Green and pink tinted dashed rectangles behind the positive and negative extremes, with gold uppercase labels outside the frame; dark gradient bars stay neutral and the zone colour carries the meaning.
pecas.serve_para: Winners vs losers, specialists vs generalists.

pecas.nome: Action zone in a risk matrix
pecas.o_que_faz: Says which risks require action before closing, not just which are large.
pecas.como_montar: Pale grey dashed box around the top-right cell labelled 'PRE-CLOSING' in small spaced caps; gold axis bands LOW/MID/HIGH on both axes; numbered dots match a right-hand ledger with mitigation and residual risk columns. Glow dots already catalogued; this entry is the zone and the residual column.
pecas.serve_para: Risk slides where a subset triggers conditions.

pecas.nome: Curve labels set along the slope, gap arrow
pecas.o_que_faz: Removes the legend and makes the crossover and final gap the message.
pecas.como_montar: Text rotated to the line's angle, in the line colour, with quotes around it because the series are words; double-headed dashed arrow at the last period.
pecas.serve_para: Two-series crossover

pecas.nome: Series tags as filled pills
pecas.o_que_faz: Each value is coloured by its series, so the legend becomes almost unnecessary and overlaps remain readable.
pecas.como_montar: Small filled rounded rectangle at each data point in series colour with white bold number, bigger than usual. Also red square tags for ratios on Cosan p14.
pecas.serve_para: Line charts with few points

pecas.nome: Dashed tinted delta chips
pecas.o_que_faz: Layers the takeaway number directly on the chart without covering bars or needing a leader.
pecas.como_montar: Muted blue semi-opaque rectangle with white bold text and a dark dashed outline, placed in the open space above each bar pair ('+43,9%'), or as a sentence box inside a chart area ('Cancer represents ~9% of the claims').
pecas.serve_para: Before/after bars, chart with one key takeaway.

pecas.nome: Rounded value pills on line points
pecas.o_que_faz: Removes the y-axis and turns each data point into a readable label in its series colour.
pecas.como_montar: Small rounded-rect label centred on every point, filled with the series colour, white text; no y-axis or gridlines, only the x baseline; smooth lines pass behind the pills. Same pill convention on bars.
pecas.serve_para: Line charts with 5-15 points and 2 series.

pecas.nome: Hatched exclusion on a score map
pecas.o_que_faz: Separates markets out of scope (home region) from those scored low, a difference grey alone would not show.
pecas.como_montar: Choropleth in a white-to-red scale; home countries filled with diagonal hatching; no-data grey; slim gradient legend Low to High. Adjacent card lists scoring criteria.
pecas.serve_para: Screening maps; any heatmap with a not applicable class.

pecas.nome: Dashed rounded bracket with a verdict on its edge
pecas.o_que_faz: Groups part of a chart and states the group's reading, keeping the remainder outside as the contrast.
pecas.como_montar: Grey dashed rounded rectangle around selected bars, passing below the axis; bold statement seated inside the top, with number in red, often breaking the dashes; bars outside stay grey.
pecas.serve_para: Selected years or categories in any bar chart.

pecas.nome: Pill data labels
pecas.o_que_faz: Makes chart labels part of the identity and readable over bars and lines.
pecas.como_montar: Rounded rectangles with white text: pale cyan centred on bars and navy on line points, sitting on the mark instead of above it. Intelbras caps each bar top with the pill. Applied to every chart throughout the deck.
pecas.serve_para: Combo charts with two series

pecas.nome: Tinted dashed window over bars
pecas.o_que_faz: Isolates the period that matters while keeping the full series visible.
pecas.como_montar: Rounded rectangle with pale tint at about 15% and dashed blue outline placed behind or over two to four bars; a small tinted note sits at its corner, overlapping the edge.
pecas.serve_para: Post-event windows and forecast periods

pecas.nome: Formula chip pinned to a waterfall
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows the arithmetic of an adjustment right where it changes the chart.
pecas.como_montar: Shadowed pale chip across the top of the chart with 'WACC: 11,7% + 3,0% = 14,7%', result in bold accent, with a bold heading ('Size premium') above and a tick to the bar.
pecas.serve_para: WACC builds, adjustments, bridge charts.

pecas.nome: Bracket to result chip
pecas.o_que_faz: Collapses a run of bars into one derived assumption.
pecas.como_montar: A black square bracket spans the bars; a dashed line runs from the bracket to a shadowed chip with a bold accent result ('g = 4,17%').
pecas.serve_para: Terminal growth, multi-year averages, implied assumptions.

pecas.nome: Holder table with IRR pills
pecas.o_que_faz: Answers 'why would they sell' under each seller's own position data.
pecas.como_montar: Thin outlined one-row table of share count by quarter; a thin vertical drop at each side reaches outlined pills under the table: 'IRR (Ex-InFinance)' and 'IRR (With InFinance)' joined by a line.
pecas.serve_para: Negotiating logic, counterparties' returns.

pecas.nome: Axis-break mark in a bar gap
pecas.o_que_faz: Separates unlike groups or signals a scale jump without needing an axis.
pecas.como_montar: Vertical light grey rule between bars interrupted by a pair of slanted short strokes; same double-slash splits horizontal rules on p31.
pecas.serve_para: Bars with mismatched groups; sectional dividers.

pecas.nome: Raw field research wall
pecas.o_que_faz: Unpolished screenshots and a PPE photo prove the fieldwork really occurred.
pecas.como_montar: White slide, unframed images with one caption each: call grids, a full iPhone call screen showing name and duration, tall photo of the team on the platform in orange gear.
pecas.serve_para: Appendix proof of access

pecas.nome: Browser-shell news cards, retyped
pecas.o_que_faz: Gets news into the slide clean and legible, without a pixelated screenshot.
pecas.como_montar: Grey rounded window with red, yellow, green dots at the top left and a red close dot at top right, blank address pill; white body with outlet logo, bold headline, regular subhead. Fully drawable.
pecas.serve_para: News and regulatory headlines

pecas.nome: Interview wall with tally band
pecas.o_que_faz: Proves the breadth of primary research at a glance and makes the count the headline.
pecas.como_montar: Lead interviewee card at left (Zoom grid, bold source, summary) joined by a line and thick tick to an open-right frame holding 8 Zoom screenshots with italic 'Name | Role' captions and one bold quote with accent tick; full-bleed accent band below with two huge numerals ('47 Employees Interviewed', '04 Different Countries').
pecas.serve_para: Management culture or qualitative thesis backed by many calls.

pecas.nome: Oversized research tally plate
pecas.o_que_faz: States the sample size as a title, before the reader sees any finding.
pecas.como_montar: Pale grey plate as wide as the column; accent numeral plus grey word at about 3x body size ('50 Orders 19 Interviewed', '23 Interviewed').
pecas.serve_para: Surveys, mystery shops, store checks.

pecas.nome: Mystery-shop experiment panel
pecas.o_que_faz: Presents an original experiment like a lab result, with data, physical proof and control conditions together.
pecas.como_montar: Grey panel: 3-row results table with competitor logos as row labels and the winning row in a dashed box; a one-line finding with accent deltas; two photos of the measurement (thermometer in a bottle); a side note in small italic behind a bracket line stating the controls ('same day, same time, same place').
pecas.serve_para: Any primary test: price checks, delivery times, product teardowns.

pecas.nome: Code screenshot as method proof
pecas.o_que_faz: Backs a soft claim with visible work by showing both the output and the script that made it.
pecas.como_montar: Two stacked images with italic labels 'Output' and 'Input': a black-and-white word cloud cropped hard at the edges, and a dark IDE screenshot below; each has a two-tone rule on top. Word cloud and script bleed off the right edge. Python scrape plus map on p124-125.
pecas.serve_para: Text mining of transcripts, web scraping, proprietary datasets.

pecas.nome: Office-visit interview block
pecas.o_que_faz: Combines proof of access with what the person said, and ties it to the deal order.
pecas.como_montar: Photo at the company reception, with diamond-tipped frame, next to name and role over a hairline. Oversized black quotation marks on both sides of the body. Above, a 1-2-3 stepper of funding stages in small square tags joined by hairlines; the same tags reappear on the cards at right.
pecas.serve_para: Management meetings that determine a structure

pecas.nome: Field research scoreboard with call screenshot
pecas.o_que_faz: Proves the sample size and shows the conversation really happened, then converts it into a single share.
pecas.como_montar: Dark panel: We went out on field and talked to 39 IFA offices, big number in light blue; below, logo rows linked by a thin line with a small X to a count; right, full video-call screenshot with the interviewee's logo and date on a dim strip across the top; from the panel a diamond leader drops to the finding and a 9% / 91% framed bar.
pecas.serve_para: Primary research summary: expert calls, store visits, surveys.

pecas.nome: Tap-by-tap product walkthrough
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows the analysts personally tested the product and counts the steps to the claim being made.
pecas.como_montar: Three phone screenshots on a baseline arrow running from a dark Current Account label to a dark Investments label; a hand-pointer icon over the tapped item; captions 1st Touch, 2nd Touch, You are now in the platform. Logos at both ends of the title rule. Pp. 94-95 use app-logo columns with screenshots and verdict lines.
pecas.serve_para: Product, UX or integration claims.

pecas.nome: Signed term sheets
pecas.o_que_faz: Makes a hypothetical deal feel executed, and adds team personality to dry bond terms.
pecas.como_montar: Three outlined term boxes with an underlined header and label-value rows. Below each, a row of three script signatures over hairlines with printed names. Project gets an italic code name in the title (Project Talos).
pecas.serve_para: Proposed financing, deal terms, M&A proposal

pecas.nome: News window with date, tied to the chart below
pecas.o_que_faz: Puts a dated headline right on top of the numbers it explains.
pecas.como_montar: Thin dark-outlined card with three small traffic-light dots, outlet logo top right, bold headline, Summary with a bullet, date bottom right. A pale funnel links down into the framed chart.
pecas.serve_para: Linking news to data

pecas.nome: Geo-heatmap proof page
pecas.o_que_faz: Turns a claim about reach into a map the team built, with rivals plotted as well.
pecas.como_montar: Two heatmap screenshots at city and metro scale, joined to outlined labels by a thin line with a diamond tip. Competitors marked as coloured stars with a small legend. To the right: dashed green boxes with 1.35 km and 4.7/5 KPIs above the code screenshot and caption.
pecas.serve_para: Footprint, capillarity, store-network analysis

pecas.nome: Word-frequency rows from earnings calls
pecas.o_que_faz: Proves a strategy shift from what management actually says.
pecas.como_montar: Dark code pane with bold vertical-rule caption, two small word and count tables by quarter, relevant rows wrapped in dashed boxes colour-coded by theme with a matching mini legend.
pecas.serve_para: Management narrative shifts; earnings call analysis

pecas.nome: Code to feed to verdict triptych
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows method, raw material and result left to right, so a homemade sentiment figure feels credible.
pecas.como_montar: Dark code pane full height; phone mockup with a mock feed of posts; donut with platform logo in its hole; dashed takeaway box beneath.
pecas.serve_para: Social listening, scraping, ML side analysis

pecas.nome: Primary-research counter band
pecas.o_que_faz: Quantifies the fieldwork and shows real faces, right where the claim is made.
pecas.como_montar: Dark full-width band; big accent numbers with labels (2 directors, 6 employees, 29 ex-staff) on the left; video-call screenshots with date and interviewee name beneath.
pecas.serve_para: Field research summaries

pecas.nome: Survey question to yes/no bar
pecas.o_que_faz: Connects the exact question to the answer.
pecas.como_montar: Dashed box with quoted question, hand-drawn curved arrow into a two-segment bar with value and label inside each part; two large-number sentences give n below. A vertical line links the box up to the counter that sourced it.
pecas.serve_para: Single-question primary surveys

pecas.nome: Field test: phone with leaders into findings
pecas.o_que_faz: Lets the reader follow the test the team ran on the product: screen, finding, supporting fine print, call log.
pecas.como_montar: Large phone with a real screenshot; solid leader from the phone to dashed finding box; dashed cyan leader from the app's button to matching cyan frame around fee table in a rounded panel; second phone showing 15 call-log entries.
pecas.serve_para: Mystery shopping, product tests
