pecas.nome: Chat bubbles as customer evidence
pecas.o_que_faz: Uses unedited customer messages as qualitative data with a tally beside.
pecas.como_montar: Dark pill with the question, dotted diamond leader to a key stat; cropped grey bubbles with avatar scattered on white; L-shadow card of three icon themes summarising mentions.
pecas.serve_para: Customer interviews by message

pecas.nome: Field-trip selfie on a location band
pecas.o_que_faz: Places the analysts physically at the asset, in one small corner.
pecas.como_montar: Navy band from the left edge under the chart area, with italic place name and white pin icon. The photo rounded and navy-outlined, overlapping the band end and rising above it.
pecas.serve_para: Site visits, store checks, plant tours

pecas.nome: Hands-on platform test
pecas.o_que_faz: Replaces opinion with an experiment the team ran on the product itself.
pecas.como_montar: Screenshot of the real dashboard in a rounded frame with a navy title bar, "Mercado Libre website printscreen", bleeding right. Over the top of the screenshot, two outlined white boxes restate the key figures in large type ("41 > 6", "ACOS = 5.9%"). Left: dashed box with up arrow and 35.4%, then conclusion sentence.
pecas.serve_para: Product tests, mystery shopping, pricing experiments

pecas.nome: Survey source chip
pecas.o_que_faz: Marks a chart as proprietary research and gives sample size at a glance.
pecas.como_montar: Google Forms purple icon overlapping a grey rounded plate with "467 answers". Place it beside the chart next to a dashed box enclosing the bars that matter; those bars switch to the accent colour. Intelbras adds an outlined bubble: "59+ responses from active resellers".
pecas.serve_para: Own surveys and field polls

pecas.nome: Code screenshot as receipt
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows how a claim was produced, with the code placed next to the result.
pecas.como_montar: Dark rounded editor screenshot beside the output. In ML p7, a five-row ranking of words from shareholder letters: rank square, pill with word and count, top pill yellow, rest navy; column headers Nº, Transcript, Q, Python script. A novel metric that needs little space.
pecas.serve_para: Text mining, scraped datasets, custom models

pecas.nome: Book cover as authority
pecas.o_que_faz: Borrows a known framework by showing the cover next to the quote it supports.
pecas.como_montar: Cover image at quote height, sometimes poking above the plate. Grey plate with justified quote and key words in navy bold; navy strip underneath saying what the idea means for this company. ML p68 extends this to a tall panel (crop b2_ml_book_panel.png) with author tag and two quotes.
pecas.serve_para: Framework citations such as Seven Powers, Good to Great, Outsiders

pecas.nome: Stacked video-call screenshots
pecas.o_que_faz: Proves that primary interviews happened, using the raw look of the call as credibility.
pecas.como_montar: Two or three Zoom screenshots overlapped in a cluster, with a navy flag rectangle poking out at the top-left of each. Set in a grey panel with left navy rail and notch, the quote in italics below. Sabesp p66 uses one larger centred call over a tinted quote band.
pecas.serve_para: Expert calls, management calls, employee interviews

pecas.nome: Python logo as method stamp
pecas.o_que_faz: Signals analysis built by the team rather than sourced, without a sentence of explanation.
pecas.como_montar: Small Python logo, sometimes on a white rounded tile, in the corner of a map or next to a caption, as a stamp of provenance. Works best with a one-line caption such as "MELI Distribution Centers Heatmap" on a navy panel.
pecas.serve_para: Self-built maps, regressions and scraped data

pecas.nome: Timed transaction race with phones
pecas.o_que_faz: Turns a claim about efficiency into a measured stopwatch test against the rival.
pecas.como_montar: Two tinted bars behind phones; numbered circles on each phone = steps; stopwatch icon plus big time at the bar's end; grey tag beneath states auth steps; floating note translates the gap into a yearly cost for the user.
pecas.serve_para: App UX, onboarding, process comparisons

pecas.nome: Pin density map with code overlay
pecas.o_que_faz: Layers proprietary analysis on a city: income choropleth and bank presence.
pecas.como_montar: Purple tonal blobs from a custom geo analysis; black map pins sized by branch concentration; pin legend stacked by size; rounded dark code panel with brand-tinted Python badge at its corner; gradient scale strip below.
pecas.serve_para: Geo white space, store network, proprietary analysis

pecas.nome: Real paperwork as exhibit
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows the incumbent's actual paper form so the word legacy needs no adjectives.
pecas.como_montar: Accent pill header; form screenshot tall at left; violet vertical rule; row of logos with three bold-lead findings at right.
pecas.serve_para: Regulatory filings, forms, contracts, price lists

pecas.nome: Pin census on a real street map
pecas.o_que_faz: Field-style proof of the store-density claim by counting competitors on two real neighbourhood maps.
pecas.como_montar: Google Maps screenshot with hand-placed pins coloured per chain; legend plate at left repeating those pin colours; a dashed note at right states the single reading, Just one RD Store in that poor area. Page 14 shows the rich neighbourhood for contrast.
pecas.serve_para: Retail footprint, capillarity, white space in any local market.

pecas.nome: Browser-chrome news card
pecas.o_que_faz: Makes a press headline look like live evidence and can be built without any screenshot.
pecas.como_montar: Grey rounded panel with red, yellow, green dots at top-left and a red dot at right; white pill with the URL; white card with outlet logo centered, bold headline and one-line standfirst retyped as live text. Beam into it from a chart bar is already catalogued; this entry is the card itself.
pecas.serve_para: Press events, regulatory changes, contract terminations.

pecas.nome: Stack of phone call screens
pecas.o_que_faz: Documents anonymised calls while protecting identities, since the screens show only labels such as BK Florida 21.
pecas.como_montar: Four iPhone call-screen mockups in two overlapping pairs, screen text naming chain and region only, next to a large sentence with the count and a red phrase; a divider rule with a grey chevron disc leads to what was found.
pecas.serve_para: Calls with sources who cannot be named.

pecas.nome: Phone mockup holding proprietary data
pecas.o_que_faz: Puts scraped app-store data inside the phone it refers to, so the source and the numbers read as one object.
pecas.como_montar: Phone outline drawn as a shape cropped by the card base; app logo, bell icon, red headline, then a grey rounded panel with a 2x2 grid of white stat tiles with icon, number, label; a pale teal takeaway box overlaps the bottom of the phone and card; card header Field evidence, Proprietary scraping.
pecas.serve_para: App usage, reviews, scraped digital metrics. The phone is drawable; only the logo is real.

pecas.nome: One-line headline strips
pecas.o_que_faz: Offers press evidence in the smallest possible space.
pecas.como_montar: Thin outlined rows, each with bold headline at left, short date and tiny outlet logo at right; 3 stacked with even gaps.
pecas.serve_para: Market chatter, buyer signals, precedent news.

pecas.nome: News card with overlapping source stamp
pecas.o_que_faz: Summarises an article in your words while keeping its source and date visible.
pecas.como_montar: Accent outlined box; dark band with bold white headline; white plate with outlet wordmark overlapping the band's right end and the frame; 'Summary:' with 2 bullets; bold italic date bottom-right. On p25 a tapered connector ties it to a 'Sell Side Analysis at the Time' panel of three attributed numbers.
pecas.serve_para: Deal history and press-sourced facts.

pecas.nome: Field selfie grid with on-photo credit
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows the team physically went to the field, and names each source.
pecas.como_montar: Grid of 2x3 tight portrait photos with no border; white italic 'Name | Employer' overlaid at the bottom of each; a large italic pull quote takes the last two cells so the grid and the quote read as one block.
pecas.serve_para: Store visits, couriers, channel checks, customer interviews.

pecas.nome: Book cover as authority prop
pecas.o_que_faz: Grounds a framework in a recognised source and then maps it to the company's portfolio.
pecas.como_montar: Book cover in a thin-line frame, overlapping a dark text band; below, each archetype name sits on a thick accent rule that runs into a dashed box with the brand name; a dashed elbow ties the middle row back to the book.
pecas.serve_para: Framework slides with a named academic or popular source.

pecas.nome: People-we-spoke-to appendix page
pecas.o_que_faz: Gives every marquee interview its own proof page to pull up during Q&A.
pecas.como_montar: Large cut-out portrait bottom-left on a pale band, name and title behind a dark tick, Zoom screenshot with soft shadow at right; repeats one person per slide in the appendix.
pecas.serve_para: Q&A backup for primary research claims.

pecas.nome: Provenance stamp on quotes
pecas.o_que_faz: Dates and sources each quote so it reads as a logged interview rather than decoration.
pecas.como_montar: Small logo, thin vertical bar, bold line Conversation happened on 04/03, then a black diamond with a thin line leading to the speaker's portrait.
pecas.serve_para: Any interview quote; cheap to apply if the interview is real.

pecas.nome: Store-visit photo strip
pecas.o_que_faz: Backs a survey with evidence of fieldwork at the point of sale.
pecas.como_montar: Four same-size portrait photos in a row with small gutters, no captions, directly under the argument that they support, and next to the survey chart and a reseller quote.
pecas.serve_para: Channel checks

pecas.nome: Book cover as evidence exhibit
pecas.o_que_faz: Cites a source object, and the box summarises what it says.
pecas.como_montar: Dashed accent box; book cover at left, accent heading, short numbered ledger with bold key words at right.
pecas.serve_para: Founder memoir, letters, reports

pecas.nome: Event proof card
pecas.o_que_faz: Proves direct access to management with a photo and a thank-you note.
pecas.como_montar: Card (modal state on the previous slide): dashed-frame photo at left, right has uppercase name, role, dated italic account, two logos, asterisked thanks. Inserted on click from the executive's slide.
pecas.serve_para: Management meetings, site visits

pecas.nome: School logos on a board roster
pecas.o_que_faz: Turns education into a scan-ready credential row.
pecas.como_montar: Row of university logos labelled Schools above the portrait cluster, with name and short bio lines at right in a grey band. Low-res crop.
pecas.serve_para: Board and management pages

pecas.nome: Source letter pinned beside its formula
pecas.o_que_faz: Credits where a calculation came from and gives its formula at once.
pecas.como_montar: Rounded pale tile holding a shareholder letter page; black band below with a typeset formula in white; highlighted result row in the table at the left.
pecas.serve_para: Appendix method slides

pecas.nome: Call screenshot with insight caption
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows the actual analyst or IR call, app chrome included, with the takeaway directly attached.
pecas.como_montar: Name and role as subhead; uncropped Teams or Zoom window including the toolbar and Leave button; grey plate directly under the image with Insights: and the quote. P.76 uses a single screen centred over a plinth and quote.
pecas.serve_para: Appendix proof of expert calls.

pecas.nome: Oversized mac-window headlines
pecas.o_que_faz: Makes a headline the main content of a modal slide, with outlet branding as the window header.
pecas.como_montar: Big grey rounded window, traffic-light dots drawn as shapes, outlet logo on its brand colour strip, headline in very large type on white, date under it at right; two windows side by side.
pecas.serve_para: Risk or catalyst slides driven by press events. Needs outlet logos.

pecas.nome: Field-visit selfie strip
pecas.o_que_faz: Makes the visit count feel lived by showing analysts with staff in the kitchens.
pecas.como_montar: Tightly tiled selfies with no gaps, in decreasing width left to right, ending in small stacked tiles; a red rule on left and base; under it a sentence with the count in bold (10 kitchens, 28 employees) and three Roman-numeral findings.
pecas.serve_para: Store, plant or site visits.

pecas.nome: Browser-window news cards
pecas.o_que_faz: Presents two dated headlines as a before and after story, joined by a double chevron.
pecas.como_montar: White card with soft shadow; three small red dots and a white address pill holding the outlet name; quoted headline with bold keywords; grey date bottom right; pale double chevron between cards.
pecas.serve_para: News as sequence of events; drawable, no screenshot needed.

pecas.nome: Incident photo log
pecas.o_que_faz: Makes operating risk concrete by dating real events in pictures.
pecas.como_montar: Four pairs of news photos in a 2x2 layout, each with a bold event headline above and month tag beside it. Page 62 then dims it behind a band asking what the company is doing about it. Low-res crop from the contact sheet.
pecas.serve_para: Risk sections, accidents, ESG incidents

pecas.nome: News app masthead on a clipping
pecas.o_que_faz: Gives a quoted article the look of a real app, not simply a text box.
pecas.como_montar: Dark gradient bar with spaced italic outlet name, magnifier and hamburger icons at right; beneath it, a clipping with bold quoted headline, body and date. The torn lower edge is already catalogued; this entry is the masthead.
pecas.serve_para: News evidence where no screenshot is available.

pecas.nome: Bond identity card
pecas.o_que_faz: Documents the debt input as a registry record.
pecas.como_montar: White shadow card styled like a registry: code in bold with a small pill for the law, then grey label and value rows.
pecas.serve_para: Debenture or instrument reference

pecas.nome: Expert dossier stack
pecas.o_que_faz: Establishes who is speaking, what method they bring and what they said, in one column.
pecas.como_montar: Top down: cut-out portrait at left over a pale plate that holds a method-vs-method comparison; credential with a thick dark tick ('Professor at Columbia University' bold, name regular); dark band with white quote, key phrase in accent, italic source below. The breakout of the portrait is already catalogued as depth; this entry is the information order.
pecas.serve_para: Authority framing for a method or thesis, CEO or founder views.

pecas.nome: Pennant plate into 'we asked' cards
pecas.o_que_faz: Turns one interview into a structured takeaway: pillars said, then specific questions and answers.
pecas.como_montar: Long hairline with a small elongated-hexagon bead joins the photo side to a pale plate with three accent words split by vertical rules; the plate's base tapers to a shallow point; a line with another bead drops to a dashed frame captioned 'We asked Jorge Paulo about...' holding three equal cards with accent headings.
pecas.serve_para: Writing up a marquee interview without quoting paragraphs.

pecas.nome: Video still wired to quote card
pecas.o_que_faz: Links speaker and statement with a drawn connector rather than simple adjacency.
pecas.como_montar: Interview still in a thin blue frame; hairline with diamond tip runs from its right edge to an outlined quote card with bold name, grey role, bold key terms, centred text. Small diamonds at frame corners.
pecas.serve_para: Expert interviews placed beside charts they explain

pecas.nome: Alternating pentagon quote ribbons with round portraits
pecas.o_que_faz: Stages two interview quotes as a back-and-forth, each pointing the opposite way.
pecas.como_montar: Two pale full-bleed bands with one pointed end, first bleeding off right and pointing left, second bleeding off left and pointing right, in different tints; round portrait overlapping the flat end; key phrases in accent blue; attribution right aligned in grey.
pecas.serve_para: Two or three contrasting quotes from experts or customers.

pecas.nome: Dated call stamp above a quote
pecas.o_que_faz: Gives an interview the authority of a logged record.
pecas.como_montar: Dark full-width strip with uppercase date, time and participants; below, justified quote with bold key phrases between small double-quote marks at each side.
pecas.serve_para: Expert calls; a photo-free interview

pecas.nome: Video-call grid and transcript card
pecas.o_que_faz: Pairs a real interview capture with the sentence used.
pecas.como_montar: Bordered pale card; 2x2 meeting screenshot at left; quote with bold key clauses and centred name and title at right, placed under the subhead that it supports.
pecas.serve_para: Executive interviews

pecas.nome: Anonymized quote with blurred portrait
pecas.o_que_faz: Keeps a sensitive quote human while showing the source's anonymity was protected.
pecas.como_montar: Grey panel; portrait in diamond crop heavily gaussian blurred, next to quote with highlighted sentence; named speakers alternate sides; footnote says anonymity was preserved on request.
pecas.serve_para: Ex-employee and expert interviews

pecas.nome: Name-tab analyst block
pecas.o_que_faz: Quotes a sell-side or industry expert with a visible call as proof it took place.
pecas.como_montar: Pale grey panel; white shadowed name tab straddling its top edge ('Caio Rocha, Bradesco BBI HC Analyst'); small Zoom screenshot centered under it; centered quote with two phrases in accent.
pecas.serve_para: Expert calls, sell-side commentary placed beside a chart.

pecas.nome: Quotes bookending a timeline
pecas.o_que_faz: Lets the buyer and the target speak to each other across the track record.
pecas.como_montar: Ribbon timeline in the centre. Left end: cut-out portrait of one CEO with quote plate; right end: the other CEO, mirrored. Final node recoloured from purple to the subject colour, with its label in matching bold, so it reads as the next case in the series.
pecas.serve_para: Acquirer track records, turnaround precedents

pecas.nome: Video-grid quote card
pecas.o_que_faz: Compresses a call into a small corner card that gives proof of the call and the quote without taking over the slide.
pecas.como_montar: Pale rounded card bleeding off the right edge; left: one large and five small rounded video stills with accent borders; quote mark in accent and justified text with bold and pink emphasis; dark full-width name bar at the base; meeting-app logo at top right of the card.
pecas.serve_para: A supporting quote beside a chart.

pecas.nome: Quote card with photo, firm and spine
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows the source, their firm, and the team with them, then a quote that reads like testimony.
pecas.como_montar: Thin frame with a dark angular spine at left; top row with team-and-source photo, name and italic role, firm logo at right; rule; large slanted black quote marks in both top corners; grey text with bold key sentence; generous line spacing.
pecas.serve_para: Legal, regulatory, industry expert testimony.

pecas.nome: Thick frame portrait bonded to quote panel
pecas.o_que_faz: A consistent quote module whose frame colour can follow the speaker's brand.
pecas.como_montar: Pale tint rounded panel; at its right, portrait in a white rounded square with thick accent border overlapping the edge; quote with bold phrase, right-aligned italic name.
pecas.serve_para: All quotes; repeat through the deck

pecas.nome: Quote as root of a branching rationale
pecas.o_que_faz: Uses an investor's quote to justify an awkward call (Hold despite downside), then lists the reasons as branches.
pecas.como_montar: Saturated panel with quote and team statement; a dark green vertical line from its lower-left corner with three horizontal branches to Roman-numbered reasons.
pecas.serve_para: Defending a non-obvious rating.

pecas.nome: CEO portrait with dashed dossier
pecas.o_que_faz: Attaches a leader's strategic view directly to their photo.
pecas.como_montar: Large framed portrait with a coloured outline; to its right a dashed tinted box continuing the top edge of the frame with name and italic tenure; a dashed line descends and branches with small diamonds to bold-led points; KPI rings beneath.
pecas.serve_para: Founder and CEO profiles tied to a capital allocation thesis.

pecas.nome: Verdict T-bracket: price to target to upside to IRR
pecas.o_que_faz: Reads the recommendation as a derivation rather than a claim.
pecas.como_montar: Light card on dark. Pill BUY at top. Horizontal I-beam between current and target price with bold numbers and small labels; vertical capped stem drops to upside; second capped stem to IRR. Result figures in accent. On the chart, dashed target line ends in a small price tag.
pecas.serve_para: Recommendation slide

pecas.nome: Formula with oversized operators to result table
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows inputs flowing into results, so calculation looks like a machine instead of a table.
pecas.como_montar: Grey L-shadow blocks; values in plain weight; big operator glyphs in accent (+, x, =) drawn as shapes; result with bold name below; arrow from Beta to a source label; large triangle pointing to a striped result table with bold WACC row.
pecas.serve_para: WACC, Ke, any equation with real inputs

pecas.nome: Barrel unit economics stack
pecas.o_que_faz: Maps the P&L to a physical unit of product.
pecas.como_montar: Drawn barrel icon with a fill level next to a stack of four rounded rows: revenue per barrel dark, costs mid, net income in light accent, keeping height equal.
pecas.serve_para: Unit economics: per barrel, ton, customer, store

pecas.nome: Giant-number equation strip
pecas.o_que_faz: Turns a derived metric into one line of arithmetic that can be read from the back of the room.
pecas.como_montar: Dashed top and bottom rule, or dashed box; 3-4 oversized bold accent numbers with dark operators between; small italic caption below each term. Rede D'Or p39 uses the same logic for EV - debt + cash - provision = equity.
pecas.serve_para: Moat years, working capital, EV bridge, any metric with 2-4 inputs.

pecas.nome: Partial-fill square rating
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows survey scores as a rating that reads faster than a table and looks like raw field data.
pecas.como_montar: Five squares in a row, the last filled proportionally (4.1 = four solid plus a 10% sliver over pale grey), score at the right; each row led by the survey question with accent keywords; a dashed elbow with a tick links to an italic field note on a pale plate.
pecas.serve_para: Primary survey results, NPS-like scores, app reviews.

pecas.nome: Logo rows on a social-class ruler
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows each company's addressable class band, turning logos into a positioning scale.
pecas.como_montar: Column headers C-, C+, B-, B+, A-, A+ in bold; thin vertical gridlines; logos as row labels; thick accent line with circular end caps from lowest to highest class served.
pecas.serve_para: Positioning: price tiers, income classes, customer sizes.

pecas.nome: Logo timeline by decade
pecas.o_que_faz: Makes entry waves of foreign brands visible at a glance as a wall of logos standing on a time axis.
pecas.como_montar: Horizontal arrow with dot at start and bold decade labels beneath; three logos stacked above each decade; a bracket from the arrow's end feeds two call-outs, one with the survivor rate and one with the exceptions as logos.
pecas.serve_para: Entrants, competitors, acquisitions, product launches.

pecas.nome: Verdict frame with bracketed upside
pecas.o_que_faz: Delivers rating, prices and upside in one ruled composition that reads left to right, with the three theses directly below as the reason.
pecas.como_montar: Thin white rectangle with small X marks cut into both vertical sides; Recommendation in light tracked type; BUY in bold green on a dark green block; current price left, target right, joined by a line with end ticks broken by 52% UPSIDE in green; below, a lighter full-width band with 01 02 03 thin numerals and X separators.
pecas.serve_para: Opening recommendation slide.

pecas.nome: Hatched maturity strip with texture legend
pecas.o_que_faz: Separates not amortizing from amortizing by texture so the bullet maturity jumps out on a dark field.
pecas.como_montar: One row per tranche, one rounded cell per year under a year header. Cells filled with diagonal hatch pattern; final year is a dark gradient cell with red outline. Small key underneath.
pecas.serve_para: Debt ladder, vesting, contract or capex schedules

pecas.nome: Ownership wires with capped percentages
pecas.o_que_faz: Percent stakes sit on the line they describe, so the chart reads without a table.
pecas.como_montar: Rectangular logo boxes with thin border; orthogonal lines; each stake is text interrupting the line, held between two short horizontal caps like an I-beam. Lines change colour by ownership path.
pecas.serve_para: Shareholder and corporate structures

pecas.nome: Decision range bar with ringed outcome
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows where a price landed inside its range in one line.
pecas.como_montar: Framed red-edged strip at the bottom: bold label, low number inside a dotted oval, tapered arrow line to high number. An elbow connector from the chart gap leads to it.
pecas.serve_para: IPO pricing, guidance range, target range

pecas.nome: Map pinned to a share bar by stems
pecas.o_que_faz: Connects geography to its numeric weight without a legend.
pecas.como_montar: Filled state silhouette above a segmented bar (SP 72%, RJ 28%); from each region a thin vertical stem falls to its segment and ends in a small foot cap.
pecas.serve_para: Concentration by region: landbank, revenue, store base.

pecas.nome: Return ladder under a formula band
pecas.o_que_faz: Sets the exit math in the header, then adds up what makes up the IRR as a stepped list.
pecas.como_montar: Dark gradient band with exit year, fair P/E, arrow, and the fraction drawn as text over a rule; beneath, grey parallelograms of decreasing width on a blue vertical thread, each joined by a thin line to a framed value box on a second thread; the final parallelogram solid dark, value box in blue.
pecas.serve_para: IRR or TSR decomposition, sum-of-parts summaries.

pecas.nome: Award rosette panel
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows external recognition as a compact trophy case.
pecas.como_montar: Thick green rectangle. Each row: awarding-body logo, line rosette with "1st" in green, year and category.
pecas.serve_para: Rankings, awards, certifications

pecas.nome: Director handover ledger
pecas.o_que_faz: Turns management turnover across peers into one scannable pattern.
pecas.como_montar: Rows split by dashed lines; brand wordmark at left as row label; outgoing name and dates, dotted arrow, incoming name and year; columns right-aligned to the arrow.
pecas.serve_para: Peer leadership change, supplier switches, any A-to-B ledger.

pecas.nome: Severity roundel problem-solution table
pecas.o_que_faz: Rates each problem and maps it to the fix and consequence in a single line.
pecas.como_montar: Dark header table: first column a ring-in-disc (red or amber fill, navy outer ring, white hole), then weakness, why it matters, solution, implication; rules only, no fills.
pecas.serve_para: Deal rationale, target fit, strategic gaps.

pecas.nome: Own score ruler with logo tokens
pecas.o_que_faz: Publishes a self-built metric with its criteria and rubric alongside the result.
pecas.como_montar: Grey track with dashed ticks 0 to 4; circular logo tokens placed by score, target highlighted by a thin window around a tie; dashed elbow from the dark method banner; criteria as grey chips and 1 to 4 rubric at right.
pecas.serve_para: Team-built scoring: UX, product, governance

pecas.nome: Star-rating scorecard with logos
pecas.o_que_faz: Makes the employee-satisfaction ranking readable at a glance using a familiar symbol.
pecas.como_montar: Rows of logo plus five outlined stars, filled in yellow to the exact fraction of the score. Source logo (Glassdoor) top right; numeric scores in a tall dashed rounded column headed SCORE in navy italics.
pecas.serve_para: Glassdoor, app ratings, Reclame Aqui, customer reviews

pecas.nome: Formula with direction arrows
pecas.o_que_faz: Explains a ratio's move by marking which term moved, not just the result.
pecas.como_montar: Typeset fraction (MLR(%) = Claims / Premiums) in math italics with a small coloured vertical arrow beside the term that changes, down in one state, up in the next; one formula per bullet of the phase.
pecas.serve_para: Margin mechanics, ROIC trees, explaining a KPI's shift by regime.

pecas.nome: Logo-as-CV clusters
pecas.o_que_faz: Summarises a board's experience as sectors and former employers instead of biographies.
pecas.como_montar: Dashed boxes grouped by skill (Finance, Healthcare, Marketing, Insurances) with a bold heading and 2-4 logos each, placed around a central image of the board; the chair named above with their former employers' logos beside the head of the table. The seated-table scene is already catalogued; this entry is the clusters.
pecas.serve_para: Board and management quality without biography paragraphs.

pecas.nome: Staircase cohort heatmap
pecas.o_que_faz: Aligns acquisitions on years since purchase to show a repeatable pattern.
pecas.como_montar: Grid with rows per asset and columns Year +0 to +9; cells shade by value and rows stop at their last year, forming a stair. The empty corner holds an outlined callout (Average -2.9% per year) with code thumbnail and Python logo. Colour scale at right.
pecas.serve_para: Acquisition cohorts, vintages, post-deal tracking

pecas.nome: Dashed year-logo ticker
pecas.o_que_faz: Compresses a deal history into a single band and groups same-year deals.
pecas.como_montar: Full-width solid band with a darker title block at left; thin dashed white frames each holding a bold white year above a logo on a translucent backing; several deals share one wider frame; p51 reuses the band for ownership milestones.
pecas.serve_para: M&A history, ownership history, product launches.

pecas.nome: Company coin to proof token rows
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows each buyer's thesis-fit item with a compact proof: the logic line goes from the target to a piece of evidence.
pecas.como_montar: Investor header band with logo, AUM at right; rows are pale rounded strips with bold lead-in at left; at right, a logo coin connected by a thin dashed line to a token: flag, dotted-circle map, or KPI chip, with some rows using coin trios for portfolio companies.
pecas.serve_para: Buyer universe, thesis fit, partner or exit analysis.

pecas.nome: Nash payoff grid
pecas.o_que_faz: Turns a competitive-response argument into a small game theory table with the equilibrium lit.
pecas.como_montar: 3x3 grid of rounded white tiles with grey border; row and column strategies as plain labels; each cell holds bold own payoff over italic rival payoff; the equilibrium cell solid dark magenta with a pale halo plate; note with a coloured dot legend below, Nash = Cautious, Accommodate.
pecas.serve_para: Entry decisions, price wars, competitor reactions.

pecas.nome: One-of-seven seat outcome with signature row
pecas.o_que_faz: Makes a deal structure feel signed: the clause result is one huge phrase, and the team literally sign it.
pecas.como_montar: Illustration of a meeting at left, note card at right, small chevron down to a pale tile with 1 of 7 in huge bold; below, five handwritten signatures on thin rules with italic names. A term sheet card with Roman-numbered clauses sits alongside.
pecas.serve_para: Deal, governance and private-equity pitches. Team signature images required.

pecas.nome: Risk cards priced in IRR
pecas.o_que_faz: Ties each risk matrix code to the assumption stressed and the effect on returns, so risk is quantified instead of described.
pecas.como_montar: Grid of pale squares on two axes, a few filled with colour by type and carrying codes such as E1, M1; at right, same-colour code tiles head row cards with three parts: description, stress assumption, IRR with a red down triangle and points lost. Restaurant Brands p.48 does the same in a table with an Impact column (pp. seen only as thumbnail).
pecas.serve_para: Risk slide in any valuation pitch.

pecas.nome: Pre/post cap table tree
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows the change of ownership per step, including who sold, with the same tree before and after.
pecas.como_montar: Two identical trees separated by a large thin chevron; holder boxes with logo in a row on top, lines into the company below; % chips sit on the lines; pale tabs 1st Step and 2nd Step above the boxes they affect; on the Post side, chips turn accent and carry 'plus or minus delta' labels beside them.
pecas.serve_para: Deal structuring, shareholder changes, spin-offs.

pecas.nome: Triangular exit table with an embedded KPI row
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows every exit year's cash flow while making one year the recommendation.
pecas.como_montar: Staircase table of cash flows with a year per row and last-column MOIC and IRR behind a vertical rule; the chosen row expands to full width in glowing tint with accent values; its empty cells on the right hold inline KPIs (22.0% Final Stake, 10,315 Buyout, 9.0x EV/EBITDA) and a logo mark stamped on top.
pecas.serve_para: Exit timing, IRR tables, hold-period analysis.

pecas.nome: Bull, house, bear ringed icons
pecas.o_que_faz: Gives three scenarios a mascot so they are recalled later.
pecas.como_montar: Double-ring circle with line icon on top of each card (bull, house, bear), then scenario name in bold and light, then parallel bullets with bold first word.
pecas.serve_para: Scenario definitions

pecas.nome: Perception map with attribute vectors
pecas.o_que_faz: Places brands against consumer attributes so that a claim like 'little overlap' becomes visible.
pecas.como_montar: Grey panel with heavy cross axes (HEAVY/LIGHT, BUDGET/PREMIUM); thin grey arrows radiating from the centre to italic attribute words; accent dots with brand names; accent title tab at the top-left corner and short accent ticks on the panel's bottom edge.
pecas.serve_para: Brand positioning, cannibalisation, competitive whitespace.

pecas.nome: Logo-stem M&A timeline
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows a company's consolidation history through the brands it absorbed, without any text.
pecas.como_montar: Thick accent timeline with black dots; black stems alternate above and below with logos stacked at the ends, year labels hugging the line; merged-entity logos sit directly on the line where they form.
pecas.serve_para: Roll-ups, brand history, deal chronologies.

pecas.nome: Logo wall as portfolio evidence
pecas.o_que_faz: Conveys portfolio breadth by sheer density rather than a count.
pecas.como_montar: Dashed rectangle packed with 30-odd logos in 4 tight rows and no gaps; the bottom row uses filled colour tiles to change the texture.
pecas.serve_para: Brand portfolios, client lists, investor bases.

pecas.nome: Stake exit tree with logos
pecas.o_que_faz: Explains who sold what to whom in a glance.
pecas.como_montar: Dashed context box on top; dashed bracket joins it to stacked logo tiles; dashed lines carrying percent labels converge on a single buyer logo tile.
pecas.serve_para: M&A precedent and deal history

pecas.nome: Logo-header scorecard with target column
pecas.o_que_faz: Compares returns across peers using logos, with the target's column isolated.
pecas.como_montar: Horizon rows (1M to 5Y) by brand columns with logos as headers; gold dashed box around the target column, including its logo; last column average with green and red text.
pecas.serve_para: Peer performance, comps summaries.

pecas.nome: Logo-labelled slider rows
pecas.o_que_faz: Replaces a bar chart with sliders that echo an app interface, each coloured in the rival's brand.
pecas.como_montar: Thin grey track, brand-colour fill, dark knob at the value, logo at left, score at right, on a card.
pecas.serve_para: Peer ratings, app scores

pecas.nome: Multiples as beads on a track
pecas.o_que_faz: Lets you find the subject's rank among peers quickly, without a table or bars.
pecas.como_montar: Thick grey rounded track, evenly spaced brand-colour dots in rank order, value above, logo under; dashed metric label at left. Ordinal not to scale.
pecas.serve_para: Trading comps with many logos

pecas.nome: Logos as scatter points
pecas.o_que_faz: Peers are read directly with no lookup.
pecas.como_montar: Small dark dot plus adjacent logo in place of a text label, dotted trendline, R-squared in corner, subject has an oversized colour dot and larger logo.
pecas.serve_para: Comps regressions, satisfaction vs. rating

pecas.nome: Brand-coloured dot coverage matrix
pecas.o_que_faz: Gives breadth of offering as a density pattern and a total to compare.
pecas.como_montar: Logo column headers on alternating pale column bands; product rows at left; dot in each company's brand colour where offered, none where not; dark total bar at the bottom. Check variant on p112.
pecas.serve_para: Ecosystem or product coverage

pecas.nome: Logo scatter
pecas.o_que_faz: Lets the reader name competitors without a legend or labels.
pecas.como_montar: Plain scatter, tiny navy dots, each logo floating right above its dot. Keep gridlines off. ML p152 varies this with tinted quadrant labels and country names.
pecas.serve_para: Positioning maps

pecas.nome: Icon-and-logo matrix table
pecas.o_que_faz: Replaces headers with recognisable marks, making a dull table instantly identifiable.
pecas.como_montar: Navy first column with white-backed brand marks on each row; App Store and Play Store icons as column headers; light grey body cells, large bold values.
pecas.serve_para: App ratings, platform presence, channel coverage

pecas.nome: Question-level ESG scorecard
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows ESG scoring is homemade and auditable, question by question.
pecas.como_montar: Long table of questions with five peer columns and average, with subtotal rows for E, S, G and a highlighted final row. Discipline over decoration. Low-res crop.
pecas.serve_para: ESG, governance or qualitative scoring

pecas.nome: Org tree with tenure chips
pecas.o_que_faz: Adds a performance fact, tenure, to a standard org chart.
pecas.como_montar: Round CEO portrait over a row of dashed name boxes; each carries a navy chip with years at the firm. Above, a timeline of tenure milestones in years. Low-res crop.
pecas.serve_para: Management quality

pecas.nome: Tenure portrait card with KPI base
pecas.o_que_faz: Reduces a founder bio to one number, then ties it to company results.
pecas.como_montar: Circular photo in a thick partial navy arc, breaking the top edge of a thin L-frame, name to the right. Large numeral with "Years at MELI" below. Navy strip across both cards with three KPI pairs.
pecas.serve_para: Founder and management pages

pecas.nome: Logo milestones timeline
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows expansion as the birth of sub-brands, without any sentence.
pecas.como_montar: Thick navy line with ticks, years above, sub-brand logos below; text labels only where no logo exists.
pecas.serve_para: Platform and product histories

pecas.nome: Logo ring for cross-sell
pecas.o_que_faz: Depicts an ecosystem loop with its product logos.
pecas.como_montar: Ring of curved arrows linking sub-brand logos around an italic centre word, on a grey panel, next to a Seven Powers cover and quote. Low-res crop.
pecas.serve_para: Ecosystems, flywheels

pecas.nome: Risk code tiles
pecas.o_que_faz: Replaces dots in a risk matrix with codes tied by colour to a legend list.
pecas.como_montar: Square tiles with codes (M1, C2) placed on Probability x Impact axes. Tile colour marks risk family. Right: three stacked coloured plates with the family name and code items. Low-res crop.
pecas.serve_para: Risk slides; ML version dims non-priority tiles to grey

pecas.nome: Scenario icon rows
pecas.o_que_faz: Makes bull, base and bear readable without labels and aligns assumptions across scenarios.
pecas.como_montar: Silhouette bull, house, bear down the left (Sabesp uses line bear, scales, bull above three colour-tiered tables). Columns PRICE, ADS, GMV in navy italics; each value in a grey navy-outlined box.
pecas.serve_para: Scenario summaries with 2-4 drivers

pecas.nome: Black formula plate
pecas.o_que_faz: Sets the method apart from the numbers in appendix calculation pages.
pecas.como_montar: Near-black rectangle with white serif LaTeX-style equation placed under or over the table it governs. Low-res crop.
pecas.serve_para: Ke, WACC, ROIC, elasticity back-up

pecas.nome: Arrow ring KPI
pecas.o_que_faz: Implies a growing or recurring KPI, more than a plain number or donut would.
pecas.como_montar: Thick gradient ring in a near full circle, ending in an arrowhead that points out to the right; the centre holds small white label with the value bold.
pecas.serve_para: Recurring revenue share, cumulative growth.

pecas.nome: Stepped ladder on a colour-fading stem
pecas.o_que_faz: Reads brands from premium to affordable as rungs, the hue fading along with the price.
pecas.como_montar: Thin vertical line with one dot per row in a fading tint; name and italic tier at left; short rounded bar and bold value at right in the same tint. Header icon of stairs.
pecas.serve_para: Product or price architectures.

pecas.nome: Dashed deal-type tags in comps table
pecas.o_que_faz: Lets a transaction table be scanned by deal type.
pecas.como_montar: Normal comps columns, the last one being two dashed outline chips per row, one for seller type and one for buyer logic; header row in accent outline.
pecas.serve_para: Precedent transaction tables.

pecas.nome: Before/After money-flow mini diagram
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows the structural change in a deal in a single line of boxes.
pecas.como_montar: Two row labels at left in italics (Operator, Client), Before and After column titles; grey lines for old flow and accent lines for new flow; '$' labels; a lightning icon for the product; dashed leader to accent '0% Tax' tag.
pecas.serve_para: Tax structure, regulatory arbitrage, business model changes.

pecas.nome: Yellow audit columns
pecas.o_que_faz: Lets reviewers jump to assumption and output cells in dense tables.
pecas.como_montar: Pure spreadsheet yellow on only the assumption and result columns or cells; everything else stays unfilled. Harsh, but works as a convention on appendix pages only.
pecas.serve_para: Appendix calculations

pecas.nome: Staircase term tree
pecas.o_que_faz: Lets the reader step through a debt instrument one term at a time.
pecas.como_montar: Left: tranche values in large italics joined by a bracket. Right: each term (Carencia, Garantias, Amortizacao, Maturity) stepped inward with an L-shaped leader ending in a dot; bold title, italic value. Active block blue, rest grey.
pecas.serve_para: Term sheets, multi-tranche financing

pecas.nome: Signed term-sheet cards
pecas.o_que_faz: Makes the proposal feel like a committed mandate rather than a suggestion.
pecas.como_montar: Top frame with title breaking the border holds four KPIs; a stem forks to three cards. Each card: italic title with rule, four lines of terms, two handwritten signatures with name lines at the foot. P18 repeats on covenant cards (crop b2_al_covenant_signed.png).
pecas.serve_para: Financing proposals, recommendation summaries, covenants

pecas.nome: Versus hourglass with logos and checks
pecas.o_que_faz: Frames two camps as facing each other at one point, then the next slides show BTG occupying the middle.
pecas.como_montar: Two flat tinted panels with inner edges cut diagonally so they almost meet at a centre X; three logos in a row at the top of each, hairline under; large green check icons with title and grey text, mirrored alignment; side labels rotated 90 degrees. Pp. 42-43 place the company in a circle at the point of the X.
pecas.serve_para: Two business models, incumbents vs challengers; positioning the target as the blend.

pecas.nome: Decision tree with lit path
pecas.o_que_faz: Prices each contract outcome and shows the recommended route.
pecas.como_montar: Framed grey panel. Question bars span the width in white with black border. Yes route navy, No route grey, with diamond nodes at splits and small L-brackets by the labels. Leaves are NPV boxes offset vertically by value; chosen ones navy-outlined, others grey.
pecas.serve_para: Deal scenarios, contract options, regulatory outcomes

pecas.nome: Before/after ownership tree
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows what the transaction changes in the group and where proceeds go.
pecas.como_montar: Left tree from adviser and parent logos forks to two steps. Each connects by right-angled line to an open-top frame titled in its border. Top frame: logo with stem to subsidiaries, % chips on stem (dashed chips), outline arrow, reduced tree. Bottom: tranche tile and interest table. Dashed notes box lower left.
pecas.serve_para: M&A, carve-outs, debt repayment

pecas.nome: Three-state recap ledger synced to a structure diagram
pecas.o_que_faz: Compresses a multi-step transaction to four numbers per stage and shows which stage is being discussed.
pecas.como_montar: Three stacked outlined boxes, each with title notched into the top border between two small diamonds, and four big-number columns with accent labels. Active box full contrast, the others about 15 percent opacity. Right side redraws the matching ownership chart per state.
pecas.serve_para: Transaction recap, before and after, staged plans

pecas.nome: Mirrored career timelines meeting at a handover
pecas.o_que_faz: Stages a CEO succession by running outgoing and incoming careers toward the same year.
pecas.como_montar: Outlined hexagon nodes on a thin line with year above and role beneath; upper line runs left to right from the outgoing CEO's photo side, lower runs right to left from the successor's; the 2026 nodes filled blue and stacked at centre; below, name plates with a central explanation box linked by bracket lines.
pecas.serve_para: Succession, founder transition, merger of two teams.

pecas.nome: Thesis ladder ending in a verdict shout
pecas.o_que_faz: Turns the thesis recap into a progress path where each pillar is claimed, then pays off in one word.
pecas.como_montar: Three short claims stepped along a dashed diagonal with one line-icon each, shown one at a time on repeat slides, final state adds huge BUY! plus a one-line human punchline in the translucent band. (Diagonal cut itself is already catalogued.)
pecas.serve_para: Thesis recap and section openers

pecas.nome: Rhetorical question interrupt
pecas.o_que_faz: Marks the turn in the argument with a question on top of the slide just finished.
pecas.como_montar: The previous slide dimmed in grey; large rounded white panel with large light-weight text and one bold accent phrase, nothing else. 3R uses the same idea on a dark full-width band: What about the peers? (p3, p10, p14).
pecas.serve_para: Storyline transitions in place of dividers

pecas.nome: Risk IDs with drill-down sequence
pecas.o_que_faz: Makes the risk map the index for a run of evidence slides, one per risk.
pecas.como_montar: Risk tiles coded by family with letter prefix and matching colour (O, S, MG); legend panels at right repeat prefix colours; each following page keeps the map and swaps the right side for a single risk's text and a small proof chart or clipping. Hard-offset shadows already catalogued; this entry is the ID system and the drill-down.
pecas.serve_para: Risk sections where every risk needs its own evidence.

pecas.nome: Combinatorial scenario pop-up
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows how the count of 27 scenarios comes from 3 by 3 by 3.
pecas.como_montar: Big count with accent number on a top card; second card overlapping, three columns divided by thick accent rules, each with driver name, Bear/Base/Bull lines and bold values.
pecas.serve_para: Scenario and sensitivity setup

pecas.nome: SWOT speech tags with one lit at a time
pecas.o_que_faz: Revives a stale SWOT with a coded label, and spotlights one quadrant per click.
pecas.como_montar: Rounded tag with left-pointing pointer: line icon, thin white divider, big letter; text row on left separated by thick grey rule; inactive rows fade tag and text.
pecas.serve_para: SWOT or any four-item framework

pecas.nome: Risk matrix lit by group
pecas.o_que_faz: Reads risks group by group instead of one crowded matrix.
pecas.como_montar: Hairline 4x4 grid; extruded tiles with codes (1A, 2B); right-hand stacked list. Active group's tiles go dark and its list card gains a border; others fade to pastel.
pecas.serve_para: Risk matrix

pecas.nome: Comparison table driven by a person toggle
pecas.o_que_faz: Lets one table carry two successive arguments by switching which person and which rows are in focus.
pecas.como_montar: Stacked names above the table: the active one bold on a thick accent rule, the inactive grey on a grey rule; a dashed connector with a dashed label ('Performance-driven') drops to the table; dashed box around the rows that prove it; thick accent bars cap both table sides. Next slide swaps name and box.
pecas.serve_para: Before/after CEO, old vs new strategy, two-slide build.

pecas.nome: Bar-terminated connector tree
pecas.o_que_faz: Replaces a boring org-style tree with a drawn logic line that ends in a calculation.
pecas.como_montar: Thin coloured lines leave a dashed box from small diamonds, one colour per branch; branches end in short thick bars on which the labels sit (Suppliers, Clients, Negative WK); a dashed line then falls to a T-tick on the equation strip below.
pecas.serve_para: Driver logic that terminates in a number.

pecas.nome: Tonal tile risk grid plus monitor list
pecas.o_que_faz: Moves risk from a static map to what the team will keep checking after buying.
pecas.como_montar: 4x3 grid of pale grey tiles between two heavy arrows; only occupied tiles filled, with shade of accent as severity and R-codes inside; right, a dashed card 'Following-up the investment' under a capped-end bracket rule, with Roman-numbered question pairs and accent keywords. On p56 the right side is a coin-numbered risk list instead.
pecas.serve_para: Risk slide plus post-investment monitoring checklist.

pecas.nome: Zigzag value chain with stepped dashes
pecas.o_que_faz: Fits a value chain into a narrow side panel and ends it in the single conclusion.
pecas.como_montar: Tall pale panel; three text boxes alternate left and right with icons opposite, linked by dashed elbow lines; arrow into a dark box at the bottom with the takeaway, keywords in accent.
pecas.serve_para: Narrow side-panel context next to charts.

pecas.nome: Open cycle frame around a stack
pecas.o_que_faz: Says the stack is a loop without drawing a circle diagram.
pecas.como_montar: Thin rectangle around three brand blocks, with gaps in the top and bottom border containing chevrons pointing opposite ways; next to it, trapezoid tags LOW and HIGH linked by a diamond leader to a detail box listing why.
pecas.serve_para: Ecosystems and flywheels when a stack of products reads more clearly than a wheel.

pecas.nome: Acquirer logo matrix
pecas.o_que_faz: Compares buyers by logo, with same criteria per column.
pecas.como_montar: Dark vertical tab with rotated label at left; logos as column headers; short bold criteria text below each. Low-res crop.
pecas.serve_para: Buyer screens, peer profiles

pecas.nome: Icon-tile spine
pecas.o_que_faz: Makes a fact list read as one connected story from intro plate down.
pecas.como_montar: Square dark-green tiles with white icons stacked on a short vertical stem below a grey intro plate with heavy base rule. Key figures bold green.
pecas.serve_para: Acquisition recaps, step lists

pecas.nome: Acquisition sheet: logo band, diamond leaders, device
pecas.o_que_faz: Makes each acquired company a repeatable fact card.
pecas.como_montar: Grey full-width band with target logo centred; target's brand colour vertical line with horizontal branches of growing length ending in a diamond; KPI bold plus italic label; device mockup at right; dashed note below.
pecas.serve_para: Series of acquisitions, portfolio, subsidiaries

pecas.nome: Square-node stem list
pecas.o_que_faz: Connects drivers to a chart in reading order and ends with a highlight.
pecas.como_montar: Thin vertical navy stem with square nodes and italic labels; the last node is a yellow circle, sometimes with a highlighted row. Low-res crop.
pecas.serve_para: Margin bridges, driver lists

pecas.nome: Inline logic strip
pecas.o_que_faz: States a cause, mechanism and consequence between a chart and its text in one row.
pecas.como_montar: Pale rounded band behind; icon + short phrase, then accent block arrow with the verb inside (Exclusion), then outcome + icon; the left edge tucks behind the donut.
pecas.serve_para: So-what strip beside charts

pecas.nome: Dashed circuit tying a source to its evidence
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows that the three charts on a slide are all consequences of one framework.
pecas.como_montar: A book cover and summary plate; dashed green elbow connectors leave the plate and run to the accent bar of each section heading, avoiding the charts.
pecas.serve_para: Any framework-to-evidence slide. Connector is drawable; the cover is optional.

pecas.nome: Zig-zag executive strips
pecas.o_que_faz: Lists executives with less monotony and fits a headshot without a column of faces.
pecas.como_montar: Full-width pale strips stacked; a small waist-up cut-out alternates left and right, with text aligned to the photo side (bold name and title, regular tenure line).
pecas.serve_para: Management lists of 2-4 people.

pecas.nome: Parallel scenario cards
pecas.o_que_faz: Shows bear, base and bull as a single assumption change with the outcome.
pecas.como_montar: Three identical grey cards with a thick right and bottom edge in scenario colour; coloured scenario title, target price, upside, a rule, then the sentence naming the varied assumption with only the year coloured.
pecas.serve_para: Scenario summary driven by one variable.

pecas.nome: Linking sentence band between charts
pecas.o_que_faz: States the causal bridge between two charts: one party's cost is another's revenue.
pecas.como_montar: Full-width solid band with white centred sentence between two chart rows; a thin arrow enters from a dashed bar above and leaves toward the chart below.
pecas.serve_para: Value chain P&Ls, payer-provider logic, two-stage reasoning.

pecas.nome: Reasons-add-up card
pecas.o_que_faz: Writes a diagnosis as an equation of words: cause + cause + cause, downward triangle, root cause.
pecas.como_montar: Rounded grey card with solid red title band; three italic bold red phrases split by pale plus signs; wide flat grey down-triangle; result in larger italic red. P.30 uses it as X >> Y pills then a triangle then a verdict.
pecas.serve_para: Why something failed, root-cause conclusions, value bridges in words.

pecas.nome: Causal pill pair
pecas.o_que_faz: Reduces an elasticity or a purchase math to cause-and-effect in two pills and a verdict line.
pecas.como_montar: Two muted red rounded pills in italic white, pale double chevron between, wide fading triangle below pointing at a one-line conclusion with key words in red.
pecas.serve_para: Mini-conclusions in the bottom-right of a dense slide.

pecas.nome: Corner number tag on card
pecas.o_que_faz: Numbers reasons discretely, leaving the text free of list markers.
pecas.como_montar: Grey card with soft bottom-right shadow; small solid square with white bold italic numeral straddling the top-right edge; bold coloured lead-in followed by regular text.
pecas.serve_para: Short ranked lists of 3-5 items.

pecas.nome: Icon disc straddling pill row
pecas.o_que_faz: Reads as a brief event sequence with lighter weight than bullets.
pecas.como_montar: Pale rounded pills stacked with even gaps; a small dark gradient disc with white line icon overlaps each pill's left edge; text indented to clear it.
pecas.serve_para: Event chains, status lists of 3-4.

pecas.nome: Reasons column closing in a synthesis card
pecas.o_que_faz: Sends the eye from reasons to conclusion within one column.
pecas.como_montar: Pale rounded cards with a thick coloured left edge bending around the corners and '01 Title' in bold; the last card is solid brand colour with logo, 'Sintese' and white text, about 1.5x taller.
pecas.serve_para: Criteria list with a single takeaway at the bottom.

pecas.nome: Skim-layer lede
pecas.o_que_faz: Lets a judge read only the coloured words and still get the slide's claim.
pecas.como_montar: Two-line full-width grey sentence with a thick dark tick at left; 5-8 phrases set in bold accent colour, which is the only strong colour in the sentence.
pecas.serve_para: Every content slide; replaces a separate 'key takeaway' box.

pecas.nome: Brand takeover: palette follows the protagonist
pecas.o_que_faz: The colour instantly tells whose story is on screen, and a competitor slide reads as foreign territory.
pecas.como_montar: Swap the whole theme token set by subject: CSN blue to ArcelorMittal red (also Cosan green to Compass red with corner logo swap). Nubank does it for a single slide: rail, accents, pills and corner logo turn Inter orange (p17), MELI logo on p54. Composite crop shows both.
pecas.serve_para: Two-company deals, holding and subsidiary, competitor deep dive

pecas.nome: Two-tone tick on titles and subheads
pecas.o_que_faz: Gives every heading a repeated brand mark and a clear hierarchy without boxes.
pecas.como_montar: Short vertical bar left of the heading, split dark on top and lighter accent at the bottom where the grey caption sits; same device at title scale and subhead scale.
pecas.serve_para: Any deck, as signature heading system

pecas.nome: Blueprint backdrop
pecas.o_que_faz: Ties the deck visually to engineering and infrastructure.
pecas.como_montar: Near-black navy page with faint grid lines, small plus marks scattered and a low wireframe mesh wave rising from the base, all under 15% contrast. Pair with thin blue hairlines ending in diamond dots.
pecas.serve_para: Infrastructure and energy decks

pecas.nome: Case number badge under logo
pecas.o_que_faz: Numbers parallel growth avenues without another agenda slide.
pecas.como_montar: Top right, below the guest or subject logo: dark green circle with a thin white numeral.
pecas.serve_para: Series of 2-5 parallel cases

pecas.nome: Career path told in logos
pecas.o_que_faz: Gives a CEO's credibility in four employer logos rather than a bio paragraph.
pecas.como_montar: Dashed-border logo boxes joined by short green arrows, turning back on itself with an elbow to the current employer, which is on a grey tile; portrait and bio plate beneath.
pecas.serve_para: Management slides. Logos only.

pecas.nome: Slashed title accent
pecas.o_que_faz: Gives every title a small branded mark that repeats across hundreds of slides.
pecas.como_montar: Vertical bar left of the title and subtitle, cut by a diagonal white slash into solid top and pale gradient bottom; a smaller version marks each subheading. Vasta and Restaurant Brands use a similar slashed bar; Vasta has a rounded pill with two slashes.
pecas.serve_para: Title mark in any template.

pecas.nome: Python badge as method stamp
pecas.o_que_faz: Signals in one icon that the numbers were computed by the team rather than collected.
pecas.como_montar: Python logo perched on the upper-left corner of a rounded criteria card, card title sitting in a gap in the top border, Roman-number tiles on the criteria list. Cury Construtora p.13 does it as a small blue pill Python Script at the corner of a chart.
pecas.serve_para: Proprietary scoring, scraping, simulations.

pecas.nome: Illustration hanging over a card edge
pecas.o_que_faz: Adds a topical object to a dense data slide without taking layout space.
pecas.como_montar: Transparent line drawing (fuel nozzle, dripping) placed to break the title band and the right border of the card; only one per slide.
pecas.serve_para: Sector identity in text-heavy panels.

pecas.nome: Closing verdict with four numbered cards
pecas.o_que_faz: Ends on one giant word and compresses the whole deck into three theses plus a risk column.
pecas.como_montar: Cover photo at top and bottom; translucent dark red band across the middle; BUY! in huge white type; four white rounded cards straddling the band's lower edge, each with a square red tag at its top-left corner hanging off the card (I, II, III, !); red hollow diamond bullets; the risk card title is italic.
pecas.serve_para: Final slide before Q&A.

pecas.nome: Teal-washed asset photo closing
pecas.o_que_faz: Keeps a real asset in the closing and in the index while staying in brand palette.
pecas.como_montar: Full-bleed photo of the rig under a theme gradient overlay; thin large Q&A centred; same image at lower contrast behind index pages.
pecas.serve_para: Q&A and index for asset-heavy companies

pecas.nome: Question answered on the closing slide
pecas.o_que_faz: Frames the conclusion as a question to the judges and answers with one word and a logo.
pecas.como_montar: Dark slide with thin-weight question as title; three stacked pentagon arrows in tints of light blue of unequal length, sentence continued across them with ellipses; large grey triangle in the lower-right corner with parallel diagonal bands holding Yes! and the logo.
pecas.serve_para: Final recommendation.

pecas.nome: Single-photo metaphor cover
pecas.o_que_faz: Sets up the deal with an image tied to the target's identity, not a corporate photo.
pecas.como_montar: Full-bleed mountain at golden hour for Moncler; only two small logos centered on the sky; firm name small at bottom-right; no title text.
pecas.serve_para: M&A or brand-led theses where an image carries the idea.

pecas.nome: Cover ribbon echoing the chevrons of the rail
pecas.o_que_faz: Introduces the deck's chevron motif on the cover, then repeats it for Q&A with only the text swapped.
pecas.como_montar: Dark page; white arrow-shaped logo band bleeding from left; thin band with event name and three fading chevrons; phone screen on brand disc.
pecas.serve_para: Consumer app or brand cover

pecas.nome: Ghost numeral divider with chapter tabs
pecas.o_que_faz: Gives the deck a calm rhythm and shows the chapter number and position in the same slide.
pecas.como_montar: Pale background; huge number in a very light tint of the accent behind and above a heavy black chapter title; short accent rule; italic subtitle; a row of six small number-over-label tabs split by thin vertical rules, the active one in accent with an underline.
pecas.serve_para: Section dividers; works with any accent colour.

pecas.nome: Bare verdict word on thesis page
pecas.o_que_faz: Makes the recommendation the largest, quietest thing on the page.
pecas.como_montar: Dark page: thin frame open on the left with price pairs at top (current to target, joined by a capped rule) and return pairs at bottom (IRR, FCFE); between them a single thin-weight accent 'BUY'; three thesis pillars branch off a diagonal as small pill nodes with italic labels.
pecas.serve_para: Opening thesis or investment summary.

pecas.nome: Icon metaphor with hand-drawn arrow
pecas.o_que_faz: Makes a compensation policy memorable: the whole cake must grow, not just the slice.
pecas.como_montar: Pale panel; small and large cake line icons linked by a loose sketched arrow; second line outside the panel, with a slice icon in a contrasting colour, completing the sentence.
pecas.serve_para: Incentive or culture points hard to chart.

pecas.nome: Verdict title on full-bleed price line
pecas.o_que_faz: Places the recommendation next to the price path that justifies it.
pecas.como_montar: Dark gradient page; title is ticker and verdict ('RDOR3 - HOLD'); price line takes most of the page, with a dashed horizontal at the target price labelled on the line; a stat cluster at right gives DCF, IRR and current price.
pecas.serve_para: Recommendation opener, especially a nuanced hold.

pecas.nome: Result seal on a leader
pecas.o_que_faz: Stamps the conclusion of a flow diagram as a verdict.
pecas.como_montar: Dashed horizontal leader from the panel into an accent circle with thick white rim and outer ring, white value and label ('18.1% Premium').
pecas.serve_para: End result of a structure or mechanism.

pecas.nome: Isometric staircase of prisms into a 3D arrow
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Measured vector, 12 polygons, draw back to front. Each step is a hex prism with 3 tones. Step 1: top (1177,618)(1052,554)(985,591)(1110,654) #004D5B; left (1111,771)(1111,653)(986,589)(986,708) #013E48; right (1178,734)(1178,616)(1111,653)(1111,771) #022E36. Step 2: top (1244,524)(1119,461)(1052,498)(1176,561) #216452; left (1178,734)(1178,560)(1053,497)(1053,670) #1E5848; right (1245,696)(1245,523)(1178,560)(1178,734) #174538. Step 3: top (1312,431)(1188,367)(1120,405)(1245,468) #297864; left (1245,696)(1245,468)(1120,405)(1120,633) #338D73; right (1312,659)(1312,431)(1245,468)(1245,696) #1F5848. Pitch is +67,-37 per step on the front diagonal, top face drops ~95 per level. Arrow: front face (1312,659)(1312,331)(1365,359)(1265,122)(1137,242)(1188,268)(1188,596) #5EC98E; shaft side (1379,622)(1379,351)(1365,359)(1312,331)(1312,659) #3E966E; head side (1320,92)(1265,122)(1365,359)(1422,328) #3E966E. Rule: top lightest of the prism in steps 1-2, right wall always darkest. Attached text tabs: flat rects flush against each step's left edge in the same colour as the step, x 570/638/705/772 to the step, heights ~118/92/92/92, stepping up; a 5px white staircase polyline separates tabs from the prisms. Build sequence dims later steps by a 23% black overlay and highlights one at a time on pages 29-32.
pecas.serve_para: Sequential build-up to a result: premises to forecast, method steps, value bridge in words.

pecas.nome: Rectangle with bevelled top and bottom lips and a side wall
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Measured vector, the deck's standard card. Depth offset is only 9-10px up-right (0.6% of width). Body rect (70,171)-(495,729) #ECEEF4. Right wall parallelogram (504,140)(495,149)(495,729)(504,721) #BEBFC4. Top bar rect (70,150)-(495,171) #205B4A; its top bevel (504,141)(80,141)(70,150)(495,150) #4C7B6D (bar colour +25% toward white); its right end (504,141)(495,150)(495,171)(504,162) #1A493B (bar -20%). Bottom bar rect (70,725)-(495,747) #205B4A with the same right end at (504,716)(495,725)(495,747)(504,738) #1A493B. Draw wall, bevels, body, bars. Three cards at a pitch of 446 with a 21px gap. Works over a page dimmed by 23% black on page 26.
pecas.serve_para: Reusable content card for scenarios, overview triplets, side rails. Cheap depth on any dense slide.

pecas.nome: Stacked overlapping arrows with a beam to two overlapping callout cards
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Vector. Page dimmed about 35% black (white becomes ~#A0A0A0). Row of 5 notched rounded block arrows at y 545-780, each ~250w, pitch ~240, so tip and next tail overlap ~35px; inactive arrows at ~55% alpha, so the overlaps visibly darken, reading as glass plates. Active arrow 100% alpha (#003E49 first, later greens moving to #4BC184). Beam: flat triangle (716,395)(204,663)(383,113) #D9D9D9 from the active arrow up, behind the cards. Two cards offset so they overlap: top card (313,35)-(1010,285) #EBEBEB; lower card (440,283)-(1143,533) with the top card overlapping its top edge by ~8. Each card has a 6px L-shaped offset in #207D5A along right and bottom (a solid rect the same size shifted +6,+6). Big number on the left with a vertical rule. Page sequence moves the active arrow and the beam.
pecas.serve_para: Chronology of financing rounds, deal timeline with drill-down per event.

pecas.nome: Interlocking S-shaped ribbon timeline
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Measured vector. Each period has two freeforms of 219x94 at the same y (589-683): coloured S-parallelogram (121-340) with flared lower-left foot and rounded top-right, and a grey #D9D9D9 mirrored twin (228-446) with flared lower-right foot. They overlap by ~112 so coloured bends over grey like a woven band. Pitch ~195; next coloured piece is drawn on top of the previous grey. Colour steps: #013E49, #004F4F, #205B4A, #207D5A, #20A874, #4BC184. A 3px grey line runs behind at y=636. Event flags: 1px vertical stem from the ribbon up/down ~90 px ending in a small right triangle pennant ~30x15 same colour, text beside it, alternating up and down.
pecas.serve_para: Company history, M&A timeline, 5-7 dated events.

pecas.nome: Flared funnel wedges between blocks
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF pt on a 960x540 slide unless noted. MEASURED. Face #FFCC00, wedges #BF9000 (about 75% brightness of face). Block 1 (69,217)-(197,293). Wedge A: (197,217),(273,192),(273,317),(197,293). Block 2 (273,192)-(442,317). Wedge B: (442,192),(532,164),(532,346),(442,317). Terminal table starts at x=532 with height y 164-346. Height grows 76, 125, 182: step ratio about 1.5. Wedge is a flat darker tone, no gradient; reads as a corridor opening toward the viewer.
pecas.serve_para: Progressive argument, small to large, ending in a table.

pecas.nome: Sharp triangle sandwich with hairlines
pecas.como_montar: In px@110 on p58, multiply by 0.6545. Grayscale photo fills page. Yellow polygon (0,0),(310,0),(1020,562),(770,825),(0,825), vertical gradient #E0B018 to #F0D000. White polygon (1020,562),(1068,514),(1467,812),(1467,825),(770,825). Charcoal #3A3A3A polygon (1022,480),(1467,200),(1467,812); darker spike #252525 (1022,480),(1467,75),(1467,200). Yellow hairline 1pt along the charcoal lower edge, white hairline along yellow's upper edge. p2 version in crop b1_fold_triangles: nested right triangles from the lower-left: yellow, grey #A8A8A8, white, plus a darker sliver, each revealing a 20-60pt strip.
pecas.serve_para: Cover, Q&A, divider, thesis slide.

pecas.nome: Glossy token with rim
pecas.como_montar: Vector, no images on p10. 51pt circle stack, back to front: (1) navy disc #001A5E; (2) slightly smaller disc offset about 1.5pt up-left, white 1pt stroke, filled with linear gradient at 45 degrees: #0572C1 top-left to #002B7A bottom-right. Navy crescent remains visible on the bottom-right as a rim. Text in 2 lines white: italic name above, regular region below. Group them inside a nested dashed oval: rotated ellipse 1pt dashed navy with fill #2040C0 at 12% alpha. Plot area: diagonal gradient #A8C4FF bottom-left to white top-right, white gridlines; a blue dotted 45 degree line runs under the tokens.
pecas.serve_para: Scatter plots with named entities instead of dots; project maps

pecas.nome: Faded wheel selector
pecas.como_montar: Vertical list that imitates a rotating drum. Centre row: full size bold italic blue text in a rect with 1.5pt blue outline and #0A1A5C alpha fill, overlapping a vertical blue axis on its right. Rows +/-1: grey, wide-stretched type, about 80% height. Rows +/-2: clipped to the top or bottom third, heavily squashed. On later pages the selection advances with the order rotated. The rows are small rasters in this PDF (712x54 with soft mask). Native build: 3-5 textboxes; for the outer rows use a smaller font and put a bg-colour to alpha 0 gradient rect on top, or use a clipped picture.
pecas.serve_para: Section navigator on a multi-part walkthrough slide

pecas.nome: Bowtie funnel with gradient wedges from rows into a circle and out
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF points on a 960x540 slide. Exact. Left rows: five rects x348-517, each 57 tall, stacked y206-493, alpha .5 #7DE2E7 (top two) and #77CEEF (lower three). Left wedge inside gradient rect x517-643,y206-493 clipped by triangle (517,206),(517,493),(632,348), #7DE2E7 at the base fading to #D2EFFA. Right wedge mirror x623-748, triangle (748,206),(748,493),(632,348), #BBE6F7 near apex to #1482AC at base. Right block rect x748-917, y206-493 #1482AC alpha .81 with white hairlines at y302,y396. White circle centre (632,348) r46.5 with thin cyan stroke drawn last with logo. Both wedges reach the same height as the blocks, so it reads as a solid channel. Dark header tabs on both blocks.
pecas.serve_para: Many business lines to one company to new units; before/after mapping

pecas.nome: Bowtie plates with rounded chamfer into grey wheel
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF points on a 960x540 slide. Exact path, rounded polygon. Left plate (81,129)->(118,115)->(515,226)->(530,240)->(530,270)->(515,284)->(118,395)->(81,380)->close, #7030A0 alpha .2. Right mirror (880,129),(842,115),(436,226),(421,240),(421,270),(436,284),(842,394),(880,380), #082D6C alpha .15. Corners rounded ~15. Each plate's neck goes beneath the wheel and overlaps it. Wheel: white circle centre (476,260) r82.5, then #D9D9D9 r69.5, then two curved arrows #65757D and #184263. List dots on the plate outer edge: vertical line with ring markers.
pecas.serve_para: Partnership with two sides feeding each other

pecas.nome: Accordion fold ribbon arrows
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF points on a 960x540 slide. Exact. Arrow 1 (43,162),(454,162),(488,196),(454,230),(43,230) #A4DEF4; arrow 2 (43,230),(508,230),(542,264),(508,298),(43,298) #77CEEF; arrow 3 (43,298),(415,298),(449,332),(415,366),(43,366) #D2EFFA. Arrows are 68 tall, tip 34 long and touch one another. Fold walls behind at left edge, extending off the slide: wall 1 (44,163),(-44,99),(-44,241),(45,241) #A0C1D5; wall 2 (44,298),(-45,353),(-45,230),(44,230) #70A1C0; wall 3 similar, third, mirrors wall 1 downward, pale #D0DEE8 estimated. Walls flare outward at slope ~0.7 and are darker than their arrow by ~20%. Draw walls first. Lengths deliberately vary, longest in the middle. Dark background #0F2233 to #142B3F.
pecas.serve_para: Closing summary, three-point conclusion; agenda

pecas.nome: Curved ribbons flowing off page into icon tiles, with an underside fold
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF points on a 960x540 slide. Exact cubic paths starting off slide x=-70. Tile rect (98,215)-(155,272) #A1C8C5. Ribbon top face: (-70,275)->(98,215)->(98,272)->(-70,296) #7EC492. Underside fold, darker: curve (-70,294) via (53,268),(105,260) to (155,272), back via (108,284),(12,292) to (-70,296), #318B71. So the fold emerges as a thin crescent beneath and curls under the tile. Middle ribbon (-71,306)-(47,299)-(99,289), (99,346)-(48,337)-(-71,327) #70A1C0, with tile #1482AC, no fold. Lower (-71,344),(99,368),(99,425),(-71,365) #2683C6 with fold above (-69,346)..(53,372)..(105,381)..(155,368)..(108,356)..(12,348) #134263, tile #1D6295. Text bar rounded rect, x135-360, 46 tall, behind the tile. Tiles 57x57, step 77.
pecas.serve_para: Drivers converging; three causes leading to three labelled outcomes

pecas.nome: Interlocked double chevron column
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF points on a 960x540 slide. Exact native polygons. Left chevrons point right: (210,197),(244,197),(261,250),(244,303),(210,303),(227,250) #A3CEED; (209,311),(244,311),(261,364),(244,417),(209,417),(227,364) #1D6295; grey end (209,423),(246,423),(261,471),(225,471) #D9D9D9. Right chevrons point left and nest in left tips: (303,357),(269,357),(251,306),(269,255),(303,255),(286,306) #75B6E5; (303,471),(269,471),(251,418),(269,365),(303,365),(286,418) #134263; grey start (251,197),(288,197),(303,249),(267,249) #D9D9D9. Each chevron w~51, h~106, notch 17; left and right offset by ~56 vertically. Each carries a shadow PNG (144x295) with darker edge, soft dark side at the notch, so it reads as stacked folded plates. Text on both outer sides.
pecas.serve_para: Dual timeline; two parallel evolutions; events alternating

pecas.nome: Active nav tab with fold triangle under header
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF points on a 960x540 slide. Exact. Header bar #65757D y0-54 and inactive tabs #A3CEED y0-54. Active tab rect (513,0)-(662,62) #134263 is 8 taller than the bar. Fold triangle (513,54),(504,54),(513,62) #141719, near black. The tab looks like a paper strip wrapped behind the header. All-tab width 148. Very cheap, always on.
pecas.serve_para: Section navigation on every slide

pecas.nome: Fade-to-floor light-pillar waterfall
pecas.como_montar: Native chart on dark gradient slide bg (black top-left, #00305F bottom-right). Bars are vertical linear gradients: #0177C8 at top, #0056A0 at 60%, background tone or alpha 0 at the bottom, so bars dissolve downward like light columns. Value label sits inside the bar top in white, percent above. The negative step inverts it: top nearly transparent (#1F5A91), bottom brightest (#47A4FA), with a slight diagonal gradient. Hairline white floor. Bars 75pt wide with 37pt gaps.
pecas.serve_para: SOTP or waterfall on dark slides

pecas.nome: Diagonal bands and converging pentagons behind a map
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Vector, 25 gradient fills. Back: left pentagon (35,137)(487,137)(732,427)(487,717)(35,717), horizontal gradient #FDFDFD at x=50, #E5E0E0 at 250, #D3CACB at 400, #CABEBF at the tip, so the content on the left sits on a plate that darkens toward the map. Right mirror: starts at x=1467 white (#FDFCFC), #EBE7E7 at 1300, #D3CACA at 1100, #C7BBBC at 1000; top-left chamfer from (1027,137) to the map. Cross band: rotated rect (1041,149)(1093,230)(480,629)(427,547), about 96px thick, #8D2925, ~-33 degrees, in the source stacked in shifted copies 14px apart; visible only as the wedges either side of the map, which is the point. Front: map polygons #D9D9D9 with 1px white borders, opaque, drawn last. Text and logos sit on the pentagons at alpha 100%. Bottom right: browser-style card #F2F2F2 with 3 traffic-light dots over the right pentagon.
pecas.serve_para: Footprint or map slide with a timeline on one side and rationale on the other; makes a map the focal object.

pecas.nome: Layered shard frame on a section divider
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Vector, no raster behind. Field: diagonal gradient #1A0000 top-left to #8A0000 bottom-right. Left shards: stacked long polygons bounded by the inner hexagon edge (345,0)(184,395)(283,825), plus extra triangles at top left and sharp strips from the top; alternating tones #491A1B, #890101, #730A0A, with gradient across each shard, so they overlap like folded sheets. Right shards: inner edge (1155,0)(1467,420) and (1467,445)(1245,825), tones #8A0101, #6E0B0C, grey-brown #3F2020 strip at the bottom. Center is the darkest area, so the text sits in a recessed hexagon. Numbered circles with a thin gradient stroke; inactive item at ~30% alpha. Blue twin on pages 9-10.
pecas.serve_para: Section divider, cover alternative on dark palettes.

pecas.nome: Twisted strand bundle
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Vector with gradients. Black field. Back: 2-3 broad curved swooshes, navy to transparent, e.g. a band x 1015-1230 at top fading out around y=470, and diagonal sheet from (810,0) to (340,825) at ~10-20% alpha.
