Front: 12-16 long tapered freeforms crossing at a waist near (1185,430), width 12-14px at the slide edges tapering to hairline at the waist, fill #3E5FA8 to #2A4A90 alpha 70-90%, each from a top/bottom edge to the opposite. Taper creates the perspective of twisting. Red twin on page 38. Reproduce with narrow closed freeforms: two bezier edges sharing the waist point.
pecas.serve_para: Cover, closing and Q&A only. Too busy for content slides.

pecas.nome: Isometric slabs connected by a road
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Source is one 1024x1536 raster, cropped in a framed box (44,160)-(720,738), with 4 native numbered circles on top with soft shadows (grey #C8C8C8, r~18, shadow to lower right). Not reproducible literally. Shape version: 4 iso slabs in zigzag, each a rhombus about 220x100 with a 20px thick left and right wall (tones as prism: top lightest, right darkest), one small dark road ribbon: a thick #404040 polyline with a #C8A878 2px outer border, S-curving between slabs behind them. Small icon cubes on top as simple prisms.
pecas.serve_para: Value chain, process from raw material to end customer.

pecas.nome: Row of gradient bands with hairlines and chevron facets
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF points on a 960x540 slide. Exact native bands. Background near-black navy #000715. Band rect x0-960,y238-306 and y387-456, horizontal gradient #000715 to royal blue at right, with hairlines 0.5pt white alpha .4 at top and bottom; bands extended by tip polygons at right. Left column x0-55,y278-540 gradient #002854 and raster facet stack (98x778,154x727,127x1500). Facets: stacked chevrons, each two-tone, pointing right at x~0-250, y~230-540, dark #0A1C3C and #142E66. Selected thesis highlighted.
pecas.serve_para: Dark-themed agenda divider

pecas.nome: Zoom beam from price point to gradient panel on dark
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF points on a 960x540 slide. Variant: beam fades. Apex at price chart end ~(440,245). Panel x533-960,y77-154 with gradient blue #1D3F8E to transparent at right. Beam triangle (440,245),(533,77),(533,154), same blue, alpha ~.4 fading to apex. Football-field bars below with a gradient rgba: alpha ~.5 at the outer ends, sharper at mean line; subtle glass effect. Measured from render, plus or minus 5.
pecas.serve_para: Dark-mode thesis summary slide with scenario panel

pecas.nome: Isometric scene with leader callouts
pecas.como_montar: Pasted PNG with alpha. The native part is the overlay: thin green arrow leaders with a dot on the scene and an arrowhead pointing at a labelled product cut-out outside it. Base slab: rhombus with a visible front edge (dark grey road, light grey curb).
pecas.serve_para: Product ecosystems, where things sit in a real site

pecas.nome: Concentric arc ribbons feeding rows
pecas.como_montar: Measured p30. Hub centre (523.8,393). OUTER ring = 5 pie wedges, R about 68.6, hub-angle boundaries at about -90, -57, -21, +21, +57, +90 degrees (right half only). INNER ring = 5 wedges centred (523.4,390.6), R about 38, same angles and colours, separated from the outer ring by a white gap: paint a white circle R about 44 between them. ROWS: 5 rects h about 21, all ending x905.7; left ends at x524, 566, 580, 564, 523 so they start from the arc. y tops 315.1, 349.7, 383.1, 419.6, 450.8. Colours per row and wedge: #56C589 #6DC073 #09AD72 #05AA4D #006240. Top and bottom rows run past the arc's end and merge with it. Hub label: rounded rect (505.6,371.5)-(561.1,405) #09AD72 in front of all, white bold text. Each row holds 2 white-text fields.
pecas.serve_para: One hub radiating to 5 benefits; cross-sell, drivers of a thesis

pecas.nome: Seated-table scene (figures radiating around an oval)
pecas.como_montar: Native. Ellipse about 210x105pt, #A6DCC8, soft shadow (blur 6, 30% black), text inside. Figures behind it: each = circle head + trapezoid torso, rotated to radiate from the ellipse centre. About 10 figures at varying angles; those at the bottom are effectively upside down. Tone by role: #09AD4A, #006240, #E2EC90. The ellipse hides half the torsos, which sells a tabletop seen from above.
pecas.serve_para: Boards, governance, partnerships

pecas.nome: Boardroom plan: beveled table, lit-seat chairs
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF pt on a 960x540 slide unless noted. MEASURED table. Outer rounded rect (146,211)-(472,273), radial or horizontal gradient #272727 to #808080, radius about 18. Inner rect (158,222)-(462,263) flat #595959, radius about 14. Gives a raised rim. Five horizontal rules start tangent to the arcs at different x and run to the right page edge, passing over the plane; section label sits on each rule. Front: wire sphere (raster 889x1058, can be swapped for circles and lines or a plain nested circle) with faded back nodes. Active section bold, others thin.

pecas.nome: Tonal 3D funnel of truncated cones
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF points on a 960x540 slide. Raster, no vector paths in this region, but simple to rebuild. Crop 185x220. Four separate cups with gaps overlapping about 8. Widths/heights at top: 165x56, 124x57, 88x44, 53x38; centres aligned at x~447. Build each with: front body = freeform with top ellipse's lower arc and bottom arc at ~60% of top width; horizontal gradient dark-light-dark, highlight at 40%; top lip = ellipse (w, h~22% of w) filled by lighter colour; inner ellipse scaled 88%, darker shade, for the inside. Colours top to bottom: #E6236F, #F48FB8, #B39DDB, #A5D8DC. Leaders: dotted line in layer colour from the rim to the right label with number.
pecas.serve_para: TAM/SAM/SOM; funnel of addressable targets

pecas.nome: Rounded offset plates behind a modal with dark veil
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF points on a 960x540 slide. Measured from render. Veil: full-slide #000 alpha ~.6. Plate 1 #E5206F roundrect x~53-400,y~60-390 r~30; plate 2 same colour x~600-912,y~200-490. White modal roundrect (67,74)-(898,475) r~30 on top. Visible as a thick rounded L top-left and bottom-right, offset ~14. Softer than the mitred RBI version.

pecas.nome: Off-page segmented half ring with staggered cards
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF points on a 960x540 slide. Measured. Ring centre (-29,315), outer radius ~170, ring width ~45, cut by slide's left edge. 5 segments with small gaps, colours #A70E55,#A70E55,#EF5FA0,#F2C2D8,#ABDBDB. Faceted brand triangle at centre, peeking from the edge. Five cards with 2pt stroke per segment, roundrect r~8, h~62, gap ~10, x-starts 101,144,170,144,101 following the arc, w~310, soft shadow (+3,+3). Card strokes match their segments. Depth comes from cards sitting on top of the arc.

pecas.nome: Isometric building overlapping cards
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF points on a 960x540 slide. Raster AI render (transparent PNG) at x~470-690,y~245-410. Draw order: option cards x512-975,y~150-265; building above covering their bottom; panel x~707-1000,y~262-425 behind right side. Native approximation: 3 parallelogram faces (top lighter, left mid, right dark, ratio about 1:0.75:0.55), angle 30 degrees, ground diamond in grey with a yellow-edge. Keep as picture in real decks.

pecas.nome: Faceted shard burst between cards (+ / = connector)
pecas.como_montar: In source this is a raster; polygons below measured on a 300dpi render, in pt, ready to rebuild. Gap between cards x 286-352. Main wedge: (286,163),(352,191),(352,260),(286,245), linear gradient #006A00 at upper left to #00B000 at lower right. Top rim 2pt line #22DD22 along upper edge. Darker upper facet band: (286,169),(352,198),(352,215),(286,190) #004D00 alpha 0.5. Lower facet: (286,211),(352,236),(352,260),(286,245) #006000. Spikes behind the right card, pointing left: tip (311,131) to base (352,144)-(352,165), #006000 gradient; tip (314,159) to base (352,172)-(352,190). Bright offset rim behind each spike, tip (329,130), #22DD22, 3-4pt visible. Streaks below: thin polygon (286,249) to (352,262), width 1.5pt #33DD33; two more further down with alpha fading to 0 at left. White '+' or '=' at wedge center. Order: wedge and shards behind both cards, right card clips the right ends.
pecas.serve_para: Merging A + B = NewCo; energetic connector between comparison cards.

pecas.nome: Stacked offset wireframe logo plates
pecas.como_montar: Raster background in source (1625x1495 with soft mask). In px@110, front V: (757,191),(893,193),(831,577),(1235,30),(930,635),(759,633). Draw 3-4 copies shifted up-left, steps about (-8,-12) and (-13,-16) pt. Copies at the back: fill white alpha 0.05-0.08, no outline. Front copy: no fill, 1pt outline #00E000. Add a mid copy with #00A000 outline at alpha 0.5. Slightly vary scale across copies so edges fan out. Page: horizontal gradient #000 to #003300 at the right. Works with any logo-like polygon.
pecas.serve_para: Cover, Q&A, or divider background.

pecas.nome: Pennant banner with fold and tab on a card

Wall (755,761)(675,700)(675,197)(755,136) #D9D9D9; panel (755,136)-(1467,761) #F2F2F2, bleeding off the right edge; the chart panel #F2F2F2 ends at x=675 so the wall looks like an open gate between them. Top tab rect (801,131)-(1188,176) #205B4A pokes 5px above the panel with a small fold triangle (785,136)(801,131)(801,136). Inner dashed rect (838,250)-(1408,667) #D9D9D9 with 2px dashed #207D5A. Banner on the dashed edge: (937,225)(1300,225)(1300,279)(1118,292)(937,279) #207D5A, the bottom shallowly pointed, soft shadow; fold (1299,249)(1299,225)(1317,249) #205B4A. Result plate (962,574)-(1298,730) #205B4A breaks through the dashed frame at the bottom.

pecas.nome: Solid offset L-bar with photo breakout and name plate

Bar: solid #205B4A 8px wide on right (759,142)-(767,455) and bottom (111,447)-(767,455), i.e. a same-size rect shifted +8,+10, card on top. Name plate rect (103,333)-(600,426) #BEBEBE on the card, photo cut-out PNG on top, its head overlapping the card area and shoulders overlapping the plate and reaching the bar: three layer planes in about 8px of offset. Photo is the only raster.

pecas.nome: Full-bleed band over dimmed slide

Previous slide copy, then 23% black overlay (white becomes #C4C4C4), then opaque #205B4A rect, full width, y 264-560 (36% of height), centered white question text. Content above and below stays legible as a ghost layer. No shadow.

pecas.nome: Layered cutaway scene

Back to front: sky #6BB0BF, sea gradient #0A6878 to #1D4F60, seabed freeform in dark green rising to the left, gradient to dark at the bottom. Rebuild as stacked freeforms; platforms can be icons.

pecas.nome: Chevrons with beam to a card

Variant on the zoom beam: 6 chevrons x 592-714, height ~120, pitch 97, so each chevron nests into the previous with a ~20 px white gap; inactive #BDBDBD, active #205B4A. Left rail ~70px, 4-5 tall curved freeforms overlapping, e.g. #003E49, #3F9D6F, #4BC184, #93D9B3 at 60-80% alpha, so overlaps create new tones. Pages under dim keep them visible. Nubank twin below.

pecas.nome: Speed rays behind an object

Five #FFFF00 freeforms bleeding from the sidebar edge at x=61, each flaring: 30-40pt tall at left narrowing to 15-20pt rectangles by x≈115, ending behind a mascot at x≈200. White gaps taper. Square photos masked as rotated 45-degree squares, diagonal about 160pt, 4 tiles in a big diamond of about 317x320 with white 2pt seams. Lower half overlaps a grey #F2F2F2 panel starting at y=226, so the top tile rises above the panel. Names as 45-degree text outside each tile.

The active slice in both bands filled with angular gradient #0B2A8A to #1F55E0, outer slice a bit longer than the inner. Centre text gradient blue italic. Percent labels outside; active one white, others grey.

pecas.nome: Ring nodes on staggered ledger lines

A 1pt line leaves the circle's bottom tangent and runs to the slide's right edge, ending in a small diamond. Items step right and down at x about 66, 140, 255 (irregular). pecas.nome: Hard offset shadow on boxes
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF points on a 960x540 slide. Exact. Top rect (412,154)-(482,250) #404040; shadow rect (414,158)-(485,253) #202020, drawn first. Offsets (+3,+3.5). Pale version: box #DCF1F8 with shadow rect in #5CC8EC, same offset. No blur. Printer-safe.

pecas.nome: Stepped arrow bars with shield banner

Bar ends x=266,294,322,351, step +28. Head triangle e.g. (266,338),(278,353),(266,369) same colour, 12 long, 31 tall. Plate behind: #F2F2F2 x0-480,y~320-500. pecas.nome: Trapezoid tabs merging into a grey plate with matching slope

pecas.nome: Stacked arches ascending
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF points on a 960x540 slide. Exact, thick open polylines with rounded shoulders. Each arch 4pt thick; shape for E: (530,482),(557,440),(584,426),(830,426),(857,440),(884,482) #134263. Above, D: (575,415)..(625,363)..(789,363)..(838,415) #1D6295; C: (617,347)..(662,300)..(752,300)..(797,347) #75B6E5; B: (653,279)..(693,237)..(721,237)..(761,279) #A3CEED; A: (682,220)..(707,199)..(732,220) #65757D. pecas.nome: Rhombus photo mosaic
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF points on a 960x540 slide. Whole diamond x72-422, y141-489, centre ~(247,315). Four photo rhombi of half diagonal ~87, gaps ~4, grey #A6A6A6 fills showing behind the photo corners. Photos are rasters cropped by freeform. Labels at outer vertices, connected with short lines ending in small diamonds. Build: 4 freeform pictures or 4 diamond shapes with picture fill.

pecas.nome: Glass plate and angled planes over a photo
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF points on a 960x540 slide. Translucent plate exact rect (377,234)-(766,329) #CFE0EA alpha .2 with large text. Background navy #0F2233. Photo raster (973x779) masked by diagonal triangle at right, plus raster tilted card (1082x866). Two or three diagonal 1pt lines and darker parallelograms at about 60 degrees. Native rebuild: photo in rect, navy triangles overlaying it, parallelogram alpha .3-.6 on top.

pecas.nome: Tube bars and glowing tab
pecas.como_montar: Multi-stop gradient across the bar's short side simulates a cylinder: dark at both edges and bright at the middle. p4 vertical bars: #1A6FA8 top, #2188CF middle, #1A6FA8 bottom. Waterfall bars: #003A7A, #0067C0, #003A7A. p31 red version, horizontal bars: #5A0000, #B00000, #5A0000. Active tab: full-width navy rect #001F3F with vertical gradient to #6FC3FF at the bottom edge, 1.5pt dashed navy outline offset 2pt out; inactive tabs flat navy. Spotlight for a chosen year: translucent #BFE3FF at 35% rect with 1pt border, behind the bar and rising above the chart.
pecas.serve_para: Rendering conventional bars with volume, navigation tabs

pecas.nome: Glass columns over a dark gradient, crossed by a timeline
pecas.como_montar: Slide bg: linear gradient black (top-left) to #00305F. 4 column rects about 171x382pt, fill white at about 4-6% alpha, 0.75pt border white at about 25% alpha, positions staggered +/-2pt vertically. White 1pt horizontal line runs edge to edge passing through them at step-label height, interrupted by the labels with short vertical ticks either side. Inner boxes: dashed 0.75pt #0B5CAD with fill a bit lighter, so 3 tones of depth: bg, column, inner box. Unselected column contents faded to about 35% on later pages.
pecas.serve_para: Step plans and comparison columns on dark slides

pecas.nome: Gradient lit regions on outlined map
pecas.como_montar: Map borders white 1pt no-fill on dark bg. Selected states filled with vertical gradient: bg-tone at top to #0A5CB0 at bottom, overlaid white 1.5pt rail lines in sky blue. Translucent table panel (#FFFFFF 3%, border #1C5D93) overlaps the map's top-left, so the map shows through. Leader lines with diamond end caps run to labels.
pecas.serve_para: Geographic footprint on dark slides

pecas.nome: Gradient-stroke corner box
pecas.como_montar: White box, no full outline. Build with 2 thin rects (1.5pt) on the top and right edges, solid #C00000 at the shared corner fading to alpha 0 towards the far ends; plus a soft shadow at low alpha on the opposite corner. Box appears lifted and lit from the top-right.
pecas.serve_para: Org and transaction structure nodes

pecas.nome: Glow row bands with fading rules
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Background horizontal #0B122B to #1A3C87. Bands 83px tall, full width, each a rect with horizontal gradient #0B122A to #19387D, a hair lighter than the field. Top and bottom 1.5px rules #517FDE that fade to transparent past ~84% of the width (bottom rule slightly stronger). Dotted-circle medallion r=24 at x=93 with the roman numeral. Rows act as recessed slots. Section variant fades inactive rows to about 35% alpha.
pecas.serve_para: Agenda on navy, section dividers.

pecas.nome: Double-outline hexagons in staggered layout with a translucent column
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Hexagons ~126x116 px: outer stroke 2px #FF0000, inner hexagon inset 5px stroke 1px #C00000, fill transparent over gradient red. Staggered: two in a column at x~1200, third offset +160 at mid height. Label plate below each with 1px stroke. Column (957,178)-(1067,522), radius 25, red at 50% alpha (#A00000) with 2px #FF0000 stroke, over the table's rows so the rows read through it. Horizontal rules cross over it. Depth from translucency, not faces.
pecas.serve_para: KPI cluster plus emphasising a terminal value column.

pecas.nome: Translucent plate over org-chart lines with ghost nodes
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Dark gradient slide. Plate rect (857,246)-(1365,300), white at ~20% alpha, 1px dashed white border, drawn over the connector lines so the lines read through it; holds the percentages. Inactive state layers: same connectors and nodes in red at 25-30% alpha sit behind the active white ones, offset ~50px left, i.e. the previous structure stays as a ghost. Ghost box 'Others' (1239,343)-(1364,407). Active node: filled dark-red with white or red 2px stroke.
pecas.serve_para: Before/after ownership structure, highlighting a stake band.

pecas.nome: Folder lip between header and chart body
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Measured. Header rect (47,147)-(720,266) #F2F2F2 with black 1px border, holds legend. Lip trapezoid (47,266)(720,266)(714,294)(52,294), black at 90% alpha (#191919): narrows by ~5-6px each side going down, 28px tall. Body rect (54,294)-(712,740) white with 1px black border, narrower than header. Reads as a binder/visor hanging over the chart. MOIC oval overlaps a connector line above the bars.
pecas.serve_para: Waterfall or chart with legend/key in a header zone.

pecas.nome: Vertical-gradient rows on a diagonal gradient field
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Background diagonal linear #020000 top-left to #8E0000 bottom-right. Rows 1303x83 at pitch 125, x 46-1349. Row fill vertical gradient #670000 top, #3F0000 mid, #250000/near black bottom. 1px dotted white on left and bottom edges only (lit edge), dark on top/right. Rows look like raised metal plates because each one's value range differs from the field behind it.
pecas.serve_para: Agenda, section lists on dark themes.

pecas.nome: Top-down boardroom capsule with chairs under the table
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. No raster at matching size, treat as native. Table capsule x 160-600, y 240-320, dark olive #3F4F31 about 85% alpha, drawn OVER 7 chair groups, so chair seats read through the table edge. Chair: back rounded rect plus two arm rounded rects and seat, top-down, #5B7F2F with dark #24361A arms; investor chairs tinted navy or grey to signal the new board member. Dashed leaders from the logo to the chair. Vertical 1px rule splits New vs Existing members.
pecas.serve_para: Board composition, governance.

pecas.nome: Shaded map states with dashed leaders
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Native polygons. Each state with its own horizontal gradient #821616 at outer left to #470000 at inner to dark, with white 1px borders. The gradient runs across the whole map so it reads as a lit relief. Dashed stepped leaders from each state to a logo row at x~710-780, % and volume to the right of a 1px rule. Gradient bars in the chart repeat the same red-to-dark gradient.

pecas.nome: Card with a top dark edge and notched corner (pasted)
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Source is a 591x1144 PNG with alpha placed at (43,114)-(367,743). To rebuild: white rect, 2px dark border, a 5px dark red bar overhanging the top by 3px, chamfered at the top-right corner.

pecas.nome: Glass waterfall on dark
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF points on a 960x540 slide. pecas.nome: Fading parallelogram tabs on tree
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF points on a 960x540 slide. Exact. pecas.nome: Donut seated on a chamfered plate

pecas.nome: Overlapping alpha triangles

pecas.nome: Fan plate from logo to a stack of rows

Right side uses a counterpart pointing right: (806,350), (806,489), (840,419), #D9D9D9, from 3 stacked rows to a dashed conclusion box. Effectively a side wall with zero short edge.

pecas.nome: Swoosh arrow overlapping a bracketed panel
pecas.como_montar: Curved block arrow freeform: tail tapers to a point at (437,354), widens up to about 22pt at the neck, head about 45pt, tip at (522,281), overlapping the panel's corner. Panel: #F5F5F5 with offset green L-brackets (known), with the arrow head in front of both. Small ramp wedge before the next title in the same green.

pecas.nome: Bars fading to black at the base
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF pt on a 960x540 slide unless noted. Native bar fill, vertical gradient #595959 from top down to about 40%, then to #0D0D0D at baseline. Thin gridline-like dashed verticals run in front, a thin gold trend arrow crosses bars on top.
pecas.serve_para: Long market-size series; the base merges with axis so bars seem to rise from the floor.

pecas.nome: Soft glow dots on a risk matrix
pecas.como_montar: Probably raster with soft mask. Build with oval d≈36 and radial gradient: solid to 70% then alpha 0 at 100% of a d≈52 oval behind it. Red #FF0000, amber #FFC000, green #00B050. Sits on flat grid plus a grey #E6E6E6 dashed gold highlight box.
pecas.serve_para: Risk matrix markers.

pecas.nome: Modal over dimmed slide with offset colour shadow
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Duplicate the slide as background, full-bleed black at ~58% alpha above it. White rect (259,87)-(1209,735). Solid pink #FF385A offset: rect shifted +7,+6, drawn under it, so only the 6-7px L at right and bottom shows, starting 38px below the card's top at x=1209 and 11px right of its left at y=735. Inner: two overlapping circles with 40% alpha of pink and grey, and a white lens in the overlap holding the key number (+20 mn).
pecas.serve_para: Pop-up detail or definition within a sequence, reuses the previous slide as depth.

pecas.nome: Faceted pyramid with tier tabs
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Known pyramid, but better than usual: each tier is a truncated pyramid with a darker top-right wall and a lighter left, and a tab rectangle in the same tone emerges from behind the tier's right wall, carrying its text. Tiers (bottom to top) #FF385A/#FF6B84, #FF8196/#FFAEBB, #FFE1E6/#FFEFF2. Apex tab tallest. Base corners (104,621)(319,711)(535,621), upper tier overlaps lower by ~40px.
pecas.serve_para: Admission criteria, funnels with explanatory text.

pecas.nome: Rail of cascading chevrons
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Left rail 75px wide, #404040. Bottom: 3 chevrons pitch ~50, width of the rail, each with a 6px white chevron above it, tones stepping #FF385A, #FF8196, #FFE1E6 (or greys on appendix). Slide-wide signature, cheap sense of downward layers.
pecas.serve_para: Slide master signature.

pecas.nome: Slashed triangle shards holding product cards
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Field #404040. Light #D9D9D9 triangles separated by ~25px field-coloured gaps forming an X, e.g. (1025,0)(1465,0)(1225,463). Card images (745x1031 raster, rotated cards) break out of the triangle edge, phone raster bleeds off the bottom. Triangles are native; products are rasters. Replacing the rasters with two rotated round rects gives a card stack: back card lower-left, offset ~50px, darker.
pecas.serve_para: Divider or thesis slide with product imagery.

pecas.nome: Mitre-joined diamond photo mosaic
pecas.como_montar: 3 square photos rotated 45 degrees, about 164pt on the diagonal, touching along edges: 2 on top row, 1 below centre, the lower in front. The cluster straddles the top edge of a full-width #E6E6E6 band (band covers lower 45%). Name labels rotated +/-45 degrees along outer edges. Build with diamond shape picture fill. Intelbras p32 variant: single diamond 1.5pt navy outline a bit larger than the photo, cropped cut-out inside.
pecas.serve_para: Team, board bios

pecas.nome: Elevated soft-shadow card over a recessed row
pecas.como_montar: Page #EDEDED. Upper card #F4F4F4 no shadow, radius 4pt (recessed tone). Lower card pure white, radius 4pt, native outer shadow: down 3pt, blur 4pt, about 45% black: contrast between the 2 tones implies 2 heights. Green vertical line and dots inside; hairline footer divider.
pecas.serve_para: Agenda or thesis tracker with price target strip

pecas.nome: Spine rail with notched teeth and overhanging header
pecas.como_montar: Panel #F0F0F0 bleeds off the right. Left spine 6pt wide with rounded top-left corner, in section colour. Header band same colour, 29pt tall, running from the spine to the right edge. Bullets: small right-pointing triangle (6x10pt), same colour, attached to the spine, so the spine appears to have teeth. Repeat for a 2nd section in grey #A6A6A6. Risk matrix tiles on the left have 3 tones by section.
pecas.serve_para: Risk lists, grouped bullet panels

pecas.nome: Scrim with band and speed lines
pecas.como_montar: Previous slide at full size under black 50% alpha. Band: pure white, full-width, about 208pt tall centred at 55% of height. Above and below it 16pt strips #E3E3E3 so band looks extruded. Two white hairlines, different lengths (207pt, 250pt), in the top-left strip; same mirrored bottom-right.
pecas.serve_para: Rhetorical transition question between sections

pecas.nome: Offset corner plates peeking out from a card
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Measured vector, very simple. Two solid rounded rects #8C0CB0 of 382x208: top-left at (109,263)-(491,471), bottom-right at (1006,531)-(1388,739). Main card on top, #F6F6F6, (123,275)-(1375,727), radius about 75px. So plates stick out only 14px left and 12px up, and 13px right and 12px down, and read as a stack behind the card. Distinct from the grey-card corner brackets because plates are solid and share the card's radius.
pecas.serve_para: Big quotes, a transcript from a results call, one-message slides.

pecas.nome: Translucent concentric arcs over tinted photo
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Photo raster full bleed with light purple tint (white ~25-35%). Circle 1, very large, center off-slide right: left edge at x~660 at y=500, solid #8C0CB0 at ~55% alpha (#953AA8 on photo). Circle 2, same center, left edge x~770: solid #8C0CB0 100%. Result is a soft 110px translucent rim. Title in the solid zone. The arcs are native; the photo is the only raster.
pecas.serve_para: Cover with a corporate photograph.

pecas.nome: Diagonal clipped photo, translucent footer band, parallel dashed path
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Solid #8C0CB0 field with freeform right edge from (1092,0) to (720,825), about 65 degrees, photo raster behind it, tinted ~15%. Bottom band across the photo y 505-825, #8C0CB0 at ~55% alpha (#83379C), carrying the BUY call. Dashed white line (955,0) to (580,810), parallel to the edge at about 140px offset, with outline icons sitting on the line that break it; text right-aligned to each icon, so the text steps diagonally.
pecas.serve_para: Investment thesis summary, section divider with a 3-point recap.

pecas.nome: Wedge from a photo into a speech bubble
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Portrait cut-out at left over a very light wedge #F5E6FF: polygon about (212,335)(345,320)(345,440)(212,440), going wider toward the bubble. Bubble (345,320)-(705,440), #E4BCFF, radius ~25, drawn over the wedge's right edge. Reads like a projection beam from speaker to message.
pecas.serve_para: Executive quote, founder thesis.

pecas.nome: Rail of curved layers, magenta to deep purple
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Same as the 3R rail, gradient-filled: base vertical gradient #E100FF to #3A0060, one dark wave #6A008C in the middle and a light translucent wave #C080FF on top; right edge wavy, width varies 45-70px.
pecas.serve_para: Slide master signature.

pecas.nome: Equals wedge linking chart rows
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF points on a 960x540 slide. Exact trapezoid (333,319),(364,287),(621,287),(652,319) #A5A5A5 with a bold '=' centred. Bottom width 319, top 257, height 32, inset 31 per side. Sits between two rows on a shared grey band so it looks like a raised shelf that the upper chart row rests on and feeds into the lower row. Multiplication signs between upper charts are plain text.
pecas.serve_para: DuPont or formula decomposition, three charts equal one result chart

pecas.nome: Double lens: circular window in the veil plus gradientless beam
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF points on a 960x540 slide. Veil over page. Big white ellipse roughly x690-930, y30-310 cut on the veil so that the right chart end stays lit; both ellipse top and bottom are clipped into arcs. Teal beam #0FA9B2 approx (475,240),(566,379),(667,197),(710,274), measured from render, plus or minus 5, and not found as a separate vector. Grey card x48-565, y240-465 with teal stroke, caption pill straddling the bottom edge.
pecas.serve_para: Comparing a metric with its incremental variant; focus on the last point

pecas.nome: Histogram tail wall into quote plate
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF points on a 960x540 slide. Measured from render, plus or minus 3. Grey band behind the histogram tail, #E8E8E8, x~530-636, y~375-510. Wall trapezoid x636-668, left height ~375-510, right ~352-522, #A6A6A6. Plate x668-960, y352-522, #F2F2F2 with portrait and quote. Histogram bars change colour from green to teal at the band start, so colour and wall both mark the same split.
pecas.serve_para: Distribution tail or subset expanding into a comment

pecas.nome: Nested tonal pentagon radar
pecas.serve_para: Porter forces or any 5-axis score

pecas.nome: Faded previous slide as modal backdrop
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF points on a 960x540 slide. Same slide kept beneath, then a full-slide rect #F2F2F2 or light grey alpha ~0.7-0.8 and a modal plate with shadow on top; title of the slide still ghosted, modal gets a new heading. Modal rect offset 100/80 from slide edges, with shadow (+4,+4) blur 8, black alpha .35. No slide transition, simply duplicates of the slide.
pecas.serve_para: Animated-style step on a static deck: deep-dive popups, Q&A follow-ups

pecas.nome: Grey lens into browser window
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF pt on a 960x540 slide unless noted. Grey #D9D9D9 wedge from bar to card (known zoom). Distinct part: card with shadow, then mock window: grey chrome #D9D9D9 band, three dots red, yellow and green d=10, white pill URL field, white page inset 8pt with news text.
pecas.serve_para: Citing a news article as evidence attached to a data point.

pecas.nome: Double-outline hexagons on a background arc
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF pt on a 960x540 slide unless noted. Hexagon outer about 98pt wide: stroke 2.5pt #6FC3E8, fill page navy #1F3864. Inner hexagon about 82pt wide, solid #6FC3E8, concentric. Teal #009B85 1.5pt arc, from a large circle centered off the left edge, passes behind hexagons. Middle hex shifts right 68pt following the arc. Inactive at alpha 0.2 as progress state.
pecas.serve_para: Three-point thesis on a dark slide.

pecas.nome: Interlocked hexagon cluster
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF pt on a 960x540 slide unless noted. Same double hex about 118pt wide. Three stacked with shared adjacent edges: outer strokes touch, navy gap keeps them separate. Offsets dx≈91, dy≈52, then dy≈110. Bleeds over a gradient page, no chart overlap.
pecas.serve_para: Recommendation stats: target, IRR, price.

pecas.nome: Flowing wave ribbons on the slide edge
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF pt on a 960x540 slide unless noted. Freeform band on left edge, x 0-37, with sinusoidal right side; 3 overlapping waves in horizontal gradients, #5FBFC0 to #004185, phase-shifted, darker on top. Page number in white at the bottom. Light stroke between waves. Master element.
pecas.serve_para: Master-level identity touch that keeps content area clean.

pecas.nome: Full-width red band over a dimmed slide
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF points on a 960x540 slide. Page duplicate; full-slide white or grey veil alpha ~.5; band rect y~218-322, full width, #CC0002 with a large white centred question. Text beneath is cut by band. No shadow. Transition slide with no new layout.
pecas.serve_para: Pivot question between sections

pecas.nome: Wedges over photo cover
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF points on a 960x540 slide. Rasters with alpha (923x761, 1342x388) over a photo. Upper polygon bright red #C80000 gradient with a very rounded corner (r~60) covers left 2/3, angle ~ -60 degrees at right edge. Second lower shape dark red #8E0E1C rising from the bottom edge with a rounded peak near (690,320). Photo appears between them as a wedge. Native rebuild: freeform with arcs, gradient fill.
pecas.serve_para: Cover or divider

pecas.nome: Shallow-angle wall panel pair
pecas.como_montar: Polygon on p11: x489.9-507, long edge y339.9-501.6, short edge y345.07-496.4, #D1D1D1. p9 larger: left panel #F5F5F5, about x61-491 y108-477; wall to about x505, short-side panel about y122-468. Angle is about 17 degrees from horizontal, versus 45 in Mercado Libre.
pecas.serve_para: Same as above when a quieter effect is wanted; dense slides

pecas.nome: Solid zoom trapezoid between tables
pecas.como_montar: Variant of the gradient beam: one solid polygon #12D0FF, no gradient. Narrow edge at x447.6 y254-365 (spans the 3 source rows), wide edge x525 y167-451 (full height of the destination table). The destination table sits on top of the wide edge, hiding nothing; source table abuts the narrow edge. The polygon has a notch: the middle of the wide side is covered by the table so only the top and bottom triangles remain visible.
pecas.serve_para: Expanding rows of a table into a detail table

pecas.nome: Light cone from donut slice to callout box
pecas.como_montar: Callout rect #00C4E9 about 307x94pt under the donut. Behind the donut, a pale #E3F6FD trapezoid: narrow top about 55pt wide hidden under the donut slice's bottom (the donut has centre about (270,264), R 78, hole r 48), wide bottom exactly the callout's width on its top edge. Order: cone, then callout, then donut on top. Cone height about 50pt.
pecas.serve_para: Tie a dominant slice to its explanation

pecas.nome: Slanted parallel strips cutting a photo
pecas.como_montar: Photo fills the right half, its left edge masked by a slant of about 12 degrees from vertical. Three parallelograms over the seam, each about 30pt wide, top shifted about +117pt right of bottom: navy #0B3A82, mid blue #0A7BD6, pale #B6E3FF, ordered left to right, each with a thin soft shadow on its right edge (blur 4pt, 30% black). Dot halftone corner decals are raster.
pecas.serve_para: Covers

pecas.nome: Outlined box with a bevel and tucked screenshot
pecas.como_montar: Box #F4F4F4 with 2pt purple outline. On the right, grey bevel polygon about 12pt wide, tapering 3pt at top and bottom, and the outline continues around the bevel's outer top and bottom edges. A dark code screenshot sits behind the bevel, with a Python logo overlapping its bottom corner.
pecas.serve_para: Small numeric callout backed by evidence

pecas.nome: Cut-out person breaking a quote panel
pecas.como_montar: Quote rect #F2F2F2 with a right-triangle flag at the top corner (navy on the left, cyan on the right), about 40x14pt, pointing inward. Person PNG with transparent bg about 95pt tall placed at the panel's outer end, standing past the top and side, in front of the panel and flag.
pecas.serve_para: Management quotes attached to a timeline

pecas.nome: Folded tab header on a card
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF pt on a 960x540 slide unless noted. MEASURED. Card (47,83)-(321,485) #F1F1F1 with a thin teal outline. Header band (45,73)-(334,99) radial or linear gradient teal #01826D to near-black navy #0A1420, wider than the card: 2pt overhang left and 13pt right. Fold: triangle about (321,99),(334,99),(321,112) navy #112235, drawn behind the card, so the overhang appears to wrap behind it.
pecas.serve_para: Company profile sidebar; any card that needs a ribbon title.

pecas.nome: Isometric wire cube in a dashed orbit
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF pt on a 960x540 slide unless noted. MEASURED, vector. Disc d=82 at (521,244) #F1F1F1, dashed ring d=94 teal concentric, dashed spokes to neighbor cards. Cube outline hexagon (515,275),(549,267),(549,230),(524,218),(492,225),(492,262) as thick stroke 5pt #BFBFBF, plus three inner edges meeting near (515,238). Inside it a teal disc d=29 (506,232)-(535,261), partly crossed by the front edges. Lower version inverts it: thick teal cube, grey sphere, and back edges dashed to show transparency.
pecas.serve_para: Core versus near-core, or a product module placed in the center.

pecas.nome: Extruded pie with ghost remainder
pecas.como_montar: Raster 944x416 in the source, buildable from freeforms. In px@110: top ellipse x 905-1282, y 520-700, so ry/rx about 0.47. Slices sector-shaped on the ellipse, #01826D and #05604F. Extrusion depth about 29pt: freeform following the lower ellipse arc, shifted down, horizontal gradient #01604F to #002A22. Remainder of the pie left unfilled, only a hairline dashed outline. Thin white seam between slices. Prefer drawing only the two highlighted slices.
pecas.serve_para: Showing a part-of-whole where the part matters and the rest is de-emphasized.

pecas.nome: Diamond badge with offset under-edge
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF pt on a 960x540 slide unless noted. Rotated square about 48pt diagonal, teal fill #01826D with white text. Below it a same-size diamond in darker #05604F shifted +4pt in y, showing only a V along the lower edges. Soft shadow optional.
pecas.serve_para: Multiple callout (5x, 8x) floating above bars.

pecas.nome: Recessed pie inside a donut
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF pt on a 960x540 slide unless noted. Outer donut about 310pt in diameter, thickness about 58pt. In the hole, the same data repeated as a pie with d≈118pt, carrying a soft grey shadow on a white hole, so it reads as a disc floating in a well. Satellites: round flags d≈35 with soft shadow at each slice's outer edge, overlapping nothing. Not verified whether vector.
pecas.serve_para: Share by country or peer; focus plus context in the same ring.

pecas.nome: Hard offset plate and L-shadow cards
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF pt on a 960x540 slide unless noted. Logo plate: rect 158x66 teal #01826D with a darker copy #05604F offset +6,+6 behind it. Cards: rect 186x65 #F2F2F2 with soft shadow, then an L along right and bottom edges 3pt thick, gradient teal to navy. Faded alternative state: same group at alpha about 40%, placed in the sibling column to show the deal not in focus.
pecas.serve_para: Side-by-side comparison in which one column is focal.

pecas.nome: Icon disc with orbiting partial arcs
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF pt on a 960x540 slide unless noted. Grey wedge zoom (known) leads to a raised card with a 2pt grey border and shadow. Distinct part: disc d≈54 with a thick gradient ring, plus one or two partial arcs r≈+10pt around it, 1.5pt, covering about 120 degrees and offset to the left. Thin curved connector links discs in a zigzag. Text rule runs from disc to the right edge, ending in a small diamond.
pecas.serve_para: Short list of 3 drivers next to a chart.

pecas.nome: Ghost next row
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF points on a 960x540 slide. Top card full opacity; second row of chart and card in the same position at alpha ~8%, no animation, suggesting what's coming. Rounded cards r~22, white with 1pt grey stroke and soft shadow (+2,+3) on pale background.
pecas.serve_para: Progressive reveal on printed or PDF decks

pecas.nome: Hard L-shadow card with gradient plate
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF pt on a 960x540 slide unless noted. MEASURED. Plate rect (30,80)-(286,317), gradient #006600 to #00B000 to #006600; white card (30,73)-(281,312) sits over it, leaving 5pt visible on right and bottom only. Thin frame stroke #003300 on the card. Third card (NewCo) tinted #F7FFF7 with bright green frame instead, no plate.
pecas.serve_para: Comparison cards; the plate gradient gives a lit-edge look.

pecas.nome: Gradient glass bubbles at scale
pecas.como_montar: Probably rasters with soft masks (205x205 and 41x41 images on page), not confirmed by position. Build with ovals: d=73 hero, d=16 small. Radial gradient, focus upper left #E8FFE8 to #A5EDA5 at rim, hairline grey outline. Three heroes overlap nothing; small dots scattered at varying saturation, alpha 0.6-1. Active variant shifts rim tone to #3DBE3D.
pecas.serve_para: KPI clusters; dots suggest quantity behind the number.

pecas.nome: Rim-lit circle
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF pt on a 960x540 slide unless noted. Disc d≈65, fill #1A1A1A. Stroke 1.5pt as gradient, #00E000 along bottom right to #005500 at top left. Second circle d≈72, 0.75pt, shifted (-2,+1), dim #00A000, visible as an open crescent. Page background black with faded diagonal streak layer.
pecas.serve_para: Numerals on dark thesis slides.

pecas.nome: Boardroom plan: capsule table with seats
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF pt on a 960x540 slide unless noted. Capsule 347x51, centered around (405,424): rounded rect radius=height/2, horizontal gradient #001A00 to #0A5A0A to #001A00, white 1pt stroke. Chairs are rounded rects with arms: seat 38x27 tucked 8pt behind table, back rail 30x8 at outer side, two arm bars 6x24, all 1pt white stroke, fill gradient dark green. Head chair at capsule's right end rotated 90 degrees. Table sits over the seats.
pecas.serve_para: Board composition; each seat tied to a name.

pecas.nome: Fading float waterfall, outlined totals
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF pt on a 960x540 slide unless noted. Floating step: rect with green 0.75pt edge, gradient #00C000 at its left or bottom edge fading to transparent at the other, plus a very faint rect of same x below it extending to the next subtotal to hint a column. Totals: rect with no fill, 1pt white stroke. Page black with raster wave texture.
pecas.serve_para: Returns bridge on dark slide.

pecas.nome: Recessed range tube
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF pt on a 960x540 slide unless noted. Rect 203x26, horizontal gradient #000 to #0C6B0C at center to #000, 0.75pt #0C6B0C stroke. Thin vertical tick at the center, white alpha 0.6, 8pt tall. Min and max outside, base value below in green.
pecas.serve_para: Bear, base and bull sensitivity row.

pecas.nome: Column lit by segment gradients
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF pt on a 960x540 slide unless noted. Native stacked bar with each series a gradient fill. Tones step from #002800 at base to #22DD22 on top; within each segment vertical gradient darker at bottom edge. Adjacent segments therefore have a visible dark seam. Same on p10 as single bars #00C000 at top to #004D00 at bottom.
pecas.serve_para: Time series that should feel like solid columns; works on native charts, so stays editable.

pecas.nome: Double-tail chevron cards
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF pt on a 960x540 slide unless noted. MEASURED. Body (554,178),(582,149),(960,149),(960,208),(582,208) #D9D9D9, bleeding off right. Detached tail (520,178),(547,149),(574,149),(547,178),(574,207),(547,207) #E0E0E0. Gap 7pt white. Next rows shift x by +88pt for a staircase toward the right, at y step 145pt.
pecas.serve_para: 3 stacked benefits pointing back at a chart.

pecas.nome: Tube gauges in tinted cards
pecas.como_montar: All coordinates in PDF pt on a 960x540 slide unless noted. Card 110x360, rounded r≈15, tint fill brand at 30%, dashed grey stroke. Inner track 34x310 rounded #F2F2F2. Line 2pt from base to value, capped by small outlined hexagon 18x10. Logo at base.
pecas.serve_para: Comparing a score across 3 peers.

pecas.nome: Thread running behind vertical panels
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Panels 237x500 at x 484, 815, 1152, gradient #1A3A85 to #15306E, 1px white border, on a darker navy field. A 1px white line crosses the slide at y=171 and appears interrupted by a break-tick ||  label on each panel, as if threaded. Weak depth but cheap.
pecas.serve_para: Sequential stages in columns on dark themes.

pecas.nome: Ring with outer arc segments
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Low-depth variant of nested ovals. Inner ring ~r=145 center (264,432), 20px stroke #CCCCCC, white center. Outer half-ring r 290, 40px thick arcs each 45 degrees, tones #CCCCCC, #FFE1E6, #FF8196, #FF385A clockwise, thin grey spokes, icons between. Colour matches items 01-04 in the panel at right.
pecas.serve_para: 4-item story with icons.

pecas.nome: Torn paper news clipping
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Pasted raster with jagged alpha edge, grey paper over a faded newspaper layer with bold headline on top. Editing as shapes is not worthwhile; a jagged freeform with ~80 random points plus faded text would approximate it.
pecas.serve_para: Press evidence.

pecas.nome: Rounded modal over light dim
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Slide at ~15% black dim, white rect (106,205)-(1358,656) radius about 55, no shadow or border. The rail and title stay visible, content blocks at the far edge visibly poke out behind it. Depth from contrast only; weakest of the modals, add an offset or shadow when reproducing.
pecas.serve_para: Synthesis message between sections, closing thought.

pecas.nome: Lavender capsule table with person icons
pecas.como_montar: Coordinates are px on a 1467x825 canvas (110 dpi render of 960x540pt): divide by 1467/825 to get slide fractions. Capsule (970,340)-(1220,407), vertical gradient #F7EFFF top to #C9A0FF bottom, soft shadow.
